fr: Anneau doré : acheté. Lumineux : tu peux l'acheter. Sombre : achète d'abord un nœud au-dessus. « ou » : choisis l'un des deux. ? : un exploit l'ouvre.

keys: The bell tolls: one descent, the same for all
en: The bell tolls: one descent, the same for all
fr: La cloche sonne : une descente, la même pour tous

keys: Your hero starts every run stronger.
en: Your hero starts every run stronger.
fr: Ton héros commence chaque partie plus fort.

keys: these items can drop in every run
en: these items can drop in every run
fr: ces objets peuvent apparaître dans chaque partie

keys: heal %d%% of max health when a floor is won
en: heal %d%% of max health when a floor is won
fr: soigne %d %% de la Vie max à chaque étage remporté
%d objets de plus chez le marchand
les élites lâchent toujours de l'équipement Magique

keys: the minimap shows stairs, merchant and forge
en: the minimap shows stairs, merchant and forge
fr: la minicarte montre escaliers, marchand et forge
choisis ton arme de départ parmi %d

keys: start with a random spell tome
en: start with a random spell tome
fr: commence avec un grimoire de sort au hasard

keys: a new oath to swear before a run
en: a new oath to swear before a run
fr: un nouveau serment à prêter avant une partie

keys: Level 1 gives: pick your starting weapon among %d: %s
en: Level 1 gives: pick your starting weapon among %d: %s
fr: Le niveau 1 donne : choisis ton arme de départ parmi %d : %s
Actuel : %d armes de départ   >   Suivant : +%d armes : %s

keys: The pact is sworn. Walk in: the door seals behind you.
en: The pact is sworn. Walk in: the door seals behind you.
fr: Le pacte est scellé. Entre : la porte se refermera derrière toi.

keys: The pact is broken: %d max Health lost for the rest of the run.
en: The pact is broken: %d max Health lost for the rest of the run.
fr: Le pacte est rompu : %d de Vie max perdus pour le reste de la partie.

keys: The pact is kept. A relic answers the oath.
en: The pact is kept. A relic answers the oath.
fr: Le pacte est tenu. Une relique répond au serment.

keys: The last foe falls. The door opens, and the room keeps its relic.
en: The last foe falls. The door opens, and the room keeps its relic.
fr: Le dernier ennemi tombe. La porte s'ouvre, et la salle garde sa relique.

keys: The wall gives way: a hidden room.
en: The wall gives way: a hidden room.
fr: Le mur cède : une salle cachée.

keys: The seal shatters: two ways down. %s, or %s.
en: The seal shatters: two ways down. %s, or %s.
fr: Le sceau vole en éclats : deux chemins vers les profondeurs. %s, ou %s.

keys: The seal shatters. The way down lies open.
en: The seal shatters. The way down lies open.
fr: Le sceau vole en éclats. La voie des profondeurs s'ouvre.

keys: Sealed. Slay %d more monster to open the stairs.
en: Sealed. Slay %d more monster to open the stairs.
fr: Scellé. Abats encore %d monstre pour ouvrir les escaliers.

keys: Sealed. Slay %d more monsters to open the stairs.
en: Sealed. Slay %d more monsters to open the stairs.
fr: Scellé. Abats encore %d monstres pour ouvrir les escaliers.

keys: The Well stirs... a curse falls on this floor
en: The Well stirs... a curse falls on this floor
fr: Le Puits s'agite... une malédiction s'abat sur cet étage

keys: Descend. Bring back the stolen souls. Become what the dark demands.
en: Descend. Bring back the stolen souls. Become what the dark demands.
fr: Descends. Ramène les âmes volées. Deviens ce que l'ombre exige.

keys: Under the Well there is more Well. Down here the dark has teeth, and what it has chewed still wanders.
en: Under the Well there is more Well. Down here the dark has teeth, and what it has chewed still wanders.
fr: Sous le Puits, il y a encore le Puits. Ici, l'obscurité a des dents, et ce qu'elle a mâché erre encore.

keys: Reach floor 12, where the last act's warden waits.
en: Reach floor 12, where the last act's warden waits.
fr: Atteins l'étage 12, où attend le gardien du dernier acte.

keys: Slay the Nameless Effigy, below the Ossuary.
en: Slay the Nameless Effigy, below the Ossuary.
fr: Terrasse le Gisant Sans Nom, sous l'Ossuaire.

keys: Take your master's place at the bottom of the Well.
en: Take your master's place at the bottom of the Well.
fr: Prends la place de ton maître au fond du Puits.

keys: Pick up 400 gold in a single run.
en: Pick up 400 gold in a single run.
fr: Ramasse 400 or en une seule partie.

keys: Discover 15 kinds of creatures in the bestiary.
en: Discover 15 kinds of creatures in the bestiary.
fr: Découvre 15 espèces de créatures dans le bestiaire.

keys: Win the trial of the Threshold and come back to life.
en: Win the trial of the Threshold and come back to life.
fr: Remporte l'épreuve du Seuil et reviens à la vie.

keys: Ring the bell at the bottom of the Well.
en: Ring the bell at the bottom of the Well.
fr: Sonne la cloche au fond du Puits.

keys: Reach level 12 in a single run.
en: Reach level 12 in a single run.
fr: Atteins le niveau 12 en une seule partie.

keys: Defeat a warden of the Well.
en: Defeat a warden of the Well.

keys: Skills have a 12% chance to be ready again at once (an echo can't echo; all echoes together: 45% at most).
en: Skills have a 12% chance to be ready again at once (an echo can't echo; all echoes together: 45% at most).
fr: Les compétences ont 12 % de chances d'être aussitôt prêtes à nouveau (un écho ne fait pas d'écho ; tous les échos ensemble : 45 % au plus).
Les ennemis qui meurent en brûlant explosent.

keys: Enemies that hit you up close take 3 damage.
en: Enemies that hit you up close take 3 damage.
fr: Les ennemis qui te frappent au corps à corps subissent 3 Dégâts.
+25 % de Dégâts contre les ennemis ralentis.

keys: Every 4th hit, lightning jumps to 2 enemies.
en: Every 4th hit, lightning jumps to 2 enemies.
fr: Tous les 4 coups, un éclair bondit sur 2 ennemis.
Rend 1 de Vie par ennemi abattu.

keys: The floor gives way at the edges!
en: The floor gives way at the edges!
fr: Le sol cède sur les bords !
Les monstres ont 15 % de Vie en plus.
Les monstres infligent 10 % de Dégâts en plus.
Les monstres d'élite sont 30 % plus fréquents.
Le marchand demande 30 % d'or en plus.

keys: One more monster in every room.
en: One more monster in every room.
fr: Un monstre de plus dans chaque salle.

keys: Monsters move faster and you get less time to dodge.
en: Monsters move faster and you get less time to dodge.
fr: Les monstres vont plus vite et tu as moins de temps pour esquiver.
Les boss ont 25 % de Vie en plus.

keys: You start with 15% less max health.
en: You start with 15% less max health.
fr: Tu commences avec 15 % de Vie max en moins.

keys: Monsters have 15% more health and deal 10% more damage.
en: Monsters have 15% more health and deal 10% more damage.
fr: Les monstres ont 15 % de Vie en plus et infligent 10 % de Dégâts en plus.

keys: Records older than Kagari, swollen with water and silence. On a table, a candle has dripped, not long ago.
en: Records older than Kagari, swollen with water and silence. On a table, a candle has dripped, not long ago.
fr: Des registres plus vieux que Kagari, gonflés d'eau et de silence. Sur une table, une chandelle a coulé il y a peu.

keys: Streets of sand, stalls nobody keeps. The wind still sells what is left.
en: Streets of sand, stalls nobody keeps. The wind still sells what is left.
fr: Des rues de sable, des étals sans marchands. Le vent vend encore ce qu'il reste.

keys: The temple's lower town burned here. Its embers never quite went out.
en: The temple's lower town burned here. Its embers never quite went out.
fr: Ici brûlait la ville basse du temple. Ses braises ne se sont jamais tout à fait éteintes.

keys: Kagari's dead, row after row. They no longer sleep well.
en: Kagari's dead, row after row. They no longer sleep well.
fr: Les morts de Kagari, rangée après rangée. Leur sommeil n'est plus paisible.

keys: The spring under Kagari came down this far, and never went back up. Paper boats rot on its banks.
en: The spring under Kagari came down this far, and never went back up. Paper boats rot on its banks.
fr: La source sous Kagari est descendue jusqu'ici, et n'est jamais remontée. Des bateaux de papier pourrissent sur ses rives.

keys: Damp stone and soft moss. Something drips in the dark.
en: Damp stone and soft moss. Something drips in the dark.
fr: Pierre humide et mousse tendre. Quelque chose goutte dans le noir.

keys: Below the Ossuary, the dead nobody named. The cold does not come from the stone.
en: Below the Ossuary, the dead nobody named. The cold does not come from the stone.
fr: Sous l'Ossuaire, les morts que nul n'a nommés. Le froid ne vient pas de la pierre.

keys: Halls of columns raised for a sun no one prays to anymore.
en: Halls of columns raised for a sun no one prays to anymore.
fr: Des salles à colonnes élevées pour un soleil que plus personne ne prie.

keys: Gold under every stone, a face on every coin. At noon, in the dark, something still shines.
en: Gold under every stone, a face on every coin. At noon, in the dark, something still shines.
fr: De l'or sous chaque pierre, un visage sur chaque pièce. À midi, dans le noir, quelque chose brille encore.

keys: The village's roots break through the vault, and the light that seeps in feeds a garden no one tends.
en: The village's roots break through the vault, and the light that seeps in feeds a garden no one tends.
fr: Les racines du village percent la voûte, et la lumière qui filtre nourrit un jardin que plus personne n'entretient.

keys: Below the kingdom of dust, the stone ends. What waits here has waited for a long time.
en: Below the kingdom of dust, the stone ends. What waits here has waited for a long time.
fr: Sous le royaume de poussière, la pierre s'arrête. Ce qui attend ici attend depuis longtemps.

keys: Gold heaped at the edge of the hole where a sun was buried.
en: Gold heaped at the edge of the hole where a sun was buried.
fr: De l'or entassé au bord du trou où l'on enterra un soleil.

keys: The Pit of the Dead Sun
en: The Pit of the Dead Sun

keys: Paper boats rot along the black water. Someone still folds them.
en: Paper boats rot along the black water. Someone still folds them.
fr: Des bateaux de papier pourrissent au bord de l'eau noire. Quelqu'un en plie encore.

keys: The lower town fell into its own fire. The bridges hold, for now.
en: The lower town fell into its own fire. The bridges hold, for now.
fr: La ville basse s'est effondrée dans son propre feu. Les ponts tiennent, pour l'instant.

keys: Kagari's dead, stacked to the vault. They sank with the earth and kept their rows.
en: Kagari's dead, stacked to the vault. They sank with the earth and kept their rows.
fr: Les morts de Kagari, empilés jusqu'à la voûte. Ils ont sombré avec la terre sans quitter leurs rangs.

keys: Braziers in a ring round an altar of ash. Here the priests fed the sun.
en: Braziers in a ring round an altar of ash. Here the priests fed the sun.
fr: Des braseros en cercle autour d'un autel de cendre. Ici, les prêtres nourrissaient le soleil.

keys: The roots of Kagari's trees reach down this far, and hang still, as if listening.
en: The roots of Kagari's trees reach down this far, and hang still, as if listening.
fr: Les racines des arbres de Kagari descendent jusqu'ici et pendent, immobiles, comme si elles écoutaient.

keys: Shelves in a ring round a reading desk. The ink has outlived the tongue it was written in.
en: Shelves in a ring round a reading desk. The ink has outlived the tongue it was written in.
fr: Des rayonnages en cercle autour d'un pupitre. L'encre a survécu à la langue qui l'écrivait.

keys: Solhar's king held court here, before the sand filled his hall.
en: Solhar's king held court here, before the sand filled his hall.
fr: Le roi de Solhar tenait sa cour ici, avant que le sable n'emplisse sa salle.

keys: Water drips from the stone overhead, as if the Well itself were weeping.
en: Water drips from the stone overhead, as if the Well itself were weeping.
fr: L'eau goutte de la pierre, là-haut, comme si le Puits lui-même pleurait.

keys: The dark of the lower floors clings to those who keep coming back.
en: The dark of the lower floors clings to those who keep coming back.
fr: L'ombre des étages d'en bas colle à ceux qui reviennent sans cesse.

keys: What waits at the bottom marks those who walked out of its Nightmare.
en: What waits at the bottom marks those who walked out of its Nightmare.
fr: Ce qui attend au fond marque ceux qui sont sortis de son Cauchemar.

keys: The light the Well swallowed, given back to one who came up again.
en: The light the Well swallowed, given back to one who came up again.
fr: La lumière que le Puits a avalée, rendue à qui en est remonté.

keys: Characters, monsters, tiles, items, effects and sound effects.
en: Characters, monsters, tiles, items, effects and sound effects.
fr: Personnages, monstres, décors, objets, effets et bruitages.

keys: Weapon attack sheets composed from the pack's sprites, some tiles and effects drawn for the game in its palette.
en: Weapon attack sheets composed from the pack's sprites, some tiles and effects drawn for the game in its palette.
fr: Planches d'attaque des armes composées à partir des sprites du pack, quelques décors et effets dessinés pour le jeu dans sa palette.

keys: The controller button glyphs and arrows added in its style.
en: The controller button glyphs and arrows added in its style.
fr: Les symboles des boutons de manette et les flèches ajoutés dans son style.

keys: The bag's and the forge's skin.
en: The bag's and the forge's skin.
fr: L'habillage du sac et de la forge.

keys: Dark insets and slots redrawn in the same palette.
en: Dark insets and slots redrawn in the same palette.
fr: Encarts sombres et cases redessinés dans la même palette.

keys: The ornate borders of the windows.
en: The ornate borders of the windows.

keys: The music and the ambience loops.
en: The music and the ambience loops.
fr: La musique et les boucles d'ambiance.

keys: Levels matched, ambience filtered and looped.
en: Levels matched, ambience filtered and looped.
fr: Volumes égalisés, ambiances filtrées et bouclées.

keys: Footsteps, hits on each material, the anvil.
en: Footsteps, hits on each material, the anvil.
fr: Les pas, les coups sur chaque matière, l'enclume.

keys: The online leaderboards and the gameplay statistics (an online service; none of its code is in the game).
en: The online leaderboards and the gameplay statistics (an online service; none of its code is in the game).
fr: Les classements en ligne et les statistiques de jeu (un service en ligne ; aucune ligne de son code n'est dans le jeu).

keys:
Deep below, something burns.
The Well breathes it up, and the air itself scorches.
en:
Deep below, something burns.
The Well breathes it up, and the air itself scorches.
fr:
Tout au fond, quelque chose brûle.
Le Puits en exhale le souffle, et l'air lui-même se met à brûler.

keys: The heat builds up. Cool down by the oases, or burn.
en: The heat builds up. Cool down by the oases, or burn.
fr: La chaleur monte. Rafraîchis-toi aux oasis, ou brûle.

keys:
The Well draws breath, and pulls every warmth down to the bottom:
frost creeps over the stone... and over you.
en:
The Well draws breath, and pulls every warmth down to the bottom:
frost creeps over the stone... and over you.
fr:
Le Puits inspire, et aspire toute chaleur vers le fond :
le givre gagne la pierre... et te gagne aussi.

keys: The cold gets into your bones. Warm up by the campfires, or freeze.
en: The cold gets into your bones. Warm up by the campfires, or freeze.
fr: Le froid te pénètre jusqu'aux os. Réchauffe-toi près des feux de camp, ou gèle.

keys:
The Well remembers the moonless night, and swallows every light.
Only your lantern still holds the dark back... barely.
en:
The Well remembers the moonless night, and swallows every light.
Only your lantern still holds the dark back... barely.
fr:
Le Puits se souvient de la nuit sans lune, et avale toute lumière.
Seule ta lanterne retient encore les ténèbres... à peine.

keys: You only see what is right around you. Better loot hides in the dark.
en: You only see what is right around you. Better loot hides in the dark.
fr: Tu ne vois que ce qui t'entoure de près. Un meilleur butin se cache dans le noir.

keys: The Well spares the pilgrim... and pays little for lukewarm souls.
en: The Well spares the pilgrim... and pays little for lukewarm souls.
fr: Le Puits ménage le pèlerin... et paie peu les âmes tièdes.

keys: Martyrdom has its monsters: tougher, faster, and more of them.
en: Martyrdom has its monsters: tougher, faster, and more of them.
fr: Le martyre a ses monstres : plus coriaces, plus rapides, plus nombreux.

keys: Darkness, hordes, and barely time to pray.
en: Darkness, hordes, and barely time to pray.
fr: Ténèbres, hordes, et à peine le temps de prier.

keys: The vigil as it was meant to be kept.
en: The vigil as it was meant to be kept.
fr: La veille telle qu'elle doit être tenue.

keys: The Well's throat. Kagari's roots hang down it like veins, and a warm breath rises from below. Things crawl toward your lantern.
en: The Well's throat. Kagari's roots hang down it like veins, and a warm breath rises from below. Things crawl toward your lantern.
fr: La gorge du Puits. Les racines de Kagari y pendent comme des veines, et d'en bas monte un souffle tiède. Des choses rampent vers ta lanterne.

keys: Where Kagari laid its dead. When the Well stirred, the Ossuary sank with the earth, and the bones no longer lie still.
en: Where Kagari laid its dead. When the Well stirred, the Ossuary sank with the earth, and the bones no longer lie still.
fr: Là où Kagari couchait ses morts. Quand le Puits a remué, l'Ossuaire a sombré avec la terre, et les os ne reposent plus.

keys: The priests of Solhar, a kingdom older than Kagari, built it to feed their sun. Its pyres still burn: they burn souls.
en: The priests of Solhar, a kingdom older than Kagari, built it to feed their sun. Its pyres still burn: they burn souls.
fr: Les prêtres de Solhar, un royaume plus vieux que Kagari, l'ont bâti pour nourrir leur soleil. Ses bûchers brûlent encore : ils brûlent des âmes.

keys: Beneath the pyres lies Solhar itself, under a sky of stone: a kingdom the dust swallowed whole. Its king still counts what he took. Souls, mostly.
en: Beneath the pyres lies Solhar itself, under a sky of stone: a kingdom the dust swallowed whole. Its king still counts what he took. Souls, mostly.
fr: Sous les bûchers s'étend Solhar même, sous un ciel de pierre : un royaume que la poussière a englouti. Son roi y compte encore ce qu'il a pris. Des âmes, surtout.

keys: The altar drinks. A relic rises from the stone.
en: The altar drinks. A relic rises from the stone.
fr: L'autel boit. Une relique s'élève de la pierre.

keys: An altar older than Kagari, black with very old blood. It wants a part of you... and it pays well.
en: An altar older than Kagari, black with very old blood. It wants a part of you... and it pays well.
fr: Un autel plus vieux que Kagari, noir d'un sang très ancien. Il veut une part de toi... et il paie bien.

keys: It giggles and drops something shiny.
en: It giggles and drops something shiny.
fr: Il ricane et laisse tomber quelque chose de brillant.

keys: "Lucky, lucky!" Something very shiny falls at your feet.
en: "Lucky, lucky!" Something very shiny falls at your feet.
fr: « Veinard, veinard ! » Quelque chose de très brillant tombe à tes pieds.

keys: It laughs, and vanishes with your gold.
en: It laughs, and vanishes with your gold.
fr: Il éclate de rire, et disparaît avec ton or.

keys: "A big spender!" A treasure falls at your feet.
en: "A big spender!" A treasure falls at your feet.
fr: « Quel panier percé ! » Un trésor tombe à tes pieds.

keys: A grinning spirit shakes its dice. "Your gold for a treasure? Maybe... maybe not!"
en: A grinning spirit shakes its dice. "Your gold for a treasure? Maybe... maybe not!"
fr: Un esprit ricaneur agite ses dés. « Ton or contre un trésor ? Peut-être... ou peut-être pas ! »

keys: The water is cool and kind. You feel whole again.
en: The water is cool and kind. You feel whole again.
fr: L'eau est fraîche et bienveillante. Tu te sens entier à nouveau.

keys: Strength flows into you: the drowned lend you their fury.
en: Strength flows into you: the drowned lend you their fury.
fr: La force afflue en toi : les noyés te prêtent leur fureur.

keys: The water tastes of mud and ash. It burns your throat.
en: The water tastes of mud and ash. It burns your throat.
fr: L'eau a un goût de vase et de cendre. Elle te brûle la gorge.

keys: Clear water glows under the stone. Sometimes a child's voice hums in it.
en: Clear water glows under the stone. Sometimes a child's voice hums in it.
fr: Une eau claire luit sous la pierre. Parfois, une voix d'enfant y fredonne.

keys: The stone warms under your hand. An old keeper lends you his strength.
en: The stone warms under your hand. An old keeper lends you his strength.
fr: La pierre tiédit sous ta main. Un ancien gardien te prête sa force.

keys: Its eyes glow red. The dead of the Well answer in its place.
en: Its eyes glow red. The dead of the Well answer in its place.
fr: Ses yeux rougeoient. Les morts du Puits répondent à sa place.

keys: Beside it, a niche cut for one more keeper stands empty. On its base a name has been scratched away; one line is left: "He keeps the last flame."
en: Beside it, a niche cut for one more keeper stands empty. On its base a name has been scratched away; one line is left: "He keeps the last flame."
fr: À côté, une niche taillée pour un gardien de plus attend, vide. Sur son socle, un nom a été gratté ; il reste une ligne : « Il garde la dernière flamme. »

keys: The niche of the last keeper, still empty. Under the scratches you can read the name now: Tôma. "He keeps the last flame." He left it in your hands.
en: The niche of the last keeper, still empty. Under the scratches you can read the name now: Tôma. "He keeps the last flame." He left it in your hands.
fr: La niche du dernier gardien, toujours vide. Sous les rayures, tu lis le nom à présent : Tôma. « Il garde la dernière flamme. » Il l'a laissée entre tes mains.

keys: A statue of one of the shrine's old keepers, a stone lantern in hand. Its eyes follow you.
en: A statue of one of the shrine's old keepers, a stone lantern in hand. Its eyes follow you.
fr: La statue d'un ancien gardien du sanctuaire, une lanterne de pierre à la main. Ses yeux te suivent.

keys: The monsters are frenzied: they hit harder, and drop twice the gold.
en: The monsters are frenzied: they hit harder, and drop twice the gold.
fr: Les monstres sont pris de frénésie : ils frappent plus fort, et lâchent deux fois plus d'or.

keys: Your lantern barely lights the way. Rare things hide in the dark.
en: Your lantern barely lights the way. Rare things hide in the dark.
fr: Ta lanterne éclaire à peine le chemin. Des choses rares se cachent dans le noir.

keys: The dead walk here: elites everywhere, and little light.
en: The dead walk here: elites everywhere, and little light.
fr: Les morts arpentent ces lieux : des élites partout, et peu de lumière.

keys: Few monsters here. Someone has set up shop, and strange things wait in the rooms.
en: Few monsters here. Someone has set up shop, and strange things wait in the rooms.
fr: Peu de monstres ici. Quelqu'un a installé son étal, et d'étranges choses attendent dans les salles.

keys: They come in hordes, but they are weak.
en: They come in hordes, but they are weak.
fr: Ils déferlent en hordes, mais ils sont faibles.

keys: Gold glitters everywhere... and so do the traps.
en: Gold glitters everywhere... and so do the traps.
fr: L'or scintille partout... et les pièges aussi.

keys: Runes, eh? Hand me that blade.
en: Runes, eh? Hand me that blade.
fr: Des runes, hein ? Passe-moi cette lame.

keys: Steel remembers every rune you give it.
en: Steel remembers every rune you give it.
fr: L'acier se souvient de chaque rune que tu lui confies.

keys: Each socket holds one rune. Choose well.
en: Each socket holds one rune. Choose well.
fr: Chaque emplacement accueille une rune. Choisis bien.

keys: Changed your mind? I can pry it out. For a price.
en: Changed your mind? I can pry it out. For a price.
fr: Changé d'avis ? Je peux la déloger. Contre paiement.

keys: Things stir in the dark, drawn by the fire...
en: Things stir in the dark, drawn by the fire...
fr: Des choses s'agitent dans le noir, attirées par le feu...

keys: Things stir in the heat haze, drawn by the water...
en: Things stir in the heat haze, drawn by the water...
fr: Des choses s'agitent dans la brume de chaleur, attirées par l'eau...
Plus de place pour les armes
Plus de place pour les armures
Plus de place pour les runes

keys: No room left for tomes and scrolls
en: No room left for tomes and scrolls
fr: Plus de place pour les grimoires et parchemins
Plus de place pour les consommables

keys: No room left for other things
en: No room left for other things
fr: Plus de place pour le reste

keys: Good protection, slows you down a little.
en: Good protection, slows you down a little.
fr: Bonne protection, mais te ralentit un peu.

keys: Cold iron, heavy as a vow.
en: Cold iron, heavy as a vow.
fr: Du fer froid, lourd comme un serment.

keys: Cured hide. It still smells of its last owner.
en: Cured hide. It still smells of its last owner.
fr: Du cuir tanné. Il garde l'odeur de son dernier porteur.

keys: Worn by many before you. None came back.
en: Worn by many before you. None came back.
fr: Portée par bien d'autres avant toi. Aucun n'est revenu.

keys: Woven from a moonless night. Move fast, strike true.
en: Woven from a moonless night. Move fast, strike true.
fr: Tissée d'une nuit sans lune. Bouge vite, frappe juste.
Explose autour de toi. Inflige 25 Dégâts.

keys: Launches an exploding fireball at the nearest enemy.
en: Launches an exploding fireball at the nearest enemy.
fr: Projette une boule de feu explosive sur l'ennemi le plus proche.

keys: A saint's heart in a jar of wax. Restores 70% of your Health.
en: A saint's heart in a jar of wax. Restores 70% of your Health.
fr: Le cœur d'un saint, dans un bocal de cire. Rend 70 % de ta Vie.
Cours bien plus vite pendant 6 secondes.

keys: +5 Damage and +15% critical hit chance for 8 seconds.
en: +5 Damage and +15% critical hit chance for 8 seconds.
fr: +5 Dégâts et +15 % de chance de coup critique pendant 8 secondes.

keys: Finger bones fused into a key, cold as the grave. It fits no door on this side of the Warden.
en: Finger bones fused into a key, cold as the grave. It fits no door on this side of the Warden.
fr: Des phalanges soudées en clef, froides comme la tombe. Elle n'ouvre aucune porte de ce côté du Gardien.

keys: A book of the pyre priests; its binding is still warm. Read it to learn a skill: it becomes your fourth skill.
en: A book of the pyre priests; its binding is still warm. Read it to learn a skill: it becomes your fourth skill.
fr: Un livre des prêtres des bûchers ; sa reliure est encore tiède. Lis-le pour apprendre une compétence : elle devient ta quatrième.

keys: Its pages are rimed with frost; the cold is written in them by a patient hand. Read it to learn a skill: it becomes your fourth skill.
en: Its pages are rimed with frost; the cold is written in them by a patient hand. Read it to learn a skill: it becomes your fourth skill.
fr: Ses pages sont givrées ; le froid y est écrit d'une main patiente. Lis-le pour apprendre une compétence : elle devient ta quatrième.

keys: The prayers of Kagari's shrine, copied for those who go down. Read it to learn a skill: it becomes your fourth skill.
en: The prayers of Kagari's shrine, copied for those who go down. Read it to learn a skill: it becomes your fourth skill.
fr: Les prières du sanctuaire de Kagari, recopiées pour ceux qui descendent. Lis-le pour apprendre une compétence : elle devient ta quatrième.

keys: A book the storm struck twice; it still rumbles. Read it to learn a skill: it becomes your fourth skill.
en: A book the storm struck twice; it still rumbles. Read it to learn a skill: it becomes your fourth skill.
fr: Un livre que l'orage a frappé deux fois ; il gronde encore. Lis-le pour apprendre une compétence : elle devient ta quatrième.

keys: A forgotten captain's manual, its margins written in blood. Read it to learn a skill: it becomes your fourth skill.
en: A forgotten captain's manual, its margins written in blood. Read it to learn a skill: it becomes your fourth skill.
fr: Le manuel d'un capitaine oublié, annoté de sang dans les marges. Lis-le pour apprendre une compétence : elle devient ta quatrième.

keys: Its pages never lie still, even at the bottom of the Well. Read it to learn a skill: it becomes your fourth skill.
en: Its pages never lie still, even at the bottom of the Well. Read it to learn a skill: it becomes your fourth skill.
fr: Ses pages ne tiennent jamais en place, même au fond du Puits. Lis-le pour apprendre une compétence : elle devient ta quatrième.

keys: Huge and slow. Everything in front of you goes flying.
en: Huge and slow. Everything in front of you goes flying.
fr: Immense et lent. Tout ce qui est devant toi s'envole.

keys: A prayer book of the pyres: its pages burn and are never consumed. Spits three embers at once.
en: A prayer book of the pyres: its pages burn and are never consumed. Spits three embers at once.
fr: Un livre de prières des bûchers : ses pages brûlent sans se consumer. Crache trois braises à la fois.

keys: Arrows that go through the first enemy.
en: Arrows that go through the first enemy.
fr: Des flèches qui transpercent le premier ennemi.

keys: Crushing blows that send enemies flying.
en: Crushing blows that send enemies flying.
fr: Des coups écrasants qui projettent les ennemis.

keys: The curved blade of the shrine's keepers, the one your master taught you. Quick and faithful.
en: The curved blade of the shrine's keepers, the one your master taught you. Quick and faithful.
fr: La lame courbe des gardiens du sanctuaire, celle que ton maître t'a apprise. Rapide et fidèle.

keys: A ninja's straight blade: quick, wide cuts.
en: A ninja's straight blade: quick, wide cuts.
fr: La lame droite du ninja : des entailles rapides et larges.

keys: The tool of a Kagari well-digger who dug too deep. Pierces armor.
en: The tool of a Kagari well-digger who dug too deep. Pierces armor.
fr: L'outil d'un puisatier de Kagari qui a creusé trop bas. Perce les armures.

keys: A fencer's blade: lightning thrusts that find the weak spots.
en: A fencer's blade: lightning thrusts that find the weak spots.
fr: La lame du bretteur : des estocades éclair qui trouvent les points faibles.

keys: Very fast stabs. Critical hits come easily.
en: Very fast stabs. Critical hits come easily.
fr: Des coups d'estoc très rapides. Les coups critiques viennent facilement.

keys: Throwing stars, three at a time. The ninja's way.
en: Throwing stars, three at a time. The ninja's way.
fr: Des étoiles de lancer, trois à la fois. La voie du ninja.

keys: Ice shards that pierce a first enemy and chill what they hit.
en: Ice shards that pierce a first enemy and chill what they hit.
fr: Des éclats de glace qui transpercent un premier ennemi et glacent ce qu'ils touchent.

keys: The blessed blade of a templar whose order is long gone. Its skills are holy.
en: The blessed blade of a templar whose order is long gone. Its skills are holy.
fr: La lame bénie d'un templier dont l'ordre a disparu. Ses compétences sont sacrées.

keys: Long reach, thin and stinging. Keep them at a distance.
en: Long reach, thin and stinging. Keep them at a distance.
fr: Longue allonge, fin et cinglant. Garde-les à distance.

keys: The highest Nightmare ascension won, one entry per player, kept for good.
en: The highest Nightmare ascension won, one entry per player, kept for good.
fr: La plus haute ascension de Cauchemar remportée, une entrée par joueur, gardée pour toujours.

keys: The day's first toll only, one entry per player. The board starts anew at midnight (UTC).
en: The day's first toll only, one entry per player. The board starts anew at midnight (UTC).
fr: Seul le premier glas du jour, une entrée par joueur. Le classement repart de zéro à minuit (UTC).

keys: The deepest floor reached on Pilgrim, one entry per player, kept for good.
en: The deepest floor reached on Pilgrim, one entry per player, kept for good.
fr: L'étage le plus profond atteint en Pèlerin, une entrée par joueur, gardée pour toujours.

keys: The deepest floor reached on Martyr, one entry per player, kept for good.
en: The deepest floor reached on Martyr, one entry per player, kept for good.
fr: L'étage le plus profond atteint en Martyr, une entrée par joueur, gardée pour toujours.

keys: The deepest floor reached on Keeper, one entry per player, kept for good.
en: The deepest floor reached on Keeper, one entry per player, kept for good.
fr: L'étage le plus profond atteint en Veilleur, une entrée par joueur, gardée pour toujours.

keys: The fastest victory on Pilgrim, in-game time, one entry per player, kept for good.
en: The fastest victory on Pilgrim, in-game time, one entry per player, kept for good.
fr: La victoire la plus rapide en Pèlerin, en temps de jeu, une entrée par joueur, gardée pour toujours.

keys: The fastest victory on Martyr, in-game time, one entry per player, kept for good.
en: The fastest victory on Martyr, in-game time, one entry per player, kept for good.
fr: La victoire la plus rapide en Martyr, en temps de jeu, une entrée par joueur, gardée pour toujours.

keys: The fastest victory on Keeper, in-game time, one entry per player, kept for good.
en: The fastest victory on Keeper, in-game time, one entry per player, kept for good.
fr: La victoire la plus rapide en Veilleur, en temps de jeu, une entrée par joueur, gardée pour toujours.

keys: The most nights the seal was held, one entry per player, kept for good.
en: The most nights the seal was held, one entry per player, kept for good.
fr: Le plus de nuits à tenir le sceau, une entrée par joueur, gardée pour toujours.

keys: A dune hunter wearing the mask of a priest of Solhar. Charges from across the room.
en: A dune hunter wearing the mask of a priest of Solhar. Charges from across the room.
fr: Un chasseur des dunes qui porte le masque d'un prêtre de Solhar. Charge d'un bout à l'autre de la salle.

keys: They nested under the shrine's roof; now they nest in the Well's throat. Fragile, fast and erratic.
en: They nested under the shrine's roof; now they nest in the Well's throat. Fragile, fast and erratic.
fr: Elles nichaient sous le toit du sanctuaire ; elles nichent à présent dans la gorge du Puits. Fragiles, rapides et imprévisibles.

keys: A beast of burden of Solhar; the Well's breath grew its horns and took its mind. Huge: charges, then crushes.
en: A beast of burden of Solhar; the Well's breath grew its horns and took its mind. Huge: charges, then crushes.
fr: Une bête de somme de Solhar ; le souffle du Puits lui a fait pousser des cornes et perdre la raison. Énorme : charge, puis écrase.

keys: What drips off the Bloated King when it has eaten too much. Splits into two slimes when it dies.
en: What drips off the Bloated King when it has eaten too much. Splits into two slimes when it dies.
fr: Ce qui coule du Roi Boursouflé quand il a trop mangé. Se divise en deux gluants à sa mort.

keys: A sapper of Solhar's army, still besieging a city that fell centuries ago. Lobs bombs from afar: dodge the blast, then close in.
en: A sapper of Solhar's army, still besieging a city that fell centuries ago. Lobs bombs from afar: dodge the blast, then close in.
fr: Un sapeur de l'armée de Solhar, qui assiège encore une ville tombée depuis des siècles. Lance des bombes de loin : esquive l'explosion, puis rapproche-toi.

keys: It wears a skull of Solhar as its shell. Spits acid from afar.
en: It wears a skull of Solhar as its shell. Spits acid from afar.
fr: Il porte un crâne de Solhar en guise de coquille. Crache de l'acide à distance.

keys: She laid her eggs in the Ossuary's shrouds, and her brood never ends. Stays back and lays spiders: kill her first.
en: She laid her eggs in the Ossuary's shrouds, and her brood never ends. Stays back and lays spiders: kill her first.
fr: Elle a pondu dans les linceuls de l'Ossuaire, et sa couvée ne finit jamais. Reste en retrait et pond des araignées : abats-la en premier.

keys: A giant Solhar's priests kept in chains to carry wood to the pyres. Huge, slow, hits like a battering ram: watch the wind-up.
en: A giant Solhar's priests kept in chains to carry wood to the pyres. Huge, slow, hits like a battering ram: watch the wind-up.
fr: Un géant que les prêtres de Solhar tenaient enchaîné pour porter le bois des bûchers. Énorme, lent, frappe comme un bélier : surveille son élan.

keys: A drake hatched in the warm ash of the pyres. Breathes fire from a distance.
en: A drake hatched in the warm ash of the pyres. Breathes fire from a distance.
fr: Un dragonnet éclos dans la cendre tiède des bûchers. Crache du feu à distance.

keys: A war mount of Solhar's kings, buried in the sand with them. A sand-colored brute: charges across the room, then crushes.
en: A war mount of Solhar's kings, buried in the sand with them. A sand-colored brute: charges across the room, then crushes.
fr: Une monture de guerre des rois de Solhar, ensevelie avec eux. Une brute couleur de sable : charge à travers la salle, puis écrase.

keys: An offering's heart, still beating in the pyre's embers. It mends whoever fights beside it.
en: An offering's heart, still beating in the pyre's embers. It mends whoever fights beside it.
fr: Le cœur d'une offrande, qui bat encore dans les braises du bûcher. Il soigne quiconque combat à ses côtés.

keys: An eye that left its dead to go on watching. Floats at a distance and fires evil bolts.
en: An eye that left its dead to go on watching. Floats at a distance and fires evil bolts.
fr: Un œil qui a quitté son mort pour continuer de regarder. Flotte à distance et tire des traits maléfiques.

keys: What is left of an offering thrown to the pyres: a flame that never finishes burning. Burning touch, and it explodes when it dies.
en: What is left of an offering thrown to the pyres: a flame that never finishes burning. Burning touch, and it explodes when it dies.
fr: Ce qui reste d'une offrande jetée aux bûchers : une flamme qui ne finit jamais de brûler. Toucher brûlant, et il explose à sa mort.

keys: A skull that slept too near the Azure Wyrm, under the crypt. Bursts into ice when it dies: slows everything around.
en: A skull that slept too near the Azure Wyrm, under the crypt. Bursts into ice when it dies: slows everything around.
fr: Un crâne qui a dormi trop près de la Guivre d'Azur, sous la crypte. Éclate en glace à sa mort : ralentit tout alentour.

keys: A moth that drank the kingdom's gold until it turned to gold itself. Wraps its allies in golden wards.
en: A moth that drank the kingdom's gold until it turned to gold itself. Wraps its allies in golden wards.
fr: Une phalène qui a bu l'or du royaume jusqu'à en devenir. Enveloppe ses alliés de protections dorées.

keys: The king of Solhar's own thief, who brought him back every coin that fell. Takes far more gold than its cousins, and runs faster.
en: The king of Solhar's own thief, who brought him back every coin that fell. Takes far more gold than its cousins, and runs faster.
fr: Le voleur attitré du roi de Solhar, qui lui rapportait chaque pièce tombée. Prend bien plus d'or que ses cousins, et court plus vite.

keys: A kappa of Kagari's river, carried down by the water as far as the temple. It never found the way back. Its water jets slow you down.
en: A kappa of Kagari's river, carried down by the water as far as the temple. It never found the way back. Its water jets slow you down.
fr: Un kappa de la rivière de Kagari, que l'eau a emporté jusqu'au temple. Il n'a jamais retrouvé le chemin. Ses jets d'eau te ralentissent.

keys: A paper lantern of Kagari, put out on the moonless night. It lit itself again, with a flame that gives no warmth. Throws ghost flames and blinks around.
en: A paper lantern of Kagari, put out on the moonless night. It lit itself again, with a flame that gives no warmth. Throws ghost flames and blinks around.
fr: Une lanterne de papier de Kagari, éteinte la nuit sans lune. Elle s'est rallumée seule, d'une flamme qui ne réchauffe pas. Lance des flammes spectrales et se téléporte.

keys: It grew in the Well's still water and never became anything else. Spits acid from a distance.
en: It grew in the Well's still water and never became anything else. Spits acid from a distance.
fr: Elle a grandi dans l'eau dormante du Puits sans jamais devenir autre chose. Crache de l'acide à distance.

keys: It dug under Kagari's fields until the Well's breath made it bigger and meaner. Tough; burrows under you when you keep away.
en: It dug under Kagari's fields until the Well's breath made it bigger and meaner. Tough; burrows under you when you keep away.
fr: Il creusait sous les champs de Kagari, jusqu'à ce que le souffle du Puits le rende plus gros et plus hargneux. Coriace, il creuse sous toi quand tu restes à distance.

keys: The Well's moss drank the lanterns' dripping wax and began to beat like a heart. It mends the monsters around it: kill it first.
en: The Well's moss drank the lanterns' dripping wax and began to beat like a heart. It mends the monsters around it: kill it first.
fr: La mousse du Puits a bu la cire des lanternes et s'est mise à battre comme un cœur. Il soigne les monstres alentour : abats-le en premier.

keys: It grows on whatever falls down the Well, and much does. Slow; puffs a cloud of spores that slows and poisons.
en: It grows on whatever falls down the Well, and much does. Slow; puffs a cloud of spores that slows and poisons.
fr: Elle pousse sur tout ce qui tombe dans le Puits, et il en tombe beaucoup. Lente, elle souffle un nuage de spores qui ralentit et empoisonne.

keys: It lived in the temple's cisterns, and Solhar's scribes wrote with its ink. Fires ink bolts and rings of ink.
en: It lived in the temple's cisterns, and Solhar's scribes wrote with its ink. Fires ink bolts and rings of ink.
fr: Elle vivait dans les citernes du temple, et les scribes de Solhar écrivaient avec son encre. Tire des traits d'encre et des anneaux d'encre.

keys: It hunted over Kagari's graves, and followed the dead down the Well. Dives at you from afar: watch the wind-up.
en: It hunted over Kagari's graves, and followed the dead down the Well. Dives at you from afar: watch the wind-up.
fr: Elle chassait au-dessus des tombes de Kagari, et a suivi les morts dans le Puits. Fond sur toi de loin : surveille son élan.

keys: Kagari's rats followed the souls down the Well, and grew fat there. Fast and weak; they come in numbers.
en: Kagari's rats followed the souls down the Well, and grew fat there. Fast and weak; they come in numbers.
fr: Les rats de Kagari ont suivi les âmes dans le Puits, et ils y ont grossi. Rapides et faibles, ils arrivent en nombre.

keys: A viper of Solhar's deserts: the sand kept its heat, and so did its venom. Hides in the sand. Fast, and its bite burns with poison.
en: A viper of Solhar's deserts: the sand kept its heat, and so did its venom. Hides in the sand. Fast, and its bite burns with poison.
fr: Une vipère des déserts de Solhar : le sable a gardé sa chaleur, et son venin aussi. Se cache dans le sable. Rapide, et sa morsure brûle de poison.

keys: Lizardmen guarded the lower steps of Solhar's temple; they still guard, without knowing what. A warrior that charges across the room.
en: Lizardmen guarded the lower steps of Solhar's temple; they still guard, without knowing what. A warrior that charges across the room.
fr: Les hommes-lézards gardaient les marches basses du temple de Solhar ; ils gardent encore, sans savoir quoi. Un guerrier qui charge à travers la salle.

keys: A drake of Solhar's dunes. Breathes scouring sand that slows you, and whips up a sandstorm.
en: A drake of Solhar's dunes. Breathes scouring sand that slows you, and whips up a sandstorm.
fr: Un drake des dunes de Solhar. Crache un sable abrasif qui te ralentit, et soulève une tempête de sable.

keys: He beat the march for Solhar's armies, and still beats it for soldiers of dust. His war drum makes his allies hit harder and run faster.
en: He beat the march for Solhar's armies, and still beats it for soldiers of dust. His war drum makes his allies hit harder and run faster.
fr: Il battait la marche des armées de Solhar, et la bat encore pour des soldats de poussière. Son tambour de guerre fait frapper ses alliés plus fort et courir plus vite.

keys: An acolyte of Solhar who died at the foot of his pyre and still chants the rite. Casts hexes and mends itself and its allies.
en: An acolyte of Solhar who died at the foot of his pyre and still chants the rite. Casts hexes and mends itself and its allies.
fr: Un acolyte de Solhar, mort au pied de son bûcher, qui psalmodie encore le rite. Lance des maléfices et se soigne, lui et ses alliés.

keys: A beast of the spring, its shell hardened by centuries of cold water. Blows from the front barely scratch it: get behind it.
en: A beast of the spring, its shell hardened by centuries of cold water. Blows from the front barely scratch it: get behind it.
fr: Une bête de la source, à la carapace durcie par des siècles d'eau froide. Les coups de face l'égratignent à peine : passe derrière lui.

keys: One of the Ossuary's dead, risen from his niche. They laid him down with his blade; it rusted, he did not.
en: One of the Ossuary's dead, risen from his niche. They laid him down with his blade; it rusted, he did not.
fr: Un mort de l'Ossuaire, relevé de sa niche. On l'avait couché avec sa lame : elle a rouillé, pas lui.

keys: The Ossuary's skulls lost their niches and their names; they fly about looking for them. Fast and fragile, they come in swarms.
en: The Ossuary's skulls lost their niches and their names; they fly about looking for them. Fast and fragile, they come in swarms.
fr: Les crânes de l'Ossuaire ont perdu leurs niches et leurs noms ; ils les cherchent en volant. Rapides et fragiles, ils arrivent en nuées.

keys: A drop broken off the Bloated King, that learned to crawl on its own. Slow, tough, hits all around itself.
en: A drop broken off the Bloated King, that learned to crawl on its own. Slow, tough, hits all around itself.
fr: Une goutte détachée du Roi Boursouflé, qui a appris à ramper seule. Lent, coriace, il frappe tout autour de lui.

keys: A viper of Kagari's rice fields that came down to the cool and never went back up. Fast, and its bite is poisoned.
en: A viper of Kagari's rice fields that came down to the cool and never went back up. Fast, and its bite is poisoned.
fr: Une vipère des rizières de Kagari, descendue au frais et jamais remontée. Rapide, et sa morsure est empoisonnée.

keys: In the Hushed Archive he read a book that should not be read, and stayed between its pages. Keeps his distance and throws shadow bolts.
en: In the Hushed Archive he read a book that should not be read, and stayed between its pages. Keeps his distance and throws shadow bolts.
fr: Dans les Archives Muettes, il a lu un livre qu'il ne fallait pas lire, et il est resté entre les pages. Garde ses distances et lance des traits d'ombre.

keys: It circled the Ossuary's candles; now it circles souls. Wraps its allies in wards that soak up your blows.
en: It circled the Ossuary's candles; now it circles souls. Wraps its allies in wards that soak up your blows.
fr: Elle tournait autour des cierges de l'Ossuaire ; à présent, elle tourne autour des âmes. Enveloppe ses alliés de protections qui absorbent tes coups.

keys: They spun in the well's beams, back when water was still drawn from it. Skitters in fast; nasty bite.
en: They spun in the well's beams, back when water was still drawn from it. Skitters in fast; nasty bite.
fr: Elles tissaient dans les poutres du puits, du temps où l'on y puisait encore. Accourt à toute vitesse ; morsure vicieuse.

keys: A soul the Well kept too long: it forgot its body, not its anger. It blinks towards you out of nowhere.
en: A soul the Well kept too long: it forgot its body, not its anger. It blinks towards you out of nowhere.
fr: Une âme que le Puits a gardée trop longtemps : elle a oublié son corps, pas sa colère. Elle surgit de nulle part et fond sur toi.

keys: It has burrowed under the Sandchoked City since the fall, until the rock armored it. Burrows under you when you keep away.
en: It has burrowed under the Sandchoked City since the fall, until the rock armored it. Burrows under you when you keep away.
fr: Elle creuse sous la Cité Ensablée depuis la chute, et la roche a fini par la cuirasser. Creuse sous toi quand tu restes à distance.

keys: It already stole the shrine's offerings; down the Well it found a taste for gold. Snatches your gold and runs: catch it to get it back, with interest.
en: It already stole the shrine's offerings; down the Well it found a taste for gold. Snatches your gold and runs: catch it to get it back, with interest.
fr: Il volait déjà les offrandes du sanctuaire ; dans le Puits, il a pris goût à l'or. Te dérobe ton or et s'enfuit : attrape-le pour le récupérer, avec les intérêts.

keys: Long ago the Well ate a whole people; it kept their eyes. It opens in the dark and does not blink.
en: Long ago the Well ate a whole people; it kept their eyes. It opens in the dark and does not blink.
fr: Il y a longtemps, le Puits a mangé tout un peuple ; il en a gardé les yeux. Il s'ouvre dans le noir et ne cille jamais.

keys: Heals from the wounds it gives.
en: Heals from the wounds it gives.
fr: Se soigne des blessures qu'il inflige.

keys: An eaten soul with nothing left but thirst. Pale and thirsty: every wound it gives, it drinks.
en: An eaten soul with nothing left but thirst. Pale and thirsty: every wound it gives, it drinks.
fr: Une âme mangée à qui il ne reste que la soif. Pâle et assoiffé : chaque blessure qu'il ouvre, il la boit.

keys: The Deeps keep one sentinel at the way out, a soldier the hunger below has chewed. It does not let go of what it catches.
en: The Deeps keep one sentinel at the way out, a soldier the hunger below has chewed. It does not let go of what it catches.
fr: Les Tréfonds gardent une sentinelle à la sortie, un soldat que la faim du fond a mâché. Ce qu'elle attrape, elle ne le lâche pas.

keys: A soul the hunger burnt down to its embers. It spits them.
en: A soul the hunger burnt down to its embers. It spits them.
fr: Une âme que la faim a consumée jusqu'aux braises. Elle les crache.

keys: A seer of a swallowed kingdom, still reading the dark aloud: its words come as shadow bolts.
en: A seer of a swallowed kingdom, still reading the dark aloud: its words come as shadow bolts.
fr: Un devin d'un royaume englouti, qui lit encore l'obscurité à voix haute : ses mots tombent en traits d'ombre.

keys: Bones under a demon's horns: what the hunger leaves of a man. Quick as a cut.
en: Bones under a demon's horns: what the hunger leaves of a man. Quick as a cut.
fr: Des os sous des cornes de démon : ce que la faim laisse d'un homme. Vifs comme une entaille.

keys: A horned brute of the Deeps; the hunger chewed it and never finished. Its club knocks the breath out of you.
en: A horned brute of the Deeps; the hunger chewed it and never finished. Its club knocks the breath out of you.
fr: Une brute cornue des Tréfonds ; la faim l'a mâchée sans jamais finir. Sa massue te coupe le souffle.

keys: A shade that kept its blade when the hunger took the rest. It steps through the dark.
en: A shade that kept its blade when the hunger took the rest. It steps through the dark.
fr: Une ombre qui a gardé sa lame quand la faim a pris le reste. Elle passe au travers du noir.

keys: Shatter the Azure Wyrm with a Hammer
en: Shatter the Azure Wyrm with a Hammer
fr: Brise la Guivre d'Azur au Marteau

keys: If you accept, at the end of each run, or when it is left or the app is closed, the game sends a summary of it: your build (weapons, armor, skills and their damage), potions, dodges, the cause and floor of your death, perks offered and picked, in-game purchases, boss fights, the kind of controls you use, plus the game version, the system and the screen size. It is linked to the random ID of this device, never to your name. Your runs also add to the world counters every player sees (the Well's Toll: monsters slain, wardens defeated, deaths, floors, potions, endings, Dawn Knells, souls offered), sent at the same moments: your own totals are kept with the same random ID, and only the sums of all players are shown. While the game is open, it also keeps a connection to Talo, so Talo records when each play session starts and ends and shows you as online; it closes when the app goes to the background. Why: to balance the game, fix its bugs, show the world counters and count play sessions and players online. keys: Burning enemies take 20% more damage per level.
en: Burning enemies take 20% more damage per level.
fr: Les ennemis en feu subissent 20 % de Dégâts en plus par niveau.

keys: Your first blow on an unhurt enemy is always a critical hit.
en: Your first blow on an unhurt enemy is always a critical hit.
fr: Ton premier coup sur un ennemi indemne est toujours un coup critique.

keys: Rolling releases a shockwave that hurts and pushes enemies away.
en: Rolling releases a shockwave that hurts and pushes enemies away.
fr: Ta roulade libère une onde de choc qui blesse et repousse les ennemis.

keys: For 1.5 s after a roll, your hits deal 25% more per level.
en: For 1.5 s after a roll, your hits deal 25% more per level.
fr: Pendant 1,5 s après une roulade, tes coups infligent 25 % de plus par niveau.

keys: Enemies that hit you up close take 4 damage per level and catch fire.
en: Enemies that hit you up close take 4 damage per level and catch fire.
fr: Les ennemis qui te frappent au corps à corps subissent 4 Dégâts par niveau et prennent feu.

keys: Critical hits release a shockwave that hurts the enemies around the target.
en: Critical hits release a shockwave that hurts the enemies around the target.
fr: Les coups critiques libèrent une onde de choc qui blesse les ennemis autour de la cible.

keys: Slaying an enemy heals 3 Health per level (summoned monsters don't count).
en: Slaying an enemy heals 3 Health per level (summoned monsters don't count).
fr: Abattre un ennemi rend 3 de Vie par niveau (les monstres invoqués ne comptent pas).

keys: +75% damage per level against enemies below 35% Health.
en: +75% damage per level against enemies below 35% Health.
fr: +75 % de Dégâts par niveau contre les ennemis sous 35 % de Vie.

keys: Every floor starts with a shell of frost that soaks up 20 damage.
en: Every floor starts with a shell of frost that soaks up 20 damage.
fr: Chaque étage commence avec une carapace de givre qui absorbe 20 Dégâts.

keys: Everything you shoot fires 1 more projectile per level, fireballs included (2 more at most with Prism runes; the volley shares its damage).
en: Everything you shoot fires 1 more projectile per level, fireballs included (2 more at most with Prism runes; the volley shares its damage).
fr: Tout ce que tu tires part avec 1 projectile de plus par niveau, boules de feu comprises (2 de plus au maximum avec les runes Prisme ; la salve partage ses Dégâts).

keys: Once per level, a killing blow sends you to the Threshold: slay 8 foes in 25 s (more in later acts) to return where you fell, at half Health (a quarter in a boss fight).
en: Once per level, a killing blow sends you to the Threshold: slay 8 foes in 25 s (more in later acts) to return where you fell, at half Health (a quarter in a boss fight).
fr: Une fois par niveau, un coup fatal t'envoie au Seuil : abats 8 ennemis en 25 s (plus aux actes suivants) pour revenir où tu es tombé, à la moitié de ta Vie (un quart en combat de boss).

keys: Using a skill also fires a ring of 8 arcane bolts.
en: Using a skill also fires a ring of 8 arcane bolts.
fr: Utiliser une compétence tire aussi un anneau de 8 traits arcaniques.

keys: Below half Health you deal 40% more damage, and every kill heals 4% of your max Health.
en: Below half Health you deal 40% more damage, and every kill heals 4% of your max Health.
fr: Sous la moitié de ta Vie, tu infliges 40 % de Dégâts en plus, et chaque ennemi abattu rend 4 % de ta Vie max.

keys: Slowed enemies take 50% more damage, and critical hits freeze them solid for a moment.
en: Slowed enemies take 50% more damage, and critical hits freeze them solid for a moment.
fr: Les ennemis ralentis subissent 50 % de Dégâts en plus, et les coups critiques les figent dans la glace un instant.

keys: Enemies that die burning explode, setting everything around them on fire.
en: Enemies that die burning explode, setting everything around them on fire.
fr: Les ennemis qui meurent en brûlant explosent et embrasent tout autour d'eux.

keys: Your attacks are 15% faster, and every 3rd hit, lightning jumps to up to 3 enemies nearby.
en: Your attacks are 15% faster, and every 3rd hit, lightning jumps to up to 3 enemies nearby.
fr: Tes attaques sont 15 % plus rapides, et tous les 3 coups, un éclair bondit sur jusqu'à 3 ennemis proches.

keys: Hits have a 50% chance to set enemies on fire.
en: Hits have a 50% chance to set enemies on fire.
fr: Les coups ont 50 % de chances d'enflammer les ennemis.

keys: Below half Health, +30% damage; every kill heals 2% of your max Health.
en: Below half Health, +30% damage; every kill heals 2% of your max Health.
fr: Sous la moitié de ta Vie, +30 % de Dégâts ; chaque ennemi abattu rend 2 % de ta Vie max.

keys: Your roll releases a gust that hurts and throws enemies back.
en: Your roll releases a gust that hurts and throws enemies back.
fr: Ta roulade libère une rafale qui blesse et repousse les ennemis.

keys: Your hits heal 10% of the damage they deal (burns and side effects don't).
en: Your hits heal 10% of the damage they deal (burns and side effects don't).
fr: Tes coups te soignent de 10 % des Dégâts infligés (pas les brûlures ni les effets secondaires).

keys: Your shots and spells fire one more projectile (2 more at most with the Hydra's Quiver; the volley shares its damage).
en: Your shots and spells fire one more projectile (2 more at most with the Hydra's Quiver; the volley shares its damage).
fr: Tes tirs et tes sorts lancent un projectile de plus (2 de plus au maximum avec le Carquois de l'Hydre ; la salve partage ses Dégâts).

keys: Enemies that die burning burst into flames around them.
en: Enemies that die burning burst into flames around them.
fr: Les ennemis qui meurent en brûlant s'embrasent et enflamment leurs voisins.

keys: Hits chill enemies: 20% slower for 2 s.
en: Hits chill enemies: 20% slower for 2 s.
fr: Les coups glacent les ennemis : 20 % plus lents pendant 2 s.

keys: Critical hits release a frost shockwave that hurts the enemies around the target and slows them by 40%.
en: Critical hits release a frost shockwave that hurts the enemies around the target and slows them by 40%.
fr: Les coups critiques libèrent une onde de givre qui blesse les ennemis autour de la cible et les ralentit de 40 %.

keys: Every 3rd hit, lightning jumps to 2 enemies.
en: Every 3rd hit, lightning jumps to 2 enemies.
fr: Tous les 3 coups, un éclair bondit sur 2 ennemis.

keys: Under the Ossuary lie the dead nobody named. One of them never lay down.
en: Under the Ossuary lie the dead nobody named. One of them never lay down.
fr: Sous l'Ossuaire gisent les morts que nul n'a nommés. L'un d'eux ne s'est jamais couché.

keys: I sell what the Well's victims left behind. No refunds.
en: I sell what the Well's victims left behind. No refunds.
fr: Je vends ce que les victimes du Puits ont laissé derrière elles. Ni repris, ni échangé.

keys: Gold is useless down here. I keep it for the faces on it.
en: Gold is useless down here. I keep it for the faces on it.
fr: L'or ne sert à rien ici-bas. Je le garde pour les visages dessus.

keys: Still alive? Good. Dead people don't buy much.
en: Still alive? Good. Dead people don't buy much.
fr: Toujours en vie ? Tant mieux. Les morts n'achètent pas grand-chose.

keys: The wardens never come to this room. I wonder why.
en: The wardens never come to this room. I wonder why.
fr: Les gardiens ne viennent jamais dans cette salle. Je me demande pourquoi.

keys: Health, Armor, healing: flesh that endures.
en: Health, Armor, healing: flesh that endures.
fr: Vie, Armure, soins : une chair qui endure.

keys: Damage, critical hits, speed: a blade that bites.
en: Damage, critical hits, speed: a blade that bites.
fr: Dégâts, coups critiques, vitesse : une lame qui mord.
Compétences, sorts, grimoires : les mots interdits.

keys: Gold, loot, the merchant, perk choices: a hunger that finds.
en: Gold, loot, the merchant, perk choices: a hunger that finds.
fr: Or, butin, marchand, choix d'atouts : une faim qui trouve.

keys: Lunges along a line, coils and all.
en: Lunges along a line, coils and all.
fr: Fond en ligne droite, anneaux compris.

keys: A fan of ice shards: they slow.
en: A fan of ice shards: they slow.
fr: Un éventail d'éclats de glace : ils ralentissent.

keys: Two fans of ice, one after the other.
en: Two fans of ice, one after the other.
fr: Deux éventails de glace, l'un après l'autre.

keys: Dives along a line and throws back what it touches.
en: Dives along a line and throws back what it touches.
fr: Plonge en ligne droite et repousse ce qu'il touche.

keys: Ice bursts out all around it.
en: Ice bursts out all around it.
fr: La glace jaillit tout autour de lui.

keys: Two bursts of ice, the second between the gaps.
en: Two bursts of ice, the second between the gaps.
fr: Deux salves de glace, la seconde dans les trous de la première.

keys: A ring of sand bursts out of it: it slows.
en: A ring of sand bursts out of it: it slows.
fr: Un anneau de sable jaillit de lui : il ralentit.

keys: A ring of venom bursts all around it.
en: A ring of venom bursts all around it.
fr: Un anneau de venin jaillit tout autour de lui.

keys: Two rings of venom, the second between the gaps.
en: Two rings of venom, the second between the gaps.
fr: Deux anneaux de venin, le second dans les trous du premier.

keys: A fan of venom: it poisons.
en: A fan of venom: it poisons.
fr: Un éventail de venin : il empoisonne.

keys: Two fans of venom, one after the other.
en: Two fans of venom, one after the other.
fr: Deux éventails de venin, l'un après l'autre.

keys: A full spin that hits everything around you.
en: A full spin that hits everything around you.
fr: Un tour complet qui frappe tout autour de toi.

keys: A lunge that cuts all in its way, then a wide sweep.
en: A lunge that cuts all in its way, then a wide sweep.
fr: Une fente qui tranche tout sur son passage, puis un large balayage.

keys: A great fireball that explodes and sets enemies on fire.
en: A great fireball that explodes and sets enemies on fire.
fr: Une grande boule de feu qui explose et embrase les ennemis.

keys: A heavy arrow that runs through every enemy in its path.
en: A heavy arrow that runs through every enemy in its path.
fr: Une flèche lourde qui transperce chaque ennemi sur sa route.

keys: Slam the ground in front of you: the shockwave hurls enemies away.
en: Slam the ground in front of you: the shockwave hurls enemies away.
fr: Frappe le sol devant toi : l'onde de choc projette les ennemis.

keys: A wide double crescent in front of you.
en: A wide double crescent in front of you.
fr: Un large double croissant devant toi.

keys: A long thrust that runs through every enemy in line, without moving.
en: A long thrust that runs through every enemy in line, without moving.
fr: Un long coup d'estoc qui transperce chaque ennemi aligné, sans bouger.

keys: A bolt strikes the closest enemy ahead, then leaps to three more.
en: A bolt strikes the closest enemy ahead, then leaps to three more.
fr: Un éclair frappe l'ennemi le plus proche devant toi, puis bondit sur trois autres.

keys: Two crossing cuts in front of you.
en: Two crossing cuts in front of you.

keys: Split the ground in front of you: it bursts in rubble.
en: Split the ground in front of you: it bursts in rubble.
fr: Fends le sol devant toi : il éclate en gravats.

keys: A short lunge that runs through every enemy in line.
en: A short lunge that runs through every enemy in line.
fr: Une courte fente qui transperce chaque ennemi aligné.

keys: Three quick stabs in front of you, the last one harder.
en: Three quick stabs in front of you, the last one harder.
fr: Trois coups rapides devant toi, le dernier plus fort.

keys: A fan of seven stars that pierce a first enemy.
en: A fan of seven stars that pierce a first enemy.
fr: Un éventail de sept étoiles qui transpercent un premier ennemi.

keys: A great ice shard that shatters into a frost nova: enemies around are slowed.
en: A great ice shard that shatters into a frost nova: enemies around are slowed.
fr: Un grand éclat de glace qui se brise en nova de givre : les ennemis autour sont ralentis.

keys: A wide blessed crescent in front of you.
en: A wide blessed crescent in front of you.
fr: Un large croissant béni devant toi.

keys: A long crack of the whip, far in front of you.
en: A long crack of the whip, far in front of you.
fr: Un long claquement de fouet, loin devant toi.

keys: Mends the shaman and its allies around it.
en: Mends the shaman and its allies around it.
fr: Soigne le chaman et ses alliés alentour.

keys: A slow, heavy bolt that goes through four enemies.
en: A slow, heavy bolt that goes through four enemies.
fr: Un trait lent et lourd qui transperce quatre ennemis.

keys: Arrows fall on the area ahead, four times.
en: Arrows fall on the area ahead, four times.
fr: Des flèches s'abattent quatre fois sur la zone devant toi.

keys: +4 Damage and attacks 25% faster for 6 s.
en: +4 Damage and attacks 25% faster for 6 s.
fr: +4 Dégâts et attaques 25 % plus rapides pendant 6 s.

keys: Teleport-dash a long way toward your target.
en: Teleport-dash a long way toward your target.
fr: Une ruée téléportée sur une longue distance vers ta cible.

keys: A huge swing in front of you.
en: A huge swing in front of you.
fr: Un immense coup de taille devant toi.

keys: Quick invulnerable roll in the direction you move.
en: Quick invulnerable roll in the direction you move.
fr: Une roulade rapide et invulnérable dans la direction où tu vas.

keys: Dash forward and cut everything on the way.
en: Dash forward and cut everything on the way.
fr: Fonce en avant et tranche tout sur ton passage.

keys: A wide fan of embers that set enemies on fire.
en: A wide fan of embers that set enemies on fire.
fr: Un large éventail de braises qui enflamment les ennemis.

keys: A crack runs forward, rock spikes bursting along it.
en: A crack runs forward, rock spikes bursting along it.
fr: Une faille court droit devant, hérissée de pics de roche.

keys: Three lightning-fast stabs in front of you.
en: Three lightning-fast stabs in front of you.
fr: Trois coups d'estoc fulgurants devant toi.

keys: Freezing burst around you: enemies are slowed.
en: Freezing burst around you: enemies are slowed.
fr: Une déflagration glaciale autour de toi : les ennemis sont ralentis.

keys: Rock spikes burst all around you.
en: Rock spikes burst all around you.
fr: Des pics de roche jaillissent tout autour de toi.

keys: Heals 30% of your Health (half during a boss fight) and burns the enemies around you.
en: Heals 30% of your Health (half during a boss fight) and burns the enemies around you.
fr: Rend 30 % de ta Vie (moitié moins pendant un combat de boss) et brûle les ennemis autour de toi.

keys: +6 Armor for 5 s and heals 8% of your Health (half during a boss fight).
en: +6 Armor for 5 s and heals 8% of your Health (half during a boss fight).
fr: +6 Armure pendant 5 s et rend 8 % de ta Vie (moitié moins pendant un combat de boss).

keys: A fan of ice shards that slow what they hit.
en: A fan of ice shards that slow what they hit.
fr: Un éventail d'éclats de glace qui ralentissent ce qu'ils touchent.

keys: Throw five kunai in a fan.
en: Throw five kunai in a fan.

keys: Crack the whip all around you, hurling enemies away.
en: Crack the whip all around you, hurling enemies away.
fr: Fais claquer le fouet tout autour de toi et projette les ennemis au loin.

keys: A long lunge that runs through every enemy in line.
en: A long lunge that runs through every enemy in line.
fr: Une longue fente qui transperce tous les ennemis alignés.

keys: Leap back, then strike faster and deadlier for 3 s.
en: Leap back, then strike faster and deadlier for 3 s.
fr: Bondis en arrière, puis frappe plus vite et plus fort pendant 3 s.

keys: Rock spikes burst from the ground in front of you.
en: Rock spikes burst from the ground in front of you.
fr: Des pics de roche jaillissent du sol devant toi.

keys: Leap back and throw three kunai.
en: Leap back and throw three kunai.
fr: Bondis en arrière et lance trois kunaïs.

keys: Sixteen shuriken fly out all around you.
en: Sixteen shuriken fly out all around you.
fr: Seize shurikens volent tout autour de toi.

keys: Holy strike in front of you that also heals you a little (less during a boss fight).
en: Holy strike in front of you that also heals you a little (less during a boss fight).
fr: Une frappe sacrée devant toi qui te soigne aussi un peu (moins pendant un combat de boss).

keys: A ring of sparks flies out in every direction.
en: A ring of sparks flies out in every direction.
fr: Un anneau d'étincelles jaillit dans toutes les directions.

keys: Throws a spear that goes through three enemies.
en: Throws a spear that goes through three enemies.
fr: Lance un javelot qui transperce trois ennemis.

keys: A crushing blow that bursts the ground in front of you.
en: A crushing blow that bursts the ground in front of you.
fr: Un coup écrasant qui fait éclater le sol devant toi.
Décoche cinq flèches à la fois.

keys: Hits every enemy around you and pushes them away.
en: Hits every enemy around you and pushes them away.
fr: Frappe tous les ennemis autour de toi et les repousse.

keys: Below the kingdom of dust, the stone ends. Someone kneels in the dark, an unlit lantern in his hand.
en: Below the kingdom of dust, the stone ends. Someone kneels in the dark, an unlit lantern in his hand.
fr: Sous le royaume de poussière, la pierre s'arrête. Quelqu'un est agenouillé dans le noir, une lanterne éteinte à la main.

keys: The mask is dust. Your master stands in the dark, free, and looks at the lantern in your hand. Far above, the bell waits.
en: The mask is dust. Your master stands in the dark, free, and looks at the lantern in your hand. Far above, the bell waits.
fr: Le masque n'est plus que poussière. Ton maître se tient dans le noir, libre, et regarde la lanterne dans ta main. Loin là-haut, la cloche attend.

keys: His lantern rolls on the stone. The one who held it stands in the dark, free, and looks at you. Far above, the bell waits.
en: His lantern rolls on the stone. The one who held it stands in the dark, free, and looks at you. Far above, the bell waits.
fr: Sa lanterne roule sur la pierre. Celui qui la tenait se tient dans le noir, libre, et te regarde. Loin là-haut, la cloche attend.

keys:
Beneath the village of Kagari sleeps an old well.
The shrine's lantern keeps watch over it, night and day.
The elders say it has no bottom: only a mouth.
en:
Beneath the village of Kagari sleeps an old well.
The shrine's lantern keeps watch over it, night and day.
The elders say it has no bottom: only a mouth.
fr:
Sous le village de Kagari dort un vieux puits.
La lanterne du sanctuaire veille sur lui.
On dit qu'il n'a pas de fond : rien qu'une gueule.

keys:
On a moonless night, the Well woke.
A cold breath, and every flame lay down.
At dawn Kagari slept, and would not wake.
en:
On a moonless night, the Well woke.
A cold breath, and every flame lay down.
At dawn Kagari slept, and would not wake.
fr:
Par une nuit sans lune, le Puits s'est éveillé.
Un souffle glacé, et chaque flamme s'est couchée.
À l'aube, Kagari dormait, sans plus s'éveiller.

keys: Their souls were gone: drawn down the Well, where the dead things feed.
en: Their souls were gone: drawn down the Well, where the dead things feed.
fr: Leurs âmes n'étaient plus là : aspirées au fond du Puits, là où les choses mortes se repaissent.

keys:
Only you were spared, the keeper's pupil,
the shrine's lantern burning in your hand.
Of your master, there was no trace.
en:
Only you were spared, the keeper's pupil,
the shrine's lantern burning in your hand.
Of your master, there was no trace.
fr:
Toi seul as été épargné, disciple du gardien,
la lanterne du sanctuaire à la main.
De ton maître, il ne restait aucune trace.

keys:
Dead things keep the stolen souls,
each one deeper than the last,
chained there by a hand no one saw.
en:
Dead things keep the stolen souls,
each one deeper than the last,
chained there by a hand no one saw.
fr:
Des choses mortes gardent les âmes volées,
chacune plus profond que la précédente,
enchaînées là par une main que nul n'a vue.

keys:
Take up the lantern. Descend.
Every soul you bring back, the shrine turns into strength.
Steel, sorcery or faith: become what the dark demands.
en:
Take up the lantern. Descend.
Every soul you bring back, the shrine turns into strength.
Steel, sorcery or faith: become what the dark demands.
fr:
Prends la lanterne. Descends.
Le sanctuaire fait de chaque âme une force.
Acier, sorts ou foi : deviens ce que l'ombre exige.

keys:
The last warden falls. Its hoard of stolen souls breaks open,
and a river of light rises toward Kagari. The bell rings; the village wakes.
But the Well goes deeper still...
en:
The last warden falls. Its hoard of stolen souls breaks open,
and a river of light rises toward Kagari. The bell rings; the village wakes.
But the Well goes deeper still...
fr:
Le dernier gardien s'effondre. Son trésor d'âmes volées se brise,
et un fleuve de lumière remonte vers Kagari. La cloche sonne ; le village s'éveille.
Mais le Puits descend plus profond encore...

keys: Your soul joins the others, deep in the Well.
en: Your soul joins the others, deep in the Well.
fr: Ton âme rejoint les autres, au fond du Puits.

keys: The lantern goes out... for now.
en: The lantern goes out... for now.
fr: La lanterne s'éteint... pour cette fois.

keys: The Well keeps you tonight. The shrine remembers the souls you brought back.
en: The Well keeps you tonight. The shrine remembers the souls you brought back.
fr: Le Puits te garde cette nuit. Le sanctuaire se souvient des âmes que tu as ramenées.

keys: Darkness. Then the shrine's bell, far above. Again.
en: Darkness. Then the shrine's bell, far above. Again.
fr: Les ténèbres. Puis la cloche du sanctuaire, loin là-haut. Encore une fois.

keys: The souls you brought back from the Well lend you their strength.
en: The souls you brought back from the Well lend you their strength.
fr: Les âmes que tu as ramenées du Puits te prêtent leur force.

keys: Only fire reminds her of the sky she left.
en: Only fire reminds her of the sky she left.
fr: Seul le feu lui rappelle le ciel qu'elle a quitté.

keys: Finish her with fire: a burning weapon or a burn.
en: Finish her with fire: a burning weapon or a burn.
fr: Achève-la par le feu : une arme ardente ou une brûlure.

keys: An ice wyrm, as long as a street. Wherever she passes, the stone grows rime.
en: An ice wyrm, as long as a street. Wherever she passes, the stone grows rime.
fr: Une guivre de glace, longue comme une rue. Là où elle passe, la pierre se couvre de givre.

keys: Her eyes are still heavy with sleep.
en: Her eyes are still heavy with sleep.
fr: Ses yeux sont encore lourds de sommeil.

keys: She slept under Kagari's crypt for longer than the village has stood. Her breath kept the dead from rotting.
en: She slept under Kagari's crypt for longer than the village has stood. Her breath kept the dead from rotting.
fr: Elle dormait sous la crypte de Kagari depuis plus longtemps que le village. Son souffle gardait les morts de la pourriture.

keys: The old folk called her the Winter Sleeper, and left cold rice on the steps for her.
en: The old folk called her the Winter Sleeper, and left cold rice on the steps for her.
fr: Les vieux l'appelaient la Dormeuse d'Hiver, et posaient du riz froid sur les marches pour elle.

keys: In her sleep she flew under a sky. She counted the snowflakes.
en: In her sleep she flew under a sky. She counted the snowflakes.
fr: Dans son sommeil, elle volait sous un ciel. Elle comptait les flocons.

keys: She had a sister with green scales, who loved warmth. One day the sister went down toward the fire.
en: She had a sister with green scales, who loved warmth. One day the sister went down toward the fire.
fr: Elle avait une sœur aux écailles vertes, qui aimait la chaleur. Un jour, la sœur est descendue vers le feu.

keys: The Azure Wyrm stayed with the dead, in the cold. They never said goodbye.
en: The Azure Wyrm stayed with the dead, in the cold. They never said goodbye.
fr: La Guivre d'Azur est restée avec les morts, au froid. Elles ne se sont jamais dit adieu.

keys: On the moonless night a cold breath rose from the bottom and passed through every house. It was not hers.
en: On the moonless night a cold breath rose from the bottom and passed through every house. It was not hers.
fr: La nuit sans lune, un souffle froid est monté du fond et a traversé chaque maison. Ce n'était pas le sien.

keys: It came from lower down, and it was hungry. It woke her as it passed.
en: It came from lower down, and it was hungry. It woke her as it passed.
fr: Il venait de plus bas, et il avait faim. Il l'a réveillée en passant.

keys: She opened her eyes. Every flame in Kagari was already dead.
en: She opened her eyes. Every flame in Kagari was already dead.
fr: Elle a ouvert les yeux. Toutes les flammes de Kagari étaient déjà mortes.

keys: The keeper found her awake and trembling. He carried chains of a steel frost cannot bite, forged by a foreign hand.
en: The keeper found her awake and trembling. He carried chains of a steel frost cannot bite, forged by a foreign hand.
fr: Le gardien l'a trouvée éveillée et tremblante. Il portait des chaînes d'un acier que le givre ne mord pas, forgées par une main étrangère.

keys: "Sleep if you will. But keep these until I come back."
en: "Sleep if you will. But keep these until I come back."
fr: « Dors si tu veux. Mais garde ceux-ci jusqu'à mon retour. »

keys: She keeps the souls he left her. She no longer sleeps.
en: She keeps the souls he left her. She no longer sleeps.
fr: Elle garde les âmes qu'il lui a laissées. Elle ne dort plus.

keys: She knows that cold breath now: it is the bottom drawing breath. It sucks in everything warm.
en: She knows that cold breath now: it is the bottom drawing breath. It sucks in everything warm.
fr: Ce souffle froid, elle le connaît maintenant : c'est le fond qui inspire. Il aspire tout ce qui est tiède.

keys: One day it will breathe out. That day there will be no winter, no flame, nothing left to keep.
en: One day it will breathe out. That day there will be no winter, no flame, nothing left to keep.
fr: Un jour, il expirera. Ce jour-là, il n'y aura plus d'hiver, plus de flamme, plus rien à garder.

keys: She fights off sleep to be there when it comes.
en: She fights off sleep to be there when it comes.
fr: Elle lutte contre le sommeil pour être là quand il viendra.

keys: You read what they wrote about me... It is so cold. Is there still a sky?
en: You read what they wrote about me... It is so cold. Is there still a sky?
fr: Tu as lu ce qu'ils écrivaient sur moi... Il fait si froid. Y a-t-il encore un ciel ?

keys: Tôma. His hands shook more than I did, holding the chains.
en: Tôma. His hands shook more than I did, holding the chains.
