fr: Tôma. Ses mains tremblaient plus que moi, sur les chaînes.

keys: The pyre only accepts what does not heal.
en: The pyre only accepts what does not heal.
fr: Le bûcher n'accepte que ce qui ne guérit pas.

keys: Slay him without healing at all during the fight.
en: Slay him without healing at all during the fight.
fr: Terrasse-le sans te soigner de tout le combat.

keys: A crow-man in a scarlet mask, his feathers cut into blades. He sweeps the ash before he fights.
en: A crow-man in a scarlet mask, his feathers cut into blades. He sweeps the ash before he fights.
fr: Un homme-corbeau au masque écarlate, les plumes taillées en lames. Il balaie la cendre avant de se battre.

keys: He greets you as one greets a worshipper who came late.
en: He greets you as one greets a worshipper who came late.
fr: Il te salue comme on salue un fidèle en retard.

keys: He was a tengu of the mountains above Kagari, proud and swift. He flew higher than the bells.
en: He was a tengu of the mountains above Kagari, proud and swift. He flew higher than the bells.
fr: Il était tengu des montagnes au-dessus de Kagari, fier et rapide. Il volait plus haut que les cloches.

keys: One winter he dove into the Well to catch a falling feather. His wings burned in the dark.
en: One winter he dove into the Well to catch a falling feather. His wings burned in the dark.
fr: Un hiver, il a plongé dans le Puits pour rattraper une plume. Ses ailes ont brûlé dans le noir.

keys: Below, he found a temple whose pyres were still burning.
en: Below, he found a temple whose pyres were still burning.
fr: En bas, il a trouvé un temple dont les bûchers brûlaient encore.

keys: The Blade That Does Not Kneel
en: The Blade That Does Not Kneel
fr: La lame qui ne s'agenouille pas

keys: A guard in burning armor sometimes passes his pyres. He never kneels.
en: A guard in burning armor sometimes passes his pyres. He never kneels.
fr: Un garde en armure brûlante passe parfois devant ses bûchers. Il ne s'agenouille jamais.

keys: The Tengu despises him. He envies him too: that guard once knew how to say no.
en: The Tengu despises him. He envies him too: that guard once knew how to say no.
fr: Le Tengu le méprise. Il l'envie aussi : ce garde-là a su dire non, une fois.

keys: The temple's walls bore a rite, carved by priests long dead: feed the sun.
en: The temple's walls bore a rite, carved by priests long dead: feed the sun.
fr: Les murs du temple portaient un rite, gravé par des prêtres morts depuis longtemps : nourrir le soleil.

keys: He read it, learned it, made himself its priest. No one was there to tell him no.
en: He read it, learned it, made himself its priest. No one was there to tell him no.
fr: Il l'a lu, il l'a appris, il s'en est fait le prêtre. Personne n'était là pour lui dire non.

keys: Every dawn he throws to the pyres whatever the Well lets fall.
en: Every dawn he throws to the pyres whatever the Well lets fall.
fr: Chaque aube, il jette aux bûchers ce que le Puits laisse tomber.

keys: One day the shrine's keeper came down, lantern in hand, and asked him for the words of the rite.
en: One day the shrine's keeper came down, lantern in hand, and asked him for the words of the rite.
fr: Un jour, le gardien du sanctuaire est descendu, la lanterne à la main, et lui a demandé les mots du rite.

keys: A priest answers whoever asks. He told him all of them, to the last.
en: A priest answers whoever asks. He told him all of them, to the last.
fr: Un prêtre répond à qui demande. Il les lui a tous dits, jusqu'au dernier.

keys: On the moonless night the keeper came back with souls. The Tengu understood too late what he had taught.
en: On the moonless night the keeper came back with souls. The Tengu understood too late what he had taught.
fr: La nuit sans lune, le gardien est revenu avec des âmes. Le Tengu a compris trop tard ce qu'il avait enseigné.

keys: At the heart of the rite is a word the priests scratched out. The Tengu found it again under the soot.
en: At the heart of the rite is a word the priests scratched out. The Tengu found it again under the soot.
fr: Au cœur du rite, il y a un mot que les prêtres ont gratté. Le Tengu l'a retrouvé sous la suie.
Ce n'est pas « soleil ». C'est « bouche ».

keys: He still feeds the pyres. He knows nothing else, and he is ashamed.
en: He still feeds the pyres. He knows nothing else, and he is ashamed.
fr: Il nourrit encore les bûchers. Il ne sait rien faire d'autre, et il a honte.

keys: A worshipper who reads, good. Read what was scratched out, too.
en: A worshipper who reads, good. Read what was scratched out, too.
fr: Un fidèle qui lit, bien. Lis aussi ce qui a été gratté.

keys: Tôma asked me for the words. For once, I should have kept silent.
en: Tôma asked me for the words. For once, I should have kept silent.
fr: Tôma m'a demandé les mots. Pour une fois, j'aurais dû me taire.

keys: He only bows to a sworn oath.
en: He only bows to a sworn oath.
fr: Il ne s'incline que devant un serment prêté.

keys: Slay him while sworn to an oath of the Tree of Souls.
en: Slay him while sworn to an oath of the Tree of Souls.
fr: Terrasse-le en ayant prêté un serment de l'Arbre des Âmes.

keys: A horned giant with a single eye, a club of bone in his hand. He counts something under his breath.
en: A horned giant with a single eye, a club of bone in his hand. He counts something under his breath.
fr: Un géant cornu à l'œil unique, une massue d'os à la main. Il compte quelque chose à voix basse.
Écoute bien : ce sont des noms.

keys: His name was Gorr, and he laid Kagari's dead in the Ossuary. Every skull had its niche, every niche its name.
en: His name was Gorr, and he laid Kagari's dead in the Ossuary. Every skull had its niche, every niche its name.
fr: Il s'appelait Gorr, et il couchait les morts de Kagari dans l'Ossuaire. Chaque crâne avait sa niche, chaque niche son nom.

keys: A stone fell from the vault and took one of his eyes. He said one eye was enough to count.
en: A stone fell from the vault and took one of his eyes. He said one eye was enough to count.
fr: Une pierre tombée de la voûte lui a pris un œil. Il a dit qu'un œil suffisait pour compter.

keys: The horns came later, with the Well's breath.
en: The horns came later, with the Well's breath.
fr: Les cornes sont venues plus tard, avec le souffle du Puits.

keys: A beast of frost sleeps under the Ossuary. Gorr sang it the names so that it would not wake.
en: A beast of frost sleeps under the Ossuary. Gorr sang it the names so that it would not wake.
fr: Sous l'Ossuaire dort une bête de givre. Gorr lui chantait les noms pour qu'elle ne se réveille pas.

keys: It woke anyway. He says it was not the song that failed, but the flame.
en: It woke anyway. He says it was not the song that failed, but the flame.
fr: Elle s'est réveillée quand même. Il dit que ce n'est pas le chant qui a manqué, mais la flamme.

keys: Every keeper of the shrine swears at the bell that the lantern shall not go out. Gorr held the rope while they swore.
en: Every keeper of the shrine swears at the bell that the lantern shall not go out. Gorr held the rope while they swore.
fr: Chaque gardien du sanctuaire jure à la cloche que la lanterne ne s'éteindra pas. Gorr tenait la corde pendant le serment.

keys: He heard the last keeper swear. Young, his voice clear, his hand over the flame.
en: He heard the last keeper swear. Young, his voice clear, his hand over the flame.
fr: Il a entendu le dernier gardien jurer. Jeune, la voix claire, la main sur la flamme.

keys: Gorr remembers every word. He counts them with the names.
en: Gorr remembers every word. He counts them with the names.
fr: Gorr se souvient de chaque mot. Il les compte avec les noms.

keys: On the moonless night the lantern went out, and the souls came down by the hundred. Gorr could not name them all.
en: On the moonless night the lantern went out, and the souls came down by the hundred. Gorr could not name them all.
fr: La nuit sans lune, la lanterne s'est éteinte, et les âmes sont descendues par centaines. Gorr n'a pas pu toutes les nommer.

keys: The keeper came down with a cold lantern: "Keep them among the bones, where no one will look for them."
en: The keeper came down with a cold lantern: "Keep them among the bones, where no one will look for them."
fr: Le gardien est descendu avec une lanterne froide : « Garde-les parmi les os, là où personne ne les cherchera. »

keys: Gorr obeyed. A hand that swore cannot lie, he thought.
en: Gorr obeyed. A hand that swore cannot lie, he thought.
fr: Gorr a obéi. Une main qui a juré ne peut pas mentir, pensait-il.

keys: The dead of the Ossuary no longer rest. Gorr believed it was his fault, that he had miscounted.
en: The dead of the Ossuary no longer rest. Gorr believed it was his fault, that he had miscounted.
fr: Les morts de l'Ossuaire ne reposent plus. Gorr croyait que c'était sa faute, qu'il avait mal compté.

keys: But something further down counts too. Faster than he does, and it never names.
en: But something further down counts too. Faster than he does, and it never names.
fr: Mais quelque chose, plus bas, compte aussi. Plus vite que lui, et sans jamais nommer.

keys: He holds the village's souls in the hollow of his hand. He will not close it.
en: He holds the village's souls in the hollow of his hand. He will not close it.
fr: Il tient les âmes du village au creux de sa main. Il ne la refermera pas.

keys: You smell of the niches' stone. Tell me your name, so I can put it away.
en: You smell of the niches' stone. Tell me your name, so I can put it away.
fr: Tu sens la pierre des niches. Dis-moi ton nom, que je le range.

keys: Tôma. I held the rope when he swore; that name I bury without a niche.
en: Tôma. I held the rope when he swore; that name I bury without a niche.
fr: Tôma. Je tenais la corde quand il a juré ; ce nom-là, je l'enterre sans niche.

keys: She only knows those who drank from her spring.
en: She only knows those who drank from her spring.
fr: Elle ne reconnaît que ceux qui ont bu à sa source.

keys: Drink at the Spring of the Drowned, then slay her in the same run.
en: Drink at the Spring of the Drowned, then slay her in the same run.
fr: Bois à la Source des Noyés, puis terrasse-la dans la même descente.

keys: A frog the size of a house, cloaked in duckweed. Her brood swims around her and never strays.
en: A frog the size of a house, cloaked in duckweed. Her brood swims around her and never strays.
fr: Une grenouille grande comme une maison, couverte de lentilles d'eau. Ses petits nagent autour d'elle sans jamais s'éloigner.

keys: She still sings. Her song has one word too many.
en: She still sings. Her song has one word too many.
fr: Elle chante encore. Son chant a un mot de trop.

keys: She lived in the spring under Kagari, where the water leaves the rock, cold and clear.
en: She lived in the spring under Kagari, where the water leaves the rock, cold and clear.
fr: Elle vivait dans la source sous Kagari, là où l'eau sort de la roche, froide et claire.

keys: On summer evenings the village girls set paper boats on it, a candle in each.
en: On summer evenings the village girls set paper boats on it, a candle in each.
fr: Les soirs d'été, les filles du village y posaient des bateaux de papier, une bougie dans chacun.

keys: She watched them drift, and sang to them with her brood.
en: She watched them drift, and sang to them with her brood.
fr: Elle les regardait dériver, et chantait pour eux avec sa couvée.

keys: At the bottom of her pool she keeps every paper boat that sank. She counts them when she is afraid.
en: At the bottom of her pool she keeps every paper boat that sank. She counts them when she is afraid.
fr: Au fond de sa mare, elle garde tous les bateaux de papier qui ont coulé. Elle les compte quand elle a peur.

keys: One is missing. She is still looking for it.
en: One is missing. She is still looking for it.
fr: Il en manque un. Elle le cherche encore.

keys: One rainy day, a paper boat stayed alone on the water. No one came to take it back.
en: One rainy day, a paper boat stayed alone on the water. No one came to take it back.
fr: Un jour de pluie, un bateau de papier est resté seul sur l'eau. Personne n'est venu le reprendre.

keys: That night she drank water that tasted of a last breath.
en: That night she drank water that tasted of a last breath.
fr: Cette nuit-là, elle a bu une eau qui avait le goût d'un dernier souffle.

keys: Since then her song ends on two syllables she does not know: Ha. Na.
en: Since then her song ends on two syllables she does not know: Ha. Na.
fr: Depuis, son chant finit par deux syllabes qu'elle ne connaît pas : Ha. Na.

keys: The keeper came to sit by the spring each evening, without a word. She had grown used to him.
en: The keeper came to sit by the spring each evening, without a word. She had grown used to him.
fr: Le gardien venait s'asseoir au bord de la source chaque soir, sans un mot. Elle s'était habituée à lui.

keys: On the moonless night he came with children's souls in his hands. "You know how to keep little ones."
en: On the moonless night he came with children's souls in his hands. "You know how to keep little ones."
fr: La nuit sans lune, il est venu avec des âmes d'enfants dans les mains. « Toi, tu sais garder les petits. »

keys: She hides them under the mud with her own. She can no longer tell them apart.
en: She hides them under the mud with her own. She can no longer tell them apart.
fr: Elle les cache sous la vase, avec les siens. Elle ne les distingue plus.

keys: Sometimes a girl's voice sings in the spring. The Matron answers it with all her heart.
en: Sometimes a girl's voice sings in the spring. The Matron answers it with all her heart.
fr: Parfois, une voix de fillette chante dans la source. La Matrone lui répond de tout son cœur.

keys: But a frog knows what lives in water. That voice has no throat.
en: But a frog knows what lives in water. That voice has no throat.
fr: Mais une grenouille sait ce qui vit dans l'eau. Cette voix-là n'a pas de gorge.

keys: It is hungry, and it waits for someone to come down for it.
en: It is hungry, and it waits for someone to come down for it.
fr: Elle a faim, et elle attend que quelqu'un descende la chercher.

keys: Croak... Did you see the boats? One is missing... Ha... na.
en: Croak... Did you see the boats? One is missing... Ha... na.
fr: Croâ... Tu as vu les bateaux ? Il en manque un... Ha... na.

keys: The keeper's name is Tôma. He wept by the water, for the missing boat.
en: The keeper's name is Tôma. He wept by the water, for the missing boat.
fr: Le gardien s'appelle Tôma. Il pleurait au bord de l'eau, pour le bateau qui manque.

keys: He speaks only to one who bought nothing with his gold.
en: He speaks only to one who bought nothing with his gold.
fr: Il ne parle qu'à qui n'a rien acheté avec son or.

keys: Slay him without buying anything from the merchant this run.
en: Slay him without buying anything from the merchant this run.
fr: Terrasse-le sans rien avoir acheté au marchand de toute la descente.

keys: A giant of gold seated on a mountain of coins. Every coin bears the same face: his.
en: A giant of gold seated on a mountain of coins. Every coin bears the same face: his.
fr: Un géant d'or assis sur une montagne de pièces. Chaque pièce porte le même visage : le sien.

keys: He counts. He stops counting for you, and he does not like it.
en: He counts. He stops counting for you, and he does not like it.
fr: Il compte. Il s'arrête de compter pour toi, et il n'aime pas ça.

keys: His name was Ostarion, last king of Solhar, under a sky that was not yet stone.
en: His name was Ostarion, last king of Solhar, under a sky that was not yet stone.
fr: Il s'appelait Ostarion, dernier roi de Solhar, sous un ciel qui n'était pas encore de pierre.

keys: His kingdom knew famine when he was a child. He swore Solhar would never be hungry again.
en: His kingdom knew famine when he was a child. He swore Solhar would never be hungry again.
fr: Son royaume avait connu la famine dans son enfance. Il avait juré que plus jamais Solhar n'aurait faim.

keys: The sun granted prayers. One had only to pay the Tithe.
en: The sun granted prayers. One had only to pay the Tithe.
fr: Le soleil exauçait les prières. Il suffisait de payer la Dîme.

keys: A peddler of Solhar once sold him spices. He still wanders the Well, and he never haggles with him.
en: A peddler of Solhar once sold him spices. He still wanders the Well, and he never haggles with him.
fr: Un colporteur de Solhar lui vendait des épices, autrefois. Il rôde encore dans le Puits, et il ne marchande jamais avec lui.

keys: And the guard of the seventh step no longer comes. Ostarion counts that absence too.
en: And the guard of the seventh step no longer comes. Ostarion counts that absence too.
fr: Et le garde de la septième marche ne vient plus. Ostarion compte aussi cette absence-là.

keys: One soul for a harvest, ten for a victory. Ostarion wanted everything at once: he gave the whole Tithe in a day.
en: One soul for a harvest, ten for a victory. Ostarion wanted everything at once: he gave the whole Tithe in a day.
fr: Une âme pour une moisson, dix pour une victoire. Ostarion a tout voulu, tout de suite : il a donné toute la Dîme en un jour.

keys: Then his people, step after step. Then there was no one left to feed.
en: Then his people, step after step. Then there was no one left to feed.
fr: Puis son peuple, marche après marche. Puis il n'est plus resté personne à nourrir.

keys: The sun paid in gold. It never paid in bread.
en: The sun paid in gold. It never paid in bread.
fr: Le soleil a payé en or. Il n'a jamais payé en pain.

keys: The shrine's keeper came to bargain, and Ostarion recognised a man who wanted something too much.
en: The shrine's keeper came to bargain, and Ostarion recognised a man who wanted something too much.
fr: Le gardien du sanctuaire est venu marchander, et Ostarion a reconnu un homme qui voulait quelque chose de trop.

keys: "Keep these souls with your gold, and your heap will grow." The king said yes before the sentence was done.
en: "Keep these souls with your gold, and your heap will grow." The king said yes before the sentence was done.
fr: « Garde ces âmes avec ton or, et ton tas grandira. » Le roi a dit oui avant la fin de la phrase.

keys: He keeps Kagari's souls the way he kept his people. He counts them.
en: He keeps Kagari's souls the way he kept his people. He counts them.
fr: Il garde les âmes de Kagari comme il a gardé son peuple. Il les compte.

keys: He knows what the promise from below is worth: he was promised plenty, and given gold.
en: He knows what the promise from below is worth: he was promised plenty, and given gold.
fr: Il sait ce que vaut la promesse d'en bas : on lui a promis l'abondance, on lui a donné de l'or.

keys: Gold cannot be eaten. In the last winter, he chewed on coins.
en: Gold cannot be eaten. In the last winter, he chewed on coins.
fr: L'or ne se mange pas. Le dernier hiver, il mâchait des pièces.

keys: He could warn the keeper. He will not: he wants to see whether the keeper pays too.
en: He could warn the keeper. He will not: he wants to see whether the keeper pays too.
fr: Il pourrait prévenir le gardien. Il ne le fera pas : il veut voir s'il paiera, lui aussi.

keys: You read my accounts: one soul, one harvest. It was a fair price, back then.
en: You read my accounts: one soul, one harvest. It was a fair price, back then.
fr: Tu as lu mes comptes : une âme, une moisson. C'était un juste prix, à l'époque.

keys: Tôma, a man who wants something too much. I would know him among a thousand.
en: Tôma, a man who wants something too much. I would know him among a thousand.
fr: Tôma, un homme qui veut quelque chose de trop. Je le reconnaîtrais entre mille.

keys: She uncoils only for those who come down as martyrs.
en: She uncoils only for those who come down as martyrs.
fr: Elle ne déroule ses anneaux que pour ceux qui descendent en martyrs.

keys: Slay her on Martyr or Nightmare.
en: Slay her on Martyr or Nightmare.
fr: Terrasse-la en Martyr ou en Cauchemar.

keys: An old wyrm with jade scales, coiled around the temple's heart. Her body burns like an ember.
en: An old wyrm with jade scales, coiled around the temple's heart. Her body burns like an ember.
fr: Une vieille guivre aux écailles de jade, lovée autour du cœur du temple. Son corps brûle comme une braise.

keys: She looks at you as one looks at a meal one did not order.
en: She looks at you as one looks at a meal one did not order.
fr: Elle te regarde comme on regarde un repas qu'on n'a pas commandé.

keys: She had a sister of ice, who stayed above with the dead. She loved warmth, and went down toward it.
en: She had a sister of ice, who stayed above with the dead. She loved warmth, and went down toward it.
fr: Elle avait une sœur de glace, restée là-haut avec les morts. Elle aimait la chaleur, et elle est descendue vers elle.

keys: Solhar's priests fed her and called her the Gentle One. Her venom put the offerings to sleep before the pyre.
en: Solhar's priests fed her and called her the Gentle One. Her venom put the offerings to sleep before the pyre.
fr: Les prêtres de Solhar l'ont nourrie et l'ont appelée la Douce. Son venin endormait les offrandes avant le bûcher.

keys: She thought it a kindness. They did not suffer.
en: She thought it a kindness. They did not suffer.
fr: Elle croyait faire une bonté. Ils ne souffraient pas.

keys: Sometimes she thinks of her ice sister, above. She wonders whether she is still cold.
en: Sometimes she thinks of her ice sister, above. She wonders whether she is still cold.
fr: Elle pense parfois à sa sœur de glace, là-haut. Elle se demande si elle a encore froid.

keys: She will not climb up to ask. The breath would not let her go.
en: She will not climb up to ask. The breath would not let her go.
fr: Elle ne remontera pas le lui demander. Le souffle ne la laisserait pas partir.

keys: What she coils around is no heart. It is a crack where a warm breath rises, steady.
en: What she coils around is no heart. It is a crack where a warm breath rises, steady.
fr: Ce qu'elle enlace n'est pas un cœur. C'est une fissure d'où monte un souffle tiède, régulier.

keys: She has slept on it for centuries. The breath lulls her at night.
en: She has slept on it for centuries. The breath lulls her at night.
fr: Elle dort dessus depuis des siècles. Le souffle la berce, la nuit.

keys: The keeper came with his foreign chains, then set them down. She was already bound, and not by him.
en: The keeper came with his foreign chains, then set them down. She was already bound, and not by him.
fr: Le gardien est venu avec ses chaînes étrangères, puis il les a reposées. Elle était déjà liée, et pas par lui.

keys: He only gave her a share of the souls to keep. She agreed: the breath wanted them.
en: He only gave her a share of the souls to keep. She agreed: the breath wanted them.
fr: Il lui a seulement confié une part des âmes. Elle a accepté : le souffle en voulait.

keys: Of all the Well's wardens, she alone serves gladly.
en: Of all the Well's wardens, she alone serves gladly.
fr: De tous les gardiens du Puits, elle seule sert de bon cœur.

keys: She knows Solhar's sun better than its priests did: she sleeps against its cheek.
en: She knows Solhar's sun better than its priests did: she sleeps against its cheek.
fr: Elle connaît le soleil de Solhar mieux que ses prêtres : elle dort contre sa joue.

keys: It is no god. It is a mask laid over a hunger, and she has never seen a hunger give anything back.
en: It is no god. It is a mask laid over a hunger, and she has never seen a hunger give anything back.
fr: Ce n'est pas un dieu. C'est un masque posé sur une faim, et elle n'a jamais vu une faim rendre quoi que ce soit.

keys: She knows it, and stays anyway. It is so warm here.
en: She knows it, and stays anyway. It is so warm here.
fr: Elle le sait, et elle reste quand même. Il fait si chaud, ici.

keys: You smell of my sister. Frost, and the dead... Does she still sleep?
en: You smell of my sister. Frost, and the dead... Does she still sleep?
fr: Tu sens ma sœur. Le givre, les morts... Est-ce qu'elle dort encore ?

keys: Tôma laid his chains before me and wept. The breath laughed.
en: Tôma laid his chains before me and wept. The breath laughed.
fr: Tôma a posé ses chaînes devant moi et il a pleuré. Le souffle a ri.

keys: It only grows on the time you give it.
en: It only grows on the time you give it.
fr: Il ne grossit que du temps qu'on lui laisse.

keys: Slay it within 60 seconds of the fight's start.
en: Slay it within 60 seconds of the fight's start.
fr: Terrasse-le dans les 60 secondes après le début du combat.

keys: In its clear flesh float a sandal, a comb, a few coins. Everything Kagari ever dropped down the Well.
en: In its clear flesh float a sandal, a comb, a few coins. Everything Kagari ever dropped down the Well.
fr: Dans sa chair translucide flottent une sandale, un peigne, des piécettes. Tout ce que Kagari a laissé tomber dans le Puits.

keys: On its head, a bronze bowl from the shrine serves as a crown.
en: On its head, a bronze bowl from the shrine serves as a crown.
fr: Sur sa tête, un bol de bronze du sanctuaire tient lieu de couronne.

keys: Once it was only a living puddle in the Well's throat. It drank the lanterns' dripping wax and fed on moss.
en: Once it was only a living puddle in the Well's throat. It drank the lanterns' dripping wax and fed on moss.
fr: Jadis, ce n'était qu'une flaque vivante dans la gorge du Puits. Elle buvait la cire des lanternes et mangeait la mousse.

keys: Kagari's children called it the Nushi. They threw it coins for wishes and listened for the plop.
en: Kagari's children called it the Nushi. They threw it coins for wishes and listened for the plop.
fr: Les enfants de Kagari l'appelaient le Nushi. Ils lui jetaient des piécettes pour faire un vœu, et guettaient le « plop ».

keys: It kept every coin. It thought they were love.
en: It kept every coin. It thought they were love.
fr: Il gardait chaque piécette. Il croyait que c'était de l'amour.

keys: Among the coins is one with a hole, on a red cord. A little girl threw it, laughing.
en: Among the coins is one with a hole, on a red cord. A little girl threw it, laughing.
fr: Parmi les piécettes, il y en a une percée, au bout d'un cordon rouge. Une fillette l'a jetée en riant.

keys: It no longer knows her wish. It keeps the coin close to its heart, if it has one.
en: It no longer knows her wish. It keeps the coin close to its heart, if it has one.
fr: Il ne sait plus quel était son vœu. Il garde la piécette au plus près de son cœur, s'il en a un.

keys: On a moonless night, a light came down the bucket's rope. Someone held out the shrine's bowl to it, full.
en: On a moonless night, a light came down the bucket's rope. Someone held out the shrine's bowl to it, full.
fr: Une nuit sans lune, une lumière est descendue le long de la corde du seau. Quelqu'un lui tendait le bol du sanctuaire, plein.

keys: It was neither wax nor moss. It was warm, and it wept.
en: It was neither wax nor moss. It was warm, and it wept.
fr: Ce n'était ni de la cire ni de la mousse. C'était chaud, et cela pleurait.

keys: It drank it all. The bowl stayed on its head.
en: It drank it all. The bowl stayed on its head.
fr: Il a tout bu. Le bol lui est resté sur la tête.
Le gardien l'a nourri le premier

keys: The shrine's keeper fed it first, by his own hand. Then he spoke to it as one speaks to a dog in training.
en: The shrine's keeper fed it first, by his own hand. Then he spoke to it as one speaks to a dog in training.
fr: Le gardien du sanctuaire l'a nourri le premier, de sa propre main. Puis il lui a parlé comme à un chien qu'on dresse.

keys: "Keep them, and do not digest them. I will come back for them."
en: "Keep them, and do not digest them. I will come back for them."
fr: « Garde-les, et ne les digère pas. Je reviendrai les chercher. »

keys: He never came back. The souls weigh, and the King swells.
en: He never came back. The souls weigh, and the King swells.
fr: Il n'est jamais revenu. Les âmes pèsent, et le Roi enfle.

keys: It is no king. It is only the throat: what it swallows slides lower, ever lower.
en: It is no king. It is only the throat: what it swallows slides lower, ever lower.
fr: Ce n'est pas un roi. Ce n'est que la gorge : ce qu'il avale glisse plus bas, toujours plus bas.

keys: Beneath it, something pulls. Each night the souls in its belly weigh a little less.
en: Beneath it, something pulls. Each night the souls in its belly weigh a little less.
fr: Sous lui, quelque chose tire. Chaque nuit, les âmes de son ventre pèsent un peu moins.

keys: It holds them back with all its bulk. It is the only promise it ever kept.
en: It holds them back with all its bulk. It is the only promise it ever kept.
fr: Il les retient de toute sa masse. C'est la seule promesse qu'il ait jamais tenue.

keys: You smell of the well-rim. The children... are they coming back?
en: You smell of the well-rim. The children... are they coming back?
fr: Tu sens la margelle. Les enfants... ils reviennent ?

keys: Tôma. The bowl smelled of him; he said he would come back.
en: Tôma. The bowl smelled of him; he said he would come back.
fr: Tôma. Le bol avait son odeur ; il a dit qu'il reviendrait.

keys: He taught you every way to step aside. He waits to see you stand.
en: He taught you every way to step aside. He waits to see you stand.
fr: Il t'a appris toutes les façons de t'écarter. Il attend de te voir tenir.
Terrasse-le sans faire une seule roulade.

keys: At the bottom of the Well a man kneels in the dark, his back to you, before a pool of tar.
en: At the bottom of the Well a man kneels in the dark, his back to you, before a pool of tar.
fr: Au fond du Puits, un homme est agenouillé dans le noir, dos à toi, devant une mare de goudron.

keys: He wears the shrine's robe. He rises the way he taught you: without haste.
en: He wears the shrine's robe. He rises the way he taught you: without haste.
fr: Il porte la robe du sanctuaire. Il se relève comme il te l'a appris : sans hâte.

keys: Tôma, keeper of Kagari's shrine. He found you at its door, an orphan, and gave you a broom, then a blade.
en: Tôma, keeper of Kagari's shrine. He found you at its door, an orphan, and gave you a broom, then a blade.
fr: Tôma, gardien du sanctuaire de Kagari. Il t'a trouvé orphelin à sa porte, et t'a donné un balai, puis une lame.

keys: He taught you the dash, the long cut and the lantern. He knows the answer to every one of your strokes.
en: He taught you the dash, the long cut and the lantern. He knows the answer to every one of your strokes.
fr: Il t'a appris l'élan, la longue coupe et la lanterne. Chacun de tes coups, il en connaît la réponse.

keys: His daughter Hana drowned in the spring under the village. He searched the water for three nights, lantern in hand.
en: His daughter Hana drowned in the spring under the village. He searched the water for three nights, lantern in hand.
fr: Sa fille Hana s'est noyée dans la source sous le village. Il a fouillé l'eau trois nuits, la lanterne à la main.

keys: Then he took you in. You never knew whether it was to fill the house or to forget it.
en: Then he took you in. You never knew whether it was to fill the house or to forget it.
fr: Puis il t'a recueilli. Tu n'as jamais su si c'était pour remplir la maison, ou pour l'oublier.

keys: In Solhar's drowned archives he found a promise: what the Maw takes, it gives back, if it is fed.
en: In Solhar's drowned archives he found a promise: what the Maw takes, it gives back, if it is fed.
fr: Dans les archives noyées de Solhar, il a trouvé une promesse : ce que la Gueule prend, elle le rend, si on la nourrit.

keys: He put out every flame of Kagari but one. That one he left in your hand: he could not give you too.
en: He put out every flame of Kagari but one. That one he left in your hand: he could not give you too.
fr: Il a éteint toutes les flammes de Kagari sauf une. Celle-là, il l'a laissée dans ta main : toi, il n'a pas pu te donner.

keys: He knows, deep down, that what waits with him is not Hana. The voice in the tar has no throat.
en: He knows, deep down, that what waits with him is not Hana. The voice in the tar has no throat.
fr: Il sait, au fond, que ce qui attend avec lui n'est pas Hana. La voix dans le goudron n'a pas de gorge.

keys: So he kneels lower, and keeps the last rule he has left: to wait without moving.
en: So he kneels lower, and keeps the last rule he has left: to wait without moving.
fr: Alors il s'agenouille plus bas, et garde la dernière règle qui lui reste : attendre sans bouger.

keys: Again, then. Show me the cut that beat me.
en: Again, then. Show me the cut that beat me.
fr: Encore, donc. Montre-moi la coupe qui m'a battu.

keys: She is almost here, my pupil. Do not make me choose.
en: She is almost here, my pupil. Do not make me choose.
fr: Elle est presque là, mon élève. Ne m'oblige pas à choisir.

keys: Your guard is true, my pupil.
en: Your guard is true, my pupil.
fr: Ta garde est juste, mon élève.

keys: You stood. That much, at least, I taught you.
en: You stood. That much, at least, I taught you.
fr: Tu as tenu. Ça, au moins, je te l'ai appris.

keys: He only yields to a blade that does not tremble.
en: He only yields to a blade that does not tremble.
fr: Il ne s'avoue vaincu que devant une lame qui ne tremble pas.

keys: Slay him losing less than a quarter of your Health.
en: Slay him losing less than a quarter of your Health.
fr: Terrasse-le en perdant moins d'un quart de ta Vie.

keys: A stone knight, lying for centuries on a tomb with no inscription. He has risen.
en: A stone knight, lying for centuries on a tomb with no inscription. He has risen.
fr: Un chevalier de pierre, couché depuis des siècles sur un tombeau sans inscription. Il s'est levé.

keys: He murmurs names as he walks. None of them is his.
en: He murmurs names as he walks. None of them is his.
fr: Il murmure des noms en marchant. Aucun n'est le sien.

keys: The seal he guards has been cut. A clean cut, without hesitation, by a blade you know.
en: The seal he guards has been cut. A clean cut, without hesitation, by a blade you know.
fr: Le sceau qu'il garde a été tranché. Une coupure nette, sans hésitation, d'une lame que tu connais.

keys: It is the school of your shrine. The stroke you were taught, too.
en: It is the school of your shrine. The stroke you were taught, too.
fr: C'est l'école de ton sanctuaire. Le geste qu'on t'a appris, à toi aussi.

keys: His two cold blades were forged by a foreign smith, who wept as he tempered them.
en: His two cold blades were forged by a foreign smith, who wept as he tempered them.
fr: Ses deux lames froides ont été forgées par un forgeron étranger, qui pleurait en les trempant.

keys: That smith still lives in the Well. He forges for others now, to be forgiven.
en: That smith still lives in the Well. He forges for others now, to be forgiven.
fr: Ce forgeron vit encore dans le Puits. Il forge pour d'autres, maintenant, pour se faire pardonner.

keys: Long ago a knight went down to seal what hungers. Solhar claims him; others say he had no land at all.
en: Long ago a knight went down to seal what hungers. Solhar claims him; others say he had no land at all.
fr: Il y a très longtemps, un chevalier est descendu sceller ce qui a faim. Solhar le réclame ; d'autres disent qu'il n'avait pas de pays.

keys: The seal asked a price. He gave his name, and the name became the seal.
en: The seal asked a price. He gave his name, and the name became the seal.
fr: Le sceau demandait un prix. Il a donné son nom, et le nom est devenu le sceau.

keys: Since then he no longer knows what he was called. He tries the names of the dead, one by one.
en: Since then he no longer knows what he was called. He tries the names of the dead, one by one.
fr: Depuis, il ne sait plus comment on l'appelait. Il essaie les noms des morts, un par un.

keys: The last keeper of Kagari came this far, his lantern unlit. The Effigy rose to stop him.
en: The last keeper of Kagari came this far, his lantern unlit. The Effigy rose to stop him.
fr: Le dernier gardien de Kagari est venu jusqu'ici, sa lanterne éteinte. Le Gisant s'est levé pour l'arrêter.

keys: He lost. The keeper cut the seal's last knot, then bound him to guard what he had sworn to prevent.
en: He lost. The keeper cut the seal's last knot, then bound him to guard what he had sworn to prevent.
fr: Il a perdu. Le gardien a tranché le dernier nœud du sceau, puis l'a lié à garder ce qu'il avait juré d'empêcher.

keys: The first keeper serves the last. He has no name left to curse it with.
en: The first keeper serves the last. He has no name left to curse it with.
fr: Le premier gardien sert le dernier. Il ne lui reste même pas de nom pour le maudire.

keys: He saw the Maw once, before he sealed it. It was no beast: it was a lack that had taken shape.
en: He saw the Maw once, before he sealed it. It was no beast: it was a lack that had taken shape.
fr: Il a vu la Gueule, une fois, avant de la sceller. Ce n'était pas une bête : c'était un manque qui avait pris forme.

keys: The seal did not kill it. It made it wait, and it knows how to wait.
en: The seal did not kill it. It made it wait, and it knows how to wait.
fr: Le sceau ne la tuait pas. Il la faisait attendre, et elle sait attendre.

keys: Someone could close the door again: by giving him back his name, or by giving their own.
en: Someone could close the door again: by giving him back his name, or by giving their own.
fr: Quelqu'un pourrait refermer la porte : en lui rendant son nom, ou en donnant le sien.

keys: You carry the lantern; I carried it too. Tell me... what was I called?
en: You carry the lantern; I carried it too. Tell me... what was I called?
fr: Tu portes la lanterne ; je la portais aussi. Dis-moi... comment m'appelait-on ?

keys: Tôma, I know his name. Mine he left in the seal, with the cut.
en: Tôma, I know his name. Mine he left in the seal, with the cut.
fr: Tôma, je sais son nom. Le mien, il l'a laissé dans le sceau, avec la coupure.

keys: At the bottom of the Well a lantern burns before the seal. The one who holds it has no face.
en: At the bottom of the Well a lantern burns before the seal. The one who holds it has no face.
fr: Au fond du Puits, une lanterne brûle devant le sceau. Celui qui la tient n'a plus de visage.

keys: He rises the way you rise. He holds the blade the way you hold it.
en: He rises the way you rise. He holds the blade the way you hold it.
fr: Il se lève comme tu te lèves. Il tient la lame comme tu la tiens.

keys: One night you knelt where Tôma knelt, and he climbed toward the light. The Well kept your guard and let your name go.
en: One night you knelt where Tôma knelt, and he climbed toward the light. The Well kept your guard and let your name go.
fr: Une nuit, tu t'es agenouillé là où Tôma s'agenouillait, et il est remonté vers la lumière. Le Puits a gardé ta garde et laissé partir ton nom.

keys: Below, no one came to take the lantern from your hand.
en: Below, no one came to take the lantern from your hand.
fr: En bas, personne n'est venu te prendre la lanterne des mains.

keys: Night after night the Maw leans on the seal, and night after night he holds.
en: Night after night the Maw leans on the seal, and night after night he holds.
fr: Nuit après nuit, la Gueule pèse sur le sceau, et nuit après nuit il tient.

keys: He does not wait to win. He waits for someone to stand in his place, so that he may rest.
en: He does not wait to win. He waits for someone to stand in his place, so that he may rest.
fr: Il n'attend pas de vaincre. Il attend que quelqu'un se tienne à sa place, pour enfin se reposer.

keys: He speaks only to a blade of his own school.
en: He speaks only to a blade of his own school.
fr: Il ne parle qu'à une lame de son école.

keys: A giant warrior in armor reddened by embers. His curved blade draws arcs of fire.
en: A giant warrior in armor reddened by embers. His curved blade draws arcs of fire.
fr: Un guerrier immense dans une armure rougie par les braises. Sa lame courbe trace des arcs de feu.

keys: He stands guard before a door no one passes anymore.
en: He stands guard before a door no one passes anymore.
fr: Il monte la garde devant une porte que plus personne ne franchit.

keys: His name was Vardan, and he guarded the seventh step of Solhar's temple. He knew every worshipper who climbed it.
en: His name was Vardan, and he guarded the seventh step of Solhar's temple. He knew every worshipper who climbed it.
fr: Il s'appelait Vardan et gardait la septième marche du temple de Solhar. Il connaissait chaque fidèle qui la montait.

keys: His curved blade came from the school of the temple guards: one edge, one loyalty.
en: His curved blade came from the school of the temple guards: one edge, one loyalty.
fr: Sa lame courbe venait de l'école des gardes du temple : un seul tranchant, une seule loyauté.

keys: Much later, the people of Kagari called him rônin: one who has no master left.
en: Much later, the people of Kagari called him rônin: one who has no master left.
fr: Bien plus tard, les gens de Kagari l'ont appelé rônin : celui qui n'a plus de maître.

keys: Far below, his old king counts his coins. Vardan never goes down to see him.
en: Far below, his old king counts his coins. Vardan never goes down to see him.
fr: Tout au fond, son ancien roi compte ses pièces. Vardan ne descend jamais le voir.

keys: If he saw him again, he would not know whether to kneel or to strike.
en: If he saw him again, he would not know whether to kneel or to strike.
fr: S'il le revoyait, il ne saurait pas s'il doit s'agenouiller ou frapper.

keys: On the day of the great Tithe, the king ordered the people driven up to the altars. All of the people.
en: On the day of the great Tithe, the king ordered the people driven up to the altars. All of the people.
fr: Le jour de la grande Dîme, le roi a ordonné de faire monter le peuple jusqu'aux autels. Tout le peuple.

keys: Vardan obeyed. He pushed up the steps people whose names he knew.
en: Vardan obeyed. He pushed up the steps people whose names he knew.
fr: Vardan a obéi. Il a poussé sur les marches des gens dont il savait les noms.

keys: He still guards the seventh step. No one climbs it, and that is better.
en: He still guards the seventh step. No one climbs it, and that is better.
fr: Il garde encore la septième marche. Personne ne la monte, et c'est mieux ainsi.

keys: When the kingdom fell, his king became a heap of gold. Vardan refused to guard gold.
en: When the kingdom fell, his king became a heap of gold. Vardan refused to guard gold.
fr: Quand le royaume est tombé, son roi est devenu un tas d'or. Vardan a refusé de garder de l'or.

keys: The shrine's keeper brought him what he lacked, an order: "Guard these souls, and let no one drive them up."
en: The shrine's keeper brought him what he lacked, an order: "Guard these souls, and let no one drive them up."
fr: Le gardien du sanctuaire lui a apporté ce qui lui manquait, un ordre : « Garde ces âmes, et que personne ne les fasse monter. »

keys: A guard without orders is only armor. He said yes.
en: A guard without orders is only armor. He said yes.
fr: Un garde sans ordre n'est qu'une armure. Il a dit oui.

keys: On the day of the Tithe, Vardan stood close enough to the altar to see the sun up close.
en: On the day of the Tithe, Vardan stood close enough to the altar to see the sun up close.
fr: Le jour de la Dîme, Vardan était assez près de l'autel pour voir le soleil de près.

keys: It had no face. It had a mouth, and the mouth thanked the king.
en: It had no face. It had a mouth, and the mouth thanked the king.
fr: Il n'avait pas de visage. Il avait une bouche, et la bouche remerciait le roi.

keys: He guards Kagari's souls against that mouth. It is the only order he ever loved.
en: He guards Kagari's souls against that mouth. It is the only order he ever loved.
fr: Il garde les âmes de Kagari contre cette bouche-là. C'est le seul ordre qu'il ait jamais aimé.

keys: You read the roll of the seventh step, all those names. I pushed them, one by one.
en: You read the roll of the seventh step, all those names. I pushed them, one by one.
fr: Tu as lu le rôle de la septième marche, tous ces noms. Je les ai poussés, un par un.

keys: Tôma gave me an order. Soon I will know whether it was just.
en: Tôma gave me an order. Soon I will know whether it was just.
fr: Tôma m'a donné un ordre. Je saurai bientôt s'il était juste.

keys: Only a blessed blade dares look this sun in the face.
en: Only a blessed blade dares look this sun in the face.
fr: Seule une lame bénie ose regarder ce soleil en face.

keys: Slay it with the Templar Sword.
en: Slay it with the Templar Sword.

keys: A dead sun floats in the tomb, crowned with embers. Its light shows nothing; it draws in.
en: A dead sun floats in the tomb, crowned with embers. Its light shows nothing; it draws in.
fr: Un soleil éteint flotte dans le tombeau, couronné de braises. Sa lumière n'éclaire rien : elle aspire.

keys: It does not look at you. It weighs you.
en: It does not look at you. It weighs you.
fr: Il ne te regarde pas. Il te pèse.

keys: Solhar called it the Great Noon. Hymns were sung to it at the hour when shadows vanish.
en: Solhar called it the Great Noon. Hymns were sung to it at the hour when shadows vanish.
fr: Solhar l'appelait le Grand Midi. On lui chantait des hymnes à l'heure où les ombres disparaissent.

keys: It granted. A harvest, a rain, a victory: one had only to give.
en: It granted. A harvest, a rain, a victory: one had only to give.
fr: Il exauçait. Une moisson, une pluie, une victoire : il suffisait de donner.

keys: No one wondered why a sun needed to be given anything.
en: No one wondered why a sun needed to be given anything.
fr: Personne ne s'est demandé pourquoi un soleil avait besoin qu'on lui donne quelque chose.

keys: Solhar's dead still sing its hymns at noon, in the dust. They no longer know why.
en: Solhar's dead still sing its hymns at noon, in the dust. They no longer know why.
fr: Les morts de Solhar chantent encore ses hymnes à midi, dans la poussière. Ils ne savent plus pourquoi.

keys: The sun listens. It counts the voices, the way one counts mouthfuls.
en: The sun listens. It counts the voices, the way one counts mouthfuls.
fr: Le soleil écoute. Il compte les voix, comme on compte des bouchées.

keys: When no souls were left in Solhar, the Great Noon took the whole kingdom. The sky turned to stone.
en: When no souls were left in Solhar, the Great Noon took the whole kingdom. The sky turned to stone.
fr: Quand il n'est plus resté d'âmes à Solhar, le Grand Midi a pris le royaume entier. Le ciel est devenu pierre.

keys: It was buried with those who prayed to it. It still shines for them at noon, in the dark.
en: It was buried with those who prayed to it. It still shines for them at noon, in the dark.
fr: Il a été enseveli avec ceux qui le priaient. Il brille encore pour eux, à midi, dans le noir.

keys: The sun needed no binding. The shrine's keeper came to kneel before it, like the priests of old.
en: The sun needed no binding. The shrine's keeper came to kneel before it, like the priests of old.
fr: Le soleil n'a pas eu besoin d'être lié. Le gardien du sanctuaire est venu s'agenouiller devant lui, comme les prêtres d'antan.

keys: The sun answered. It always answers those who have lost something.
en: The sun answered. It always answers those who have lost something.
fr: Le soleil a répondu. Il répond toujours à ceux qui ont perdu quelque chose.

keys: The keeper left with a promise. The sun kept its share of the souls.
en: The keeper left with a promise. The sun kept its share of the souls.
fr: Le gardien est reparti avec une promesse. Le soleil, lui, a gardé sa part d'âmes.

keys: It is no god, not even a sun. It is a mask, and behind the mask, a mouth.
en: It is no god, not even a sun. It is a mask, and behind the mask, a mouth.
fr: Ce n'est pas un dieu, pas même un soleil. C'est un masque, et derrière le masque, une bouche.

keys: When it speaks, it is not the one speaking. It is what hungers, at the very bottom, trying on a face.
en: When it speaks, it is not the one speaking. It is what hungers, at the very bottom, trying on a face.
fr: Quand il parle, ce n'est pas lui qui parle. C'est ce qui a faim, tout au fond, qui essaie un visage.

keys: The mask is cracked. Soon the mouth will not need it.
en: The mask is cracked. Soon the mouth will not need it.
fr: Le masque est fendu. Bientôt, la bouche n'en aura plus besoin.

keys: Pray, and the harvest will come. Give, and the harvest will come.
en: Pray, and the harvest will come. Give, and the harvest will come.
fr: Prie, et la moisson viendra. Donne, et la moisson viendra.

keys: Tôma gave, and the harvest will come. The harvest always comes.
en: Tôma gave, and the harvest will come. The harvest always comes.
fr: Tôma a donné, et la moisson viendra. La moisson vient toujours.

keys: It only yields to one it has never tasted.
en: It only yields to one it has never tasted.
fr: Elle ne cède qu'à celui qu'elle n'a jamais goûté.

keys: Slay it without being caught in its bite once.
en: Slay it without being caught in its bite once.
fr: Terrasse-la sans te faire prendre une seule fois par sa morsure.

keys: Out of the tar rises a face of gold crowned with rays: the sun Solhar prayed to, cracked.
en: Out of the tar rises a face of gold crowned with rays: the sun Solhar prayed to, cracked.
fr: Du goudron s'élève un visage d'or couronné de rayons : le soleil que priait Solhar, fendu.

keys: Behind it, no body. Only a hunger that has learned to wear faces.
en: Behind it, no body. Only a hunger that has learned to wear faces.
fr: Derrière, pas de corps. Seulement une faim, qui a appris à porter des visages.

keys: When the master fell to his knees, it took him into its mouth. Tôma stands there now, his eyes open.
en: When the master fell to his knees, it took him into its mouth. Tôma stands there now, his eyes open.
fr: Quand le maître est tombé à genoux, elle l'a pris dans sa gueule. Tôma s'y tient debout, les yeux ouverts.

keys: It wears him as it wore the sun: to be looked at, to be prayed to, to be fed.
en: It wears him as it wore the sun: to be looked at, to be prayed to, to be fed.
fr: Elle le porte comme elle portait le soleil : pour qu'on la regarde, qu'on la prie, qu'on la nourrisse.

keys: It answered Solhar with harvests and gold, and Tôma with his daughter's voice.
en: It answered Solhar with harvests and gold, and Tôma with his daughter's voice.
fr: Elle a répondu à Solhar par des moissons et de l'or, et à Tôma par la voix de sa fille.

keys: It has never given anything back. It gives only what it has learned to imitate.
en: It has never given anything back. It gives only what it has learned to imitate.
fr: Elle n'a jamais rien rendu. Elle ne donne que ce qu'elle a appris à imiter.

keys: It does not die. The first keeper never killed it: he made it wait, behind a door that remembers it is a door.
en: It does not die. The first keeper never killed it: he made it wait, behind a door that remembers it is a door.
fr: Elle ne meurt pas. Le premier gardien ne l'a jamais tuée : il l'a fait attendre, derrière une porte qui se souvient d'être une porte.

keys: The bell of Kagari, rung from below, shuts that door. Then someone must keep it.
en: The bell of Kagari, rung from below, shuts that door. Then someone must keep it.
fr: La cloche de Kagari, sonnée d'en bas, ferme cette porte. Ensuite, quelqu'un doit la garder.

keys: What it has tasted, it keeps: a name, a voice, a kingdom. Of you, it has had nothing.
en: What it has tasted, it keeps: a name, a voice, a kingdom. Of you, it has had nothing.
fr: Ce qu'elle a goûté, elle le garde : un nom, une voix, un royaume. De toi, elle n'a rien eu.

keys: That is why the bell answers you. A soul it never tasted can still close the door.
en: That is why the bell answers you. A soul it never tasted can still close the door.
fr: Voilà pourquoi la cloche te répond. Une âme qu'elle n'a jamais goûtée peut encore fermer la porte.

keys: She speaks only to one who sheds neither blood nor tears.
en: She speaks only to one who sheds neither blood nor tears.
fr: Elle ne parle qu'à qui ne verse ni sang ni larme.

keys: Slay her without being hurt once.
en: Slay her without being hurt once.
fr: Terrasse-la sans être blessé une seule fois.

keys: A ghost woven of many veils, and under each veil a weeping face.
en: A ghost woven of many veils, and under each veil a weeping face.
fr: Un spectre tissé de plusieurs voiles, et sous chaque voile, un visage qui pleure.

keys: They all weep together, but not for the same person.
en: They all weep together, but not for the same person.
fr: Elles pleurent toutes ensemble, mais pas pour la même personne.

keys: In Kagari, mourners were paid in rice to sing at funerals. They knew every lament.
en: In Kagari, mourners were paid in rice to sing at funerals. They knew every lament.
fr: À Kagari, on payait les pleureuses en riz pour qu'elles chantent aux funérailles. Elles connaissaient toutes les complaintes.

keys: When they died they stayed in the Ossuary. Their tears did not know how to stop.
en: When they died they stayed in the Ossuary. Their tears did not know how to stop.
fr: Mortes, elles sont restées à l'Ossuaire. Leurs larmes ne savaient pas s'arrêter.

keys: Over time their veils knotted together.
en: Over time their veils knotted together.
fr: Avec le temps, leurs voiles se sont noués les uns aux autres.

keys: Above, a frog croaks a name of two syllables. The mourners take it up under their breath.
en: Above, a frog croaks a name of two syllables. The mourners take it up under their breath.
fr: Au-dessus, une grenouille croasse un nom de deux syllabes. Les pleureuses le reprennent tout bas.

keys: It is the only name they never sang. They are learning it.
en: It is the only name they never sang. They are learning it.
fr: C'est le seul nom qu'elles n'aient jamais chanté. Elles l'apprennent.

keys: They wept for every death in the village but one. A child the water kept, whom no one buried.
en: They wept for every death in the village but one. A child the water kept, whom no one buried.
fr: Elles ont pleuré chaque mort du village, sauf une. Une enfant que l'eau a gardée, et que personne n'a enterrée.

keys: No body, no song. It is the one lament they never sang.
en: No body, no song. It is the one lament they never sang.
fr: Pas de corps, pas de chant. C'est la seule complainte qui leur manque.

keys: So they weep for her, in the place of those who could not.
en: So they weep for her, in the place of those who could not.
fr: Alors elles pleurent pour elle, à la place de ceux qui n'ont pas su.

keys: The One Who Wept With Them
en: The One Who Wept With Them

keys: Only one living man came to weep with them: the shrine's keeper. He gave them no rice, only his tears.
en: Only one living man came to weep with them: the shrine's keeper. He gave them no rice, only his tears.
fr: Un seul vivant venait pleurer avec elles : le gardien du sanctuaire. Il ne leur donnait pas de riz, seulement ses larmes.

keys: On the moonless night he gave them the souls of the grieving: "You know how to comfort; keep them."
en: On the moonless night he gave them the souls of the grieving: "You know how to comfort; keep them."
fr: La nuit sans lune, il leur a confié les âmes des endeuillés : « Vous savez consoler ; gardez-les. »

keys: They have rocked those souls ever since. They never asked him whom he wept for.
en: They have rocked those souls ever since. They never asked him whom he wept for.
fr: Elles bercent ces âmes depuis. Elles ne lui ont jamais demandé pour qui il pleurait.

keys: Sometimes they hear the child singing, far beneath the Ossuary. Their veils quiver with hope.
en: Sometimes they hear the child singing, far beneath the Ossuary. Their veils quiver with hope.
fr: Parfois, elles entendent l'enfant chanter, loin sous l'Ossuaire. Leurs voiles frémissent d'espoir.

keys: Then they fall silent. A mourner knows the voices of the dead, and this one lies.
en: Then they fall silent. A mourner knows the voices of the dead, and this one lies.
fr: Puis elles se taisent. Une pleureuse connaît la voix des morts, et celle-ci ment.

keys: What sings down there learned the song. It never had tears.
en: What sings down there learned the song. It never had tears.
fr: Ce qui chante en bas a appris la chanson. Il n'a jamais eu de larmes.

keys: You carry a grief too. Weep with us, only for a moment.
en: You carry a grief too. Weep with us, only for a moment.
fr: Tu portes un deuil, toi aussi. Pleure avec nous, rien qu'un instant.

keys: Tôma wept for Hana. We weep for her in his stead, since he stopped.
en: Tôma wept for Hana. We weep for her in his stead, since he stopped.
fr: Tôma pleurait Hana. Nous la pleurons à sa place, puisqu'il a cessé.

keys: Find the one who does not rest, and slay him
en: Find the one who does not rest, and slay him
fr: Trouve celui qui ne repose pas, et terrasse-le

keys: Find the one who does not rest, then win a run
en: Find the one who does not rest, then win a run
fr: Trouve celui qui ne repose pas, puis remporte une descente

keys: Find the one who waits at the bottom
en: Find the one who waits at the bottom
fr: Trouve celui qui attend au fond

keys: Hee hee... One die, two dice, three souls to play; who loses pays, who wins... plays again.
en: Hee hee... One die, two dice, three souls to play; who loses pays, who wins... plays again.
fr: Hi hi... Un dé, deux dés, trois âmes à jouer ; qui perd paie, qui gagne... rejoue.

keys: I bet it all one night on a double six. The Well rolled a seven, hee hee, with two dice.
en: I bet it all one night on a double six. The Well rolled a seven, hee hee, with two dice.
fr: J'ai tout misé, un soir, sur un double six. Le Puits a tiré sept, hi hi, avec deux dés.

keys: Bet big, bet small, the die does not know your name... Hee hee, mine it won long ago.
en: Bet big, bet small, the die does not know your name... Hee hee, mine it won long ago.
fr: Mise gros, mise peu, le dé ne sait pas ton nom... Hi hi, le mien, il l'a gagné depuis longtemps.

keys: Heads you win, tails I laugh... Hee hee, down here coins are all heads, and always the same king.
en: Heads you win, tails I laugh... Hee hee, down here coins are all heads, and always the same king.
fr: Pile tu gagnes, face je ris... Hi hi, ici les pièces n'ont que des faces, et c'est toujours le même roi.

keys: Solhar played dice on the temple stairs; the king bet his people, and the sun took all the shares.
en: Solhar played dice on the temple stairs; the king bet his people, and the sun took all the shares.
fr: Solhar jouait aux dés sur les marches du temple ; le roi misait son peuple, et le soleil raflait l'ensemble.

keys: Three wardens down, three lucky throws? Hee hee... The Well counts the dice, and it hates to lose.
en: Three wardens down, three lucky throws? Hee hee... The Well counts the dice, and it hates to lose.
fr: Trois gardiens tombés, trois coups de chance ? Hi hi... Le Puits compte les dés, et il n'aime pas perdre.

keys: You won a game against the Well, hee hee. It always asks for revenge, lower down, ever lower.
en: You won a game against the Well, hee hee. It always asks for revenge, lower down, ever lower.
fr: Tu as gagné une partie contre le Puits, hi hi. Il demande toujours sa revanche, plus bas, toujours plus bas.

keys: You die often, you. Hee hee... I like that: we are almost family.
en: You die often, you. Hee hee... I like that: we are almost family.
fr: Tu meurs souvent, toi. Hi hi... Ça me plaît : nous sommes presque de la même famille.

keys: The die spins, the flame dances; who cheats the Well loses his chance. Hee hee... and yet, everyone cheats.
en: The die spins, the flame dances; who cheats the Well loses his chance. Hee hee... and yet, everyone cheats.
fr: Le dé tourne, la flamme danse ; qui triche au Puits perd sa chance. Hi hi... et pourtant, tout le monde triche.

keys: Your master played too: the whole village on a single throw. Hee hee... he thought the Well gave back what you bet.
en: Your master played too: the whole village on a single throw. Hee hee... he thought the Well gave back what you bet.
fr: Ton maître a joué, lui aussi : tout le village sur un seul coup. Hi hi... il croyait que le Puits rendait ce qu'on mise.

keys: I forge, you strike: each to his metal.
en: I forge, you strike: each to his metal.
fr: Je forge, toi, tu frappes : chacun son métal.

keys: A rune is like a temper: chosen badly, the blade remembers the bad blow. Choose, then strike.
en: A rune is like a temper: chosen badly, the blade remembers the bad blow. Choose, then strike.
fr: Une rune, c'est comme une trempe : mal choisie, la lame se souvient du mauvais coup. Choisis, puis frappe.

keys: I served an army, once. Far from here, under a sky that burned.
en: I served an army, once. Far from here, under a sky that burned.
fr: J'ai servi une armée, jadis. Loin d'ici, sous un ciel qui brûlait.

keys: Solhar, yes: I come from there. Metal there tasted of salt and gold.
en: Solhar, yes: I come from there. Metal there tasted of salt and gold.
fr: Solhar, oui : j'en viens. Là-bas, le métal avait un goût de sel et d'or.

keys: The blue wyrm wore chains that frost cannot bite. I know that steel; I know the hand that hammered it.
en: The blue wyrm wore chains that frost cannot bite. I know that steel; I know the hand that hammered it.
fr: La guivre bleue portait des chaînes que le givre ne mord pas. Je connais cet acier ; je connais la main qui l'a battu.

keys: A blade that has killed three wardens is not the same blade. Keep it, or melt it; never sell it.
en: A blade that has killed three wardens is not the same blade. Keep it, or melt it; never sell it.
fr: Une lame qui a tué trois gardiens n'est plus la même lame. Garde-la, ou fonds-la ; ne la vends pas.

keys: The effigy... I forged its blades weeping into the quench. It remembers nothing; I remember everything.
en: The effigy... I forged its blades weeping into the quench. It remembers nothing; I remember everything.
fr: Le gisant... J'ai forgé ses lames en pleurant dans la trempe. Lui ne se souvient de rien ; moi, de tout.

keys: A seal is a lock of iron and of name. The first keeper gave the name; the iron was mine.
en: A seal is a lock of iron and of name. The first keeper gave the name; the iron was mine.
fr: Un sceau, c'est une serrure de fer et de nom. Le premier gardien a donné le nom ; le fer, c'est moi.

keys: The souls are coming up. Metal remembers the heat too; that is why we reforge it.
en: The souls are coming up. Metal remembers the heat too; that is why we reforge it.
fr: Les âmes remontent. Le métal aussi se souvient de la chaleur ; c'est pour ça qu'on le reforge.

keys: Tôma came to my forge for chains. I gave them to him without looking at him; I forge for you to pay for it.
en: Tôma came to my forge for chains. I gave them to him without looking at him; I forge for you to pay for it.
fr: Tôma est venu à ma forge commander des chaînes. Je les lui ai données sans le regarder ; je forge pour toi pour payer ça.

keys: The Bloated King spits its rain in a crown: stand between two drops, never in their line.
en: The Bloated King spits its rain in a crown: stand between two drops, never in their line.
fr: Le Roi Boursouflé crache sa pluie en couronne : tiens-toi entre deux gouttes, jamais dans leur ligne.

keys: And when it splits, child, cut the little ones down one by one.
en: And when it splits, child, cut the little ones down one by one.
fr: Et quand il se divise, petit, tranche les petits un à un.

keys: The Matron leaps in a straight line and lands hard: step aside, not back.
en: The Matron leaps in a straight line and lands hard: step aside, not back.
fr: La Matrone bondit en ligne droite et retombe lourdement : écarte-toi de côté, pas en arrière.

keys: Her spit opens like a fan; go wide around it, child.
en: Her spit opens like a fan; go wide around it, child.
fr: Son crachat s'ouvre en éventail ; contourne-le large, petit.

keys: Gorr's eye spits fire in a fan before him: keep to his flank.
en: Gorr's eye spits fire in a fan before him: keep to his flank.
fr: L'œil de Gorr crache le feu en éventail devant lui : tiens-toi sur son flanc.

keys: When the ground reddens in a wide circle, child, leave it before his club falls.
en: When the ground reddens in a wide circle, child, leave it before his club falls.
fr: Quand le sol rougit en grand cercle, petit, sors-en avant que son gourdin tombe.

keys: Only the Azure Wyrm's head bleeds; its body burns cold at a touch. When it dives along a line, roll across it, child, not along it.
en: Only the Azure Wyrm's head bleeds; its body burns cold at a touch. When it dives along a line, roll across it, child, not along it.
fr: Seule la tête de la Guivre d'Azur saigne ; son corps brûle de froid à qui le touche. Quand elle plonge en ligne, roule à travers, petit, pas le long.

keys: The Mother of Tears' wail goes out in a ring, and the ring widens as it travels.
en: The Mother of Tears' wail goes out in a ring, and the ring widens as it travels.
fr: Le cri de la Mère des Larmes part en anneau, et l'anneau s'élargit en s'éloignant.

keys: Far from her the gaps are wider, child: that is where you pass.
en: Far from her the gaps are wider, child: that is where you pass.
fr: Loin d'elle, les trous sont plus grands, petit : c'est là qu'il faut passer.

keys: When the line of its step marks the ground, the Tengu is about to cross it in one stroke. Leave it sideways, child, then strike where it stops.
en: When the line of its step marks the ground, the Tengu is about to cross it in one stroke. Leave it sideways, child, then strike where it stops.
fr: Quand la ligne de son pas se trace au sol, le Tengu va la traverser d'un trait. Sors-en par le côté, petit, puis frappe-le là où il s'arrête.

keys: The Ronin's flame arc burns all around him, up close. Step out of the circle when he draws, child, and come back when the flame dies down.
en: The Ronin's flame arc burns all around him, up close. Step out of the circle when he draws, child, and come back when the flame dies down.
fr: L'arc de flammes du Rônin brûle tout autour de lui, de près. Recule hors du cercle quand il arme son coup, petit, et reviens quand la flamme retombe.

keys: Only the Jade Wyrm's head can be wounded; its coils burn. When the venom blooms all around it, child, be far away already.
en: Only the Jade Wyrm's head can be wounded; its coils burn. When the venom blooms all around it, child, be far away already.
fr: Seule la tête de la Guivre de Jade se laisse blesser ; ses anneaux brûlent. Quand le venin fleurit tout autour d'elle, petit, sois déjà loin.

keys: The Hoarder leaps along a line and crushes where he lands: step off his line.
en: The Hoarder leaps along a line and crushes where he lands: step off his line.
fr: L'Accapareur bondit en ligne et écrase où il retombe : écarte-toi de sa ligne.

keys: At half his life he calls his thieves; cut them down fast, child, they carry off your gold.
en: At half his life he calls his thieves; cut them down fast, child, they carry off your gold.
fr: À mi-vie, il appelle ses voleurs ; abats-les vite, petit, ils emportent ton or.

keys: The Dead Sun fades and appears elsewhere: never stand still before it. Its flare goes out in a ring; look for the gaps far from it, child.
en: The Dead Sun fades and appears elsewhere: never stand still before it. Its flare goes out in a ring; look for the gaps far from it, child.
fr: Le Soleil Mort s'efface et reparaît ailleurs : ne reste jamais immobile devant lui. Sa flamme part en anneau ; cherche les trous loin de lui, petit.

keys: The effigy calls the dead to its side: cut them down before they close around you. Its rush marks a line on the ground, child; do not stay on it.
en: The effigy calls the dead to its side: cut them down before they close around you. Its rush marks a line on the ground, child; do not stay on it.
fr: Le gisant appelle les morts à son aide : abats-les avant qu'ils ne t'encerclent. Son élan trace une ligne au sol, petit ; ne reste pas dessus.

keys: When his lantern flares violet, a circle fills under your feet: leave it before it closes.
en: When his lantern flares violet, a circle fills under your feet: leave it before it closes.
fr: Quand sa lanterne flambe violet, un cercle se remplit sous tes pieds : quitte-le avant qu'il se ferme.

keys: Your master taught you never to stay where you are expected, child.
en: Your master taught you never to stay where you are expected, child.
fr: Ton maître t'a appris à ne jamais rester où l'on t'attend, petit.

keys: Strike the Maw only with its jaw open, and from the edge: too near its mouth, it bites.
en: Strike the Maw only with its jaw open, and from the edge: too near its mouth, it bites.
fr: Ne frappe la Gueule que mâchoire ouverte, et depuis le bord : trop près de sa bouche, elle mord.

keys: Shut, it lashes the ground around you; do not stop moving, child.
en: Shut, it lashes the ground around you; do not stop moving, child.
fr: Fermée, elle fouette le sol autour de toi ; ne t'arrête pas, petit.

keys: {killer} has taken you too often for chance. Open the codex at its name, child: its blows are written there, one by one.
en: {killer} has taken you too often for chance. Open the codex at its name, child: its blows are written there, one by one.
fr: {killer} t'a pris trop souvent pour que ce soit le hasard. Ouvre le codex à son nom, petit : ses coups y sont écrits, un à un.

keys: Do not strike a warden endlessly: after too many blows in a row, it answers with a blast. Step back, or roll through the red ring, child.
en: Do not strike a warden endlessly: after too many blows in a row, it answers with a blast. Step back, or roll through the red ring, child.
fr: Ne frappe pas sans fin un gardien : après trop de coups d'affilée, il répond d'un souffle. Recule, ou roule à travers l'anneau rouge, petit.

keys: In the Deeps, do not linger to fight: seek the Dawn Breach. The golden light shows you the way, child.
en: In the Deeps, do not linger to fight: seek the Dawn Breach. The golden light shows you the way, child.
fr: Dans les Tréfonds, ne t'attarde pas à te battre : cherche la Brèche de l'Aube. La lumière dorée te montre le chemin, petit.

keys: At the Threshold every spectre slain counts, and the knell does not wait. Strike without rest, child: there, running is no use.
en: At the Threshold every spectre slain counts, and the knell does not wait. Strike without rest, child: there, running is no use.
fr: Au Seuil, chaque spectre abattu compte, et le glas n'attend pas. Frappe sans relâche, petit : là-bas, fuir ne sert à rien.

keys: Traps always warn before they strike: a click, a glow. Never stand on a flagstone that has spoken, child.
en: Traps always warn before they strike: a click, a glow. Never stand on a flagstone that has spoken, child.
fr: Les pièges préviennent toujours avant de frapper : un déclic, une lueur. Ne t'arrête jamais sur une dalle qui a parlé, petit.

keys: A hole is crossed by rolling over it, child. And monsters fall in too, if you push them.
en: A hole is crossed by rolling over it, child. And monsters fall in too, if you push them.
fr: Un trou se passe en roulant par-dessus, petit. Et les monstres y tombent aussi, si tu les y pousses.

keys: Fire keeps biting a while after the flame. Get out of the embers, child, and drink while you burn, not after.
en: Fire keeps biting a while after the flame. Get out of the embers, child, and drink while you burn, not after.
fr: Le feu mord encore un moment après la flamme. Sors des braises, petit, et bois pendant que tu brûles, pas après.

keys: Venom gnaws until its time runs out. Keep clear of the clouds and the spit, child, and mend yourself before it is done.
en: Venom gnaws until its time runs out. Keep clear of the clouds and the spit, child, and mend yourself before it is done.
fr: Le venin ronge jusqu'au bout de son temps. Écarte-toi des nuages et des crachats, petit, et soigne-toi avant qu'il n'ait fini.

keys: On floors gripped by frost, the campfires are your life. Never stray from them longer than your warmth lasts, child.
en: On floors gripped by frost, the campfires are your life. Never stray from them longer than your warmth lasts, child.
fr: Sur les étages pris par le givre, les feux de camp sont ta vie. Ne t'en éloigne pas plus longtemps que ta chaleur ne dure, petit.

keys: When the ash burns you from within, find the oasis and stay on its shore, child, until you cool.
en: When the ash burns you from within, find the oasis and stay on its shore, child, until you cool.
fr: Quand la cendre te brûle de l'intérieur, cherche l'oasis et reste sur sa rive, petit, le temps de refroidir.

keys: Quicksand slows you first, then swallows. Roll out the moment it takes your ankles, child.
en: Quicksand slows you first, then swallows. Roll out the moment it takes your ankles, child.
fr: Le sable mouvant ralentit d'abord, puis il avale. Roule dehors dès qu'il te prend les chevilles, petit.

keys: What is about to burst warns first, with a red circle on the ground. Leave the circle, child, then come back to strike.
en: What is about to burst warns first, with a red circle on the ground. Leave the circle, child, then come back to strike.
fr: Ce qui va éclater prévient d'abord, d'un cercle rouge au sol. Sors du cercle, petit, puis reviens frapper.

keys: The altar takes what it is offered, and it does not count. Never offer your blood when your Health is low, child.
en: The altar takes what it is offered, and it does not count. Never offer your blood when your Health is low, child.
fr: L'autel prend ce qu'on lui offre, et il ne compte pas. N'offre jamais ton sang quand ta Vie est basse, petit.

keys: You fall early, child, again and again. Offer your souls to the shrine's Tree: every knot of it makes you stronger for every descent.
en: You fall early, child, again and again. Offer your souls to the shrine's Tree: every knot of it makes you stronger for every descent.
fr: Tu tombes tôt, petit, encore et encore. Offre tes âmes à l'Arbre du sanctuaire : chaque nœud te rend plus fort pour toutes les descentes.

keys: Go down as a Pilgrim for a while, child: the blows there are lighter and the souls fewer, but you will learn their moves.
en: Go down as a Pilgrim for a while, child: the blows there are lighter and the souls fewer, but you will learn their moves.
fr: Descends en Pèlerin quelque temps, petit : les coups y sont moins lourds et les âmes moins nombreuses, mais tu apprendras leurs gestes.

keys: You still had potions on you, child. Drink before the last breath, not after.
en: You still had potions on you, child. Drink before the last breath, not after.
fr: Tu avais encore des potions sur toi, petit. Bois avant le dernier souffle, pas après.

keys: Not a single potion the whole way down, child. Keep them on your belt: they are drunk in one move, without opening the bag.
en: Not a single potion the whole way down, child. Keep them on your belt: they are drunk in one move, without opening the bag.
fr: Pas une seule potion de toute la descente, petit. Garde-les sur ta ceinture : elles se boivent d'un geste, sans ouvrir le sac.

keys: You did not roll once, child. Your master taught you: while you roll, no blow can touch you.
en: You did not roll once, child. Your master taught you: while you roll, no blow can touch you.
fr: Tu n'as pas roulé une seule fois, petit. Ton maître te l'a appris : pendant la roulade, aucun coup ne te touche.

keys: Wardens freeze before they strike, and the ground reddens where the blow will fall. Roll through, child: the roll slips under the blade.
en: Wardens freeze before they strike, and the ground reddens where the blow will fall. Roll through, child: the roll slips under the blade.
fr: Les gardiens se figent avant de frapper, et le sol rougit là où le coup tombera. Roule à travers, petit : la roulade passe sous la lame.

keys: You went down without armor, child. Even a little leather on your head stops one blow too many.
en: You went down without armor, child. Even a little leather on your head stops one blow too many.
fr: Tu descendais sans armure, petit. Même un peu de cuir sur la tête arrête un coup de trop.

keys: You ran for the stairs, and the Well went down faster than you. Cut down what prowls on the way, child: every soul hardens you.
en: You ran for the stairs, and the Well went down faster than you. Cut down what prowls on the way, child: every soul hardens you.
fr: Tu as couru vers les escaliers, et le Puits est descendu plus vite que toi. Abats ce qui rôde en chemin, petit : chaque âme t'endurcit.

keys: Those who strike from afar fear being reached. Close the distance, child, or put a wall between you.
en: Those who strike from afar fear being reached. Close the distance, child, or put a wall between you.
fr: Ceux qui frappent de loin craignent qu'on les approche. Coupe la distance, petit, ou mets un mur entre vous.

keys: Those ringed in colored light are tougher than the rest. Never face them in the middle of a pack, child: draw them out alone.
en: Those ringed in colored light are tougher than the rest. Never face them in the middle of a pack, child: draw them out alone.
fr: Ceux qu'une lueur de couleur entoure sont plus coriaces que les autres. Ne les affronte pas au milieu d'une meute, petit : attire-les seuls.

keys: Your master used to say: "Do not watch the blade, watch the shoulder." What strikes freezes first; that is when you roll, child.
en: Your master used to say: "Do not watch the blade, watch the shoulder." What strikes freezes first; that is when you roll, child.
fr: Ton maître disait : « Ne regarde pas la lame, regarde l'épaule. » Ce qui frappe se fige d'abord ; c'est là qu'il faut rouler, petit.

keys: Hold your attack down, child, and let go when the circle is full: one charged blow is worth more than three hurried ones.
en: Hold your attack down, child, and let go when the circle is full: one charged blow is worth more than three hurried ones.
fr: Garde ton attaque enfoncée, petit, et relâche quand le cercle est plein : un coup chargé vaut mieux que trois coups pressés.

keys: Perks of one family wake together. Choose them with the ones you already carry in mind, child.
en: Perks of one family wake together. Choose them with the ones you already carry in mind, child.
fr: Les atouts d'une même famille s'éveillent ensemble. Choisis-les en pensant à ceux que tu portes déjà, petit.

keys: Brann sets runes for nothing. Never keep a rune in your bag while your weapon has an empty socket, child.
en: Brann sets runes for nothing. Never keep a rune in your bag while your weapon has an empty socket, child.
fr: Brann sertit les runes sans rien demander. Ne garde pas une rune dans ton sac quand ton arme a un creux libre, petit.

keys: Put your potions on your belt, child. One does not dig through a bag while death is watching.
en: Put your potions on your belt, child. One does not dig through a bag while death is watching.
fr: Mets tes potions sur ta ceinture, petit. On ne cherche pas dans son sac quand la mort vous regarde.

keys: Your master used to say that a guard is knowing when not to strike. Step back, child, and watch before you strike back.
en: Your master used to say that a guard is knowing when not to strike. Step back, child, and watch before you strike back.
fr: Ton maître disait que la garde, c'est savoir quand ne pas frapper. Recule d'un pas, petit, et regarde avant de rendre le coup.

keys: There you are, child. I am the Vigil-Keeper: I keep the bell, and I never sleep.
