en: There you are, child. I am the Vigil-Keeper: I keep the bell, and I never sleep.
fr: Te voilà, petit. Je suis la Veilleuse : je garde la cloche, et je ne dors jamais.

keys: All of Kagari sleeps but the two of us. Your lantern, I can hear it burning from here.
en: All of Kagari sleeps but the two of us. Your lantern, I can hear it burning from here.
fr: Tout Kagari dort, sauf nous deux. Ta lanterne, je l'entends brûler d'ici.

keys: The Well woke on a moonless night. A cold breath went through every house, and every flame lay down.
en: The Well woke on a moonless night. A cold breath went through every house, and every flame lay down.
fr: Le Puits s'est réveillé une nuit sans lune. Un souffle froid est passé dans chaque maison, et chaque flamme s'est couchée.

keys: All but yours. I do not know why yet, child.
en: All but yours. I do not know why yet, child.
fr: Toutes, sauf la tienne. Je ne sais pas encore pourquoi, petit.

keys: A warden has fallen, child. I felt souls climb the bell rope, warm as bread.
en: A warden has fallen, child. I felt souls climb the bell rope, warm as bread.
fr: Un gardien est tombé, petit. J'ai senti des âmes remonter la corde de la cloche, tièdes comme du pain.

keys: You went as far as the Ossuary. Our dead sank there when the earth moved; greet them for me.
en: You went as far as the Ossuary. Our dead sank there when the earth moved; greet them for me.
fr: Tu es allé jusqu'à l'Ossuaire. Nos morts sont descendus là quand la terre a bougé ; salue-les pour moi.

keys: And if you hear a little girl's voice by the water, child, do not answer it.
en: And if you hear a little girl's voice by the water, child, do not answer it.
fr: Et si tu entends une voix de fillette près de l'eau, petit, ne lui réponds pas.

keys: You bring back pages from below. Read them to me, child; my eyes read nothing now but wax and wind.
en: You bring back pages from below. Read them to me, child; my eyes read nothing now but wax and wind.
fr: Tu rapportes des pages du fond. Lis-les-moi, petit ; mes yeux ne lisent plus que la cire et le vent.

keys: The Pyre Temple... My masters spoke of a kingdom beneath ours that prayed to a sun.
en: The Pyre Temple... My masters spoke of a kingdom beneath ours that prayed to a sun.
fr: Le Temple-Bûcher... Mes maîtres parlaient d'un royaume sous le nôtre, qui priait un soleil.

keys: They said that sun was hungry, child. I thought it a tale for children.
en: They said that sun was hungry, child. I thought it a tale for children.
fr: Ils disaient que ce soleil avait faim, petit. Je croyais que c'était une fable pour les enfants.

keys: Fresh wax in the Hushed Archive, and a keeper's seal? Someone read them, and not long ago.
en: Fresh wax in the Hushed Archive, and a keeper's seal? Someone read them, and not long ago.
fr: De la cire fraîche dans les Archives Muettes, et un sceau de gardien ? Quelqu'un les a lues, et il n'y a pas longtemps.

keys: No: many keepers have worn that seal, child. Many.
en: No: many keepers have worn that seal, child. Many.
fr: Non : beaucoup de gardiens ont porté ce sceau, petit. Beaucoup.

keys: I kept silent too long, child. That night the lamps of Kagari were blown out by hand, one by one, in the order of the rite.
en: I kept silent too long, child. That night the lamps of Kagari were blown out by hand, one by one, in the order of the rite.
fr: Je me suis tue trop longtemps, petit. Cette nuit-là, les lampes de Kagari ont été soufflées à la main, une à une, dans l'ordre du rite.

keys: Do not ask me who knows that order. I do not want to hear it.
en: Do not ask me who knows that order. I do not want to hear it.
fr: Ne me demande pas qui connaît cet ordre. Je ne veux pas l'entendre.

keys: Souls have gone home to their bodies. I heard a door open in the village, the first since that night.
en: Souls have gone home to their bodies. I heard a door open in the village, the first since that night.
fr: Des âmes sont rentrées dans leurs corps. J'ai entendu une porte s'ouvrir au village, la première depuis cette nuit.

keys: But the Well still goes down, child. As long as it does, your lantern and my bell have work to do.
en: But the Well still goes down, child. As long as it does, your lantern and my bell have work to do.
fr: Mais le Puits descend encore, petit. Tant qu'il descend, ta lanterne et ma cloche ont du travail.

keys: The nameless effigy has fallen? Then the seal below was cut... by a blade of our school, you say.
en: The nameless effigy has fallen? Then the seal below was cut... by a blade of our school, you say.
fr: Le gisant sans nom est tombé ? Alors le sceau d'en bas a été coupé... par une lame de notre école, dis-tu.

keys: Many learned the guard here, child, many. Do not look at me like that.
en: Many learned the guard here, child, many. Do not look at me like that.
fr: Beaucoup ont appris la garde ici, petit, beaucoup. Ne me regarde pas ainsi.

keys: The Well has a bottom, child. I hear it when you come back up: a silence heavier than the rest, where someone waits on his knees.
en: The Well has a bottom, child. I hear it when you come back up: a silence heavier than the rest, where someone waits on his knees.
fr: Le Puits a un fond, petit. Je l'entends quand tu remontes : un silence plus lourd que les autres, où quelqu'un attend à genoux.

keys: Tôma: there, I have said it. I rocked Hana beside him, and I refused to hear what the stones kept saying.
en: Tôma: there, I have said it. I rocked Hana beside him, and I refused to hear what the stones kept saying.
fr: Tôma : voilà, je l'ai dit. J'ai bercé Hana à côté de lui, et je refusais d'entendre ce que les pierres répétaient.

keys: He blew out the lamps to have her back, child. Your master gave the village to a hunger that gives nothing back.
en: He blew out the lamps to have her back, child. Your master gave the village to a hunger that gives nothing back.
fr: Il a soufflé les lampes pour la ravoir, petit. Ton maître a donné le village à une faim qui ne rend rien.

keys: He spared you. He left your lantern lit because he could not give you too.
en: He spared you. He left your lantern lit because he could not give you too.
fr: Il t'a épargné, toi. Il a laissé ta lanterne allumée parce qu'il ne pouvait pas te donner aussi.

keys: That is all I still love of him, child.
en: That is all I still love of him, child.
fr: C'est tout ce que j'aime encore de lui, petit.

keys: You rang the bell from below. Hana sleeps, and Tôma too, against the stone.
en: You rang the bell from below. Hana sleeps, and Tôma too, against the stone.
fr: Tu as sonné la cloche d'en bas. Hana dort, et Tôma aussi, contre la pierre.

keys: And I, child, for the first time in many nights, I slept.
en: And I, child, for the first time in many nights, I slept.
fr: Et moi, petit, pour la première fois depuis bien des nuits, j'ai dormi.

keys: Tôma has come back up. He knocks at every door in the village and answers for what he did, one house after another.
en: Tôma has come back up. He knocks at every door in the village and answers for what he did, one house after another.
fr: Tôma est remonté. Il frappe à chaque porte du village et répond de ce qu'il a fait, une maison après l'autre.

keys: You keep the bottom in his place. I keep your lantern, child; it is all I know how to do.
en: You keep the bottom in his place. I keep your lantern, child; it is all I know how to do.
fr: Toi, tu gardes le fond à sa place. Je garde ta lanterne, petit ; c'est tout ce que je sais faire.

keys: Ten times, child, I have heard you climb the rope. The bell is learning your step.
en: Ten times, child, I have heard you climb the rope. The bell is learning your step.
fr: Dix fois, petit, je t'ai entendu remonter la corde. La cloche commence à connaître ton pas.

keys: Your master will come back, child. He went down before you, I am sure of it; he will come back up with the souls, you will see.
en: Your master will come back, child. He went down before you, I am sure of it; he will come back up with the souls, you will see.
fr: Ton maître reviendra, petit. Il est descendu avant toi, j'en suis sûre ; il remontera avec les âmes, tu verras.

keys: The Well never sleeps, and neither do I. We keep each other company, it and I.
en: The Well never sleeps, and neither do I. We keep each other company, it and I.
fr: Le Puits ne dort jamais, et moi non plus. Nous nous tenons compagnie, lui et moi.

keys: Offer your souls to the Tree, child. They are our neighbours': they remember you and lend you their strength.
en: Offer your souls to the Tree, child. They are our neighbours': they remember you and lend you their strength.
fr: Offre tes âmes à l'Arbre, petit. Ce sont celles de nos voisins : elles se souviennent de toi et te prêtent leur force.

keys: Your master swept this step every morning, at the hour when only the crows are heard. I still hear him, sometimes.
en: Your master swept this step every morning, at the hour when only the crows are heard. I still hear him, sometimes.
fr: Ton maître balayait ce seuil chaque matin, à l'heure où l'on n'entend que les corbeaux. Je l'entends encore, parfois.

keys: My bell rings only for souls coming home. Bring me some, child, and it will sing.
en: My bell rings only for souls coming home. Bring me some, child, and it will sing.
fr: Ma cloche ne sonne que pour les âmes qui rentrent. Rapporte-m'en, petit, et elle chantera.

keys: I have had no eyes for a long time, child. But a lantern can be heard: yours crackles like a child's laugh.
en: I have had no eyes for a long time, child. But a lantern can be heard: yours crackles like a child's laugh.
fr: Je n'ai plus d'yeux depuis longtemps, petit. Mais une lanterne, ça s'entend : la tienne crépite comme un rire d'enfant.

keys: There you are, child. I never sleep: I was waiting for you.
en: There you are, child. I never sleep: I was waiting for you.
fr: Te voilà revenu, petit. Je ne dors jamais : je t'attendais.

keys: {killer} took you on floor {floor}. While your lantern burns here, the Well gives you back to me.
en: {killer} took you on floor {floor}. While your lantern burns here, the Well gives you back to me.
fr: {killer} t'a pris à l'étage {floor}. Tant que ta lanterne brûle ici, le Puits te rend à moi.

keys: You knocked at the Threshold, child, and the knell rang before you. I heard your lantern waver, then fall quiet.
en: You knocked at the Threshold, child, and the knell rang before you. I heard your lantern waver, then fall quiet.
fr: Tu as frappé au Seuil, petit, et le glas a sonné avant toi. J'ai entendu ta lanterne hésiter, puis se taire.

keys: You fell lower than the Well, into the Deeps. Even there your flame reached me, child.
en: You fell lower than the Well, into the Deeps. Even there your flame reached me, child.
fr: Tu es tombé plus bas que le Puits, dans les Tréfonds. Même là, ta flamme me parvenait, petit.

keys: {killer} smothered it. The Deeps have no bell.
en: {killer} smothered it. The Deeps have no bell.
fr: {killer} l'a étouffée. Les Tréfonds n'ont pas de cloche.

keys: {place}. Few lanterns have shone down there, child, and this one went out.
en: {place}. Few lanterns have shone down there, child, and this one went out.
fr: {place}. Peu de lanternes ont brillé là-bas, petit, et celle-ci s'y est éteinte.

keys: So it was Tôma who sent you back. He always struck where the guard opens, child, and he taught you so.
en: So it was Tôma who sent you back. He always struck where the guard opens, child, and he taught you so.
fr: C'est donc Tôma qui t'a renvoyé. Il frappait toujours là où la garde s'ouvre, petit, et il te l'avait appris.

keys: The Maw has tasted you, child. What it tastes it keeps, but your lantern still burns here, beside me.
en: The Maw has tasted you, child. What it tastes it keeps, but your lantern still burns here, beside me.
fr: La Gueule t'a goûté, petit. Ce qu'elle goûte, elle le garde, mais ta lanterne brûle encore ici, près de moi.

keys: You set the lantern down yourself, child. There is no shame in it: one goes down better rested.
en: You set the lantern down yourself, child. There is no shame in it: one goes down better rested.
fr: Tu as posé la lanterne toi-même, petit. Ce n'est pas une honte : on redescend mieux reposé.

keys: {killer} threw you off with a single breath, child. You struck without pausing for air, so the warden paused for you.
en: {killer} threw you off with a single breath, child. You struck without pausing for air, so the warden paused for you.
fr: {killer} t'a repoussé d'un seul souffle, petit. Tu frappais sans reprendre haleine, et le gardien l'a reprise pour toi.

keys: {killer}, again. The same shadow keeps falling on your flame, child, and I am learning its step.
en: {killer}, again. The same shadow keeps falling on your flame, child, and I am learning its step.
fr: {killer}, encore. La même ombre revient sur ta flamme, petit, et je finis par connaître son pas.

keys: {killer}. That is the name the bell breathed to me, child, on floor {floor}.
en: {killer}. That is the name the bell breathed to me, child, on floor {floor}.
fr: {killer}. C'est ce nom-là que la cloche m'a soufflé, petit, à l'étage {floor}.

keys: {act}, floor {floor}. You held out {time} in the dark, and a warden had the last word.
en: {act}, floor {floor}. You held out {time} in the dark, and a warden had the last word.
fr: {act}, étage {floor}. Tu as tenu {time} dans le noir, et c'est un gardien qui a eu le dernier mot.

keys: {killer}. Souls from our village are in its keeping, child; you will have to take them back.
en: {killer}. Souls from our village are in its keeping, child; you will have to take them back.
fr: {killer}. Des âmes de chez nous sont sous sa garde, petit ; il faudra les lui reprendre.

keys: The cold took you, child. No blade: the cold that climbs from the stones when the Well draws breath.
en: The cold took you, child. No blade: the cold that climbs from the stones when the Well draws breath.
fr: Le froid t'a pris, petit. Pas une lame : le froid qui monte des pierres quand le Puits inspire.

keys: The heat consumed you, child. Some nights the Well burns like an oven left untended.
en: The heat consumed you, child. Some nights the Well burns like an oven left untended.
fr: La chaleur t'a consumé, petit. Certaines nuits, le Puits brûle comme un four qu'on aurait oublié.

keys: The sand swallowed you, child, without a sound. Even I heard nothing.
en: The sand swallowed you, child, without a sound. Even I heard nothing.
fr: Le sable t'a avalé, petit, sans un bruit. Même moi, je n'ai rien entendu.

keys: You paid the altar with your own life, child. That is how Solhar took its tithes, and it died of it.
en: You paid the altar with your own life, child. That is how Solhar took its tithes, and it died of it.
fr: Tu as payé l'autel de ta propre vie, petit. Solhar prenait ainsi ses dîmes, et il en est mort.

keys: You gave your blood to the altar, and it took it all. Those old stones do not know when to stop, child.
en: You gave your blood to the altar, and it took it all. Those old stones do not know when to stop, child.
fr: Tu as donné ton sang à l'autel, et il a tout pris. Ces vieilles pierres ne savent pas s'arrêter, petit.

keys: No beast this time: the stone itself. The Well hides teeth under its flagstones, child, on floor {floor}.
en: No beast this time: the stone itself. The Well hides teeth under its flagstones, child, on floor {floor}.
fr: Pas une bête, cette fois : la pierre elle-même. Le Puits cache des dents sous ses dalles, petit, à l'étage {floor}.

keys: You fell, child. The Well did not need to strike: it only opened its mouth.
en: You fell, child. The Well did not need to strike: it only opened its mouth.
fr: Tu es tombé, petit. Le Puits n'a pas eu besoin de frapper : il a seulement ouvert la bouche.

keys: Fire took you slowly, ember by ember. I smelled the ash as far as the shrine's step.
en: Fire took you slowly, ember by ember. I smelled the ash as far as the shrine's step.
fr: Le feu t'a pris lentement, braise après braise. J'ai senti l'odeur de cendre jusque sur le seuil du sanctuaire.

keys: The venom did its work, drop by drop. Your flame paled, child, before it went out.
en: The venom did its work, drop by drop. Your flame paled, child, before it went out.
fr: Le venin a fait son œuvre, goutte à goutte. Ta flamme a pâli, petit, avant de s'éteindre.

keys: A rumble, then fire. You stood too near when it burst, child.
en: A rumble, then fire. You stood too near when it burst, child.
fr: Un grondement, puis le feu. Tu étais trop près quand la chose a éclaté, petit.

keys: {killer}, ringed in light. The bell tolled deeper for that one.
en: {killer}, ringed in light. The bell tolled deeper for that one.
fr: {killer}, dans un halo de lueur. La cloche a sonné plus grave pour celui-là.

keys: Floor {floor}, {biome}. I keep the names of the places where you fall, child.
en: Floor {floor}, {biome}. I keep the names of the places where you fall, child.
fr: Étage {floor}, {biome}. Je retiens les noms des lieux où tu tombes, petit.

keys: {killer}, from afar. You never saw the blow coming, child; I heard it whistle.
en: {killer}, from afar. You never saw the blow coming, child; I heard it whistle.
fr: {killer}, de loin. Tu n'as pas vu venir le coup, petit ; moi, je l'ai entendu siffler.

keys: {act}, floor {floor}. No lantern of Kagari ever went so deep, child, save one.
en: {act}, floor {floor}. No lantern of Kagari ever went so deep, child, save one.
fr: {act}, étage {floor}. Jamais une lanterne de Kagari n'était descendue si bas, petit, sauf une.

keys: So soon, child. The well-rim is still warm from your hand.
en: So soon, child. The well-rim is still warm from your hand.
fr: Si tôt, petit. La margelle est encore tiède de ta main.

keys: {killer}, on floor {floor}. Come up, breathe, and go down again.
en: {killer}, on floor {floor}. Come up, breathe, and go down again.
fr: {killer}, à l'étage {floor}. Remonte, souffle, et redescends.

keys: {killer}, floor {floor}, {biome}: I felt your flame waver, then nothing.
en: {killer}, floor {floor}, {biome}: I felt your flame waver, then nothing.
fr: {killer}, étage {floor}, {biome} : j'ai senti ta flamme vaciller, puis plus rien.

keys: You fell on floor {floor}, child, at level {level}, after {time} in the dark. {killer} was hungry.
en: You fell on floor {floor}, child, at level {level}, after {time} in the dark. {killer} was hungry.
fr: Tu es tombé à l'étage {floor}, petit, au niveau {level}, après {time} dans le noir. {killer} avait faim.

keys: {act}, floor {floor}. {killer} sent you back to me, and I heard you climb the bell rope.
en: {act}, floor {floor}. {killer} sent you back to me, and I heard you climb the bell rope.
fr: {act}, étage {floor}. {killer} t'a renvoyé vers moi, et je t'ai entendu remonter la corde de la cloche.

keys: Floor {floor}, {biome}. Something took you down there, child, and the bell could not tell me what.
en: Floor {floor}, {biome}. Something took you down there, child, and the bell could not tell me what.
fr: Étage {floor}, {biome}. Quelque chose t'a pris là-bas, petit, et la cloche n'a pas su me dire quoi.

keys: You rang the bell from below, child. Hana sleeps at last.
en: You rang the bell from below, child. Hana sleeps at last.
fr: Tu as sonné la cloche d'en bas, petit. Hana dort, enfin.

keys: And tonight, for the first time in a long while, I think I shall sleep.
en: And tonight, for the first time in a long while, I think I shall sleep.
fr: Et moi, cette nuit, pour la première fois depuis bien longtemps, je crois que je vais dormir.

keys: You stayed below in his place, and your master climbed back to answer to the village.
en: You stayed below in his place, and your master climbed back to answer to the village.
fr: Tu es resté en bas, à sa place, et ton maître est remonté répondre au village.

keys: I will keep your lantern lit, child, as I kept his.
en: I will keep your lantern lit, child, as I kept his.
fr: Je garderai ta lanterne allumée, petit, comme j'ai gardé la sienne.

keys: The bell rang, child. I felt it in my bones before I heard it.
en: The bell rang, child. I felt it in my bones before I heard it.
fr: La cloche a sonné, petit. Je l'ai sentie dans mes os avant de l'entendre.

keys: There is something I must tell you: that night, the lamps did not go out by themselves. Someone blew them out, one by one.
en: There is something I must tell you: that night, the lamps did not go out by themselves. Someone blew them out, one by one.
fr: Il faut que je te dise une chose : cette nuit-là, les lampes ne se sont pas éteintes seules. Quelqu'un les a soufflées, une à une.

keys: More souls given back to the village, child. And still the Well goes deeper.
en: More souls given back to the village, child. And still the Well goes deeper.
fr: Encore des âmes rendues au village, petit. Le Puits, lui, descend toujours plus bas.

keys: I heard shutters open in the village. Someone lit a fire, child; it smelled of rice.
en: I heard shutters open in the village. Someone lit a fire, child; it smelled of rice.
fr: J'ai entendu des volets s'ouvrir dans le village. Quelqu'un a allumé un feu, petit ; ça sentait le riz.

keys: I have no name, friend. I sold it to the Well for the right to trade forever, and the price was fair.
en: I have no name, friend. I sold it to the Well for the right to trade forever, and the price was fair.
fr: Je n'ai pas de nom, l'ami. Je l'ai vendu au Puits contre le droit de commercer toujours, et le prix était bon.

keys: I take everything back, even what is worthless; especially what is worthless. Empty your bag here before the warden, friend.
en: I take everything back, even what is worthless; especially what is worthless. Empty your bag here before the warden, friend.
fr: Je reprends tout, même ce qui ne vaut rien ; surtout ce qui ne vaut rien. Vide ton sac chez moi avant le gardien, l'ami.

keys: Every coin has a face, and every face a memory. Look closely at the ones you pick up: it is always the same king.
en: Every coin has a face, and every face a memory. Look closely at the ones you pick up: it is always the same king.
fr: Chaque pièce a un visage, et chaque visage un souvenir. Regarde bien celles que tu ramasses : c'est toujours le même roi.

keys: Solhar? I sold spices there when its sky was not stone, and the king paid well: in gold, never in bread.
en: Solhar? I sold spices there when its sky was not stone, and the king paid well: in gold, never in bread.
fr: Solhar ? J'y vendais des épices quand son ciel n'était pas de pierre, et le roi payait bien : en or, jamais en pain.

keys: Free advice, for once: the Hoarder only respects those who bought nothing from me. It pains me to say it.
en: Free advice, for once: the Hoarder only respects those who bought nothing from me. It pains me to say it.
fr: Un conseil gratuit, pour une fois : l'Accapareur ne respecte que ceux qui ne m'ont rien acheté. Ça me coûte de le dire.

keys: You saw old Ostarion on his pile of gold? He still owes me three sacks of saffron; remind him before you strike.
en: You saw old Ostarion on his pile of gold? He still owes me three sacks of saffron; remind him before you strike.
fr: Tu as vu le vieil Ostarion sur son tas d'or ? Il me doit encore trois sacs de safran ; rappelle-le-lui avant de frapper.

keys: The Well lets me through because I am worth nothing to it: a man without a name does not feed. You, friend, have a taste.
en: The Well lets me through because I am worth nothing to it: a man without a name does not feed. You, friend, have a taste.
fr: Le Puits me laisse passer parce que je ne vaux rien pour lui : un homme sans nom, ça ne nourrit pas. Toi, l'ami, tu as un goût.

keys: The Sandchoked City was my finest market. If you pass a stall with blue shutters, touch nothing: it is mine.
en: The Sandchoked City was my finest market. If you pass a stall with blue shutters, touch nothing: it is mine.
fr: La Cité Ensablée était mon plus beau marché. Si tu croises une échoppe aux volets bleus, ne touche à rien : elle est à moi.

keys: You emptied a warden of its souls? Bad for business: the dead never buy from me.
en: You emptied a warden of its souls? Bad for business: the dead never buy from me.
fr: Tu as vidé un gardien de ses âmes ? Mauvais pour les affaires : les morts ne m'achètent rien.

keys: Tôma, your keeper? He bought a lantern without a wick from me once, and I still wonder what it was for.
en: Tôma, your keeper? He bought a lantern without a wick from me once, and I still wonder what it was for.
fr: Tôma, ton gardien ? Il m'a acheté une lanterne sans mèche, une fois, et je me demande encore à quoi elle pouvait servir.

keys: Seal the Maw. Your master finds rest, and Hana with him.
en: Seal the Maw. Your master finds rest, and Hana with him.
fr: Scelle la Gueule. Ton maître trouve le repos, et Hana avec lui.

keys:
You ring the bell, and the Well closes.
Tôma sits against the stone, his hand on your lantern. "She sleeps now." Then he sleeps too.
Far above, Kagari wakes. The knell carries until dawn.
en:
You ring the bell, and the Well closes.
Tôma sits against the stone, his hand on your lantern. "She sleeps now." Then he sleeps too.
Far above, Kagari wakes. The knell carries until dawn.
fr:
Tu sonnes la cloche, et le Puits se referme.
Tôma s'assied contre la pierre, la main sur ta lanterne. « Elle dort, maintenant. » Puis il s'endort aussi.
Loin là-haut, Kagari s'éveille. Le glas porte jusqu'à l'aube.

keys: Seal the Maw. The one you were finds rest.
en: Seal the Maw. The one you were finds rest.
fr: Sceller la Gueule. Celui que tu étais trouve le repos.

keys:
You ring the bell, and the Well closes.
The shade sets down its lantern and is gone, like breath on cold stone.
Far above, Kagari wakes. The knell carries until dawn.
en:
You ring the bell, and the Well closes.
The shade sets down its lantern and is gone, like breath on cold stone.
Far above, Kagari wakes. The knell carries until dawn.
fr:
Tu sonnes la cloche, et le Puits se referme.
L'ombre pose sa lanterne et s'efface, comme un souffle sur la pierre froide.
Loin là-haut, Kagari s'éveille. Le glas porte jusqu'à l'aube.

keys: Become the keeper of the seal: nameless, down here, for as long as it holds.
en: Become the keeper of the seal: nameless, down here, for as long as it holds.
fr: Deviens le gardien du sceau : sans nom, ici-bas, aussi longtemps qu'il tiendra.

keys:
You take his place before the seal, and the Well forgets your face.
Tôma climbs toward the light, to wake the village and answer to it.
Below, a lantern keeps watch. No one will know who holds it.
en:
You take his place before the seal, and the Well forgets your face.
Tôma climbs toward the light, to wake the village and answer to it.
Below, a lantern keeps watch. No one will know who holds it.
fr:
Tu prends sa place devant le sceau, et le Puits oublie ton visage.
Tôma remonte vers la lumière, réveiller le village et lui répondre.
En bas, une lanterne veille. Personne ne saura qui la tient.

keys: Take the lantern from him: nameless, down here, in your turn.
en: Take the lantern from him: nameless, down here, in your turn.
fr: Lui prendre la lanterne : sans nom, ici-bas, à ton tour.

keys:
You take the lantern from the hand that was yours, and the Well forgets your face.
The one you were climbs toward the light, and does not look back.
Below, a lantern keeps watch. No one will know who holds it.
en:
You take the lantern from the hand that was yours, and the Well forgets your face.
The one you were climbs toward the light, and does not look back.
Below, a lantern keeps watch. No one will know who holds it.
fr:
Tu prends la lanterne de la main qui fut la tienne, et le Puits oublie ton visage.
Celui que tu étais remonte vers la lumière, sans se retourner.
En bas, une lanterne veille. Nul ne saura qui la tient.
Note de Brann sur le givre

keys: Frost does not fear steel. It bites it.
en: Frost does not fear steel. It bites it.
fr: Le givre ne craint pas l'acier. Il le mord.

keys: Heat your blade red, and the beast will remember the sun.
en: Heat your blade red, and the beast will remember the sun.
fr: Chauffe ta lame au rouge, et la bête se souviendra du soleil.

keys: Finish her with fire: she will not fight it, she will listen.
en: Finish her with fire: she will not fight it, she will listen.
fr: Achève-la par le feu : elle ne luttera pas, elle écoutera.

keys: The Sleeper woke before I came down. The breath reached her first, or I came too late.
en: The Sleeper woke before I came down. The breath reached her first, or I came too late.
fr: La Dormeuse s'est réveillée avant que je descende. Le souffle l'a devancée, ou je suis venu trop tard.

keys: Brann gave me the chains without looking at me. He knew what they were for.
en: Brann gave me the chains without looking at me. He knew what they were for.
fr: Brann m'a donné les chaînes sans me regarder. Il savait à quoi elles serviraient.

keys: I was cold all night. Hana did not like the cold.
en: I was cold all night. Hana did not like the cold.
fr: J'ai eu froid toute la nuit. Hana n'aimait pas le froid.
Crypte de Kagari, la première marche

keys: Sleeper, here is your cold rice. Keep our dead as you keep the winter.
en: Sleeper, here is your cold rice. Keep our dead as you keep the winter.
fr: Dormeuse, voici ton riz froid. Garde nos morts comme tu gardes l'hiver.

keys: Do not wake before we do.
en: Do not wake before we do.
fr: Ne te réveille pas avant nous.

keys: And if you dream of a sky, dream it for us as well.
en: And if you dream of a sky, dream it for us as well.
fr: Et si tu rêves d'un ciel, rêve-le pour nous aussi.

keys: Dawn, swept the ash. Three lost souls to the pyres.
en: Dawn, swept the ash. Three lost souls to the pyres.
fr: Aube, balayé la cendre. Trois âmes égarées aux bûchers.

keys: Dawn, swept the ash. A feather fell from me; it will not grow back.
en: Dawn, swept the ash. A feather fell from me; it will not grow back.
fr: Aube, balayé la cendre. Une plume m'est tombée ; elle ne repoussera pas.

keys: The Tengu told me the words of the rite without a pause. He was glad someone listened.
en: The Tengu told me the words of the rite without a pause. He was glad someone listened.
fr: Le Tengu m'a dit les mots du rite sans hésiter. Il était content qu'on l'écoute.

keys: In the Hushed Archive I had found the promise. Here I found the way.
en: In the Hushed Archive I had found the promise. Here I found the way.
fr: Aux Archives Muettes, j'avais trouvé la promesse. Ici, j'ai trouvé la manière.

keys: It must be fed, a great deal. Forgive me, Kagari: Hana first.
en: It must be fed, a great deal. Forgive me, Kagari: Hana first.
fr: Il faut nourrir, beaucoup. Pardonne-moi, Kagari : Hana d'abord.

keys: Carved in the Pyre Temple's wall
en: Carved in the Pyre Temple's wall
fr: Gravée dans le mur du Temple-Bûcher

keys: The priest takes no balm and no remedy while the offering burns.
en: The priest takes no balm and no remedy while the offering burns.
fr: Le prêtre ne prend ni baume ni remède tant que brûle l'offrande.

keys: Whoever heals during the rite defiles it. Then the sun turns its face away.
en: Whoever heals during the rite defiles it. Then the sun turns its face away.
fr: Qui guérit pendant le rite le souille. Le soleil détourne alors sa face.

keys: Burn without remedy, and the face will look upon you.
en: Burn without remedy, and the face will look upon you.
fr: Brûle sans remède, et la face te regardera.
Journal de Tôma, page tachée de suie

keys: Gorr looked at me with his one eye. He remembered my oath; I saw it.
en: Gorr looked at me with his one eye. He remembered my oath; I saw it.
fr: Gorr m'a regardé de son œil unique. Il se souvenait de mon serment, je l'ai vu.

keys: He took the souls without a word. He still believes my hand does not lie.
en: He took the souls without a word. He still believes my hand does not lie.
fr: Il a pris les âmes sans un mot. Il croit encore que ma main ne ment pas.

keys: Hana was afraid of him when she was small. He carved her a doll from an ox bone.
en: Hana was afraid of him when she was small. He carved her a doll from an ox bone.
fr: Petite, Hana avait peur de lui. Il lui avait taillé une poupée dans un os de bœuf.

keys: Niche thirty-eight: the old potter. He laughed loudly.
en: Niche thirty-eight: the old potter. He laughed loudly.
fr: Niche trente-huit : le vieux potier. Il riait fort.

keys: Niche thirty-nine: the ferryman's wife, and her comb.
en: Niche thirty-nine: the ferryman's wife, and her comb.
fr: Niche trente-neuf : la femme du passeur, et son peigne.

keys: Niche forty: empty. I am keeping it for myself.
en: Niche forty: empty. I am keeping it for myself.
fr: Niche quarante : vide. Je la garde pour moi.

keys: The keeper lays his hand over the flame and swears at the bell.
en: The keeper lays his hand over the flame and swears at the bell.
fr: Le gardien pose la main sur la flamme et prête serment à la cloche.

keys: The gravedigger holds the rope: the dead are witnesses.
en: The gravedigger holds the rope: the dead are witnesses.
fr: Le fossoyeur tient la corde : les morts sont témoins.

keys: Come before him bound by an oath, and the gravedigger will bow.
en: Come before him bound by an oath, and the gravedigger will bow.
fr: Présente-toi lié par un serment, et le fossoyeur s'inclinera.

keys: She sings my daughter's name. She does not know what she sings.
en: She sings my daughter's name. She does not know what she sings.
fr: Elle chante le nom de ma fille. Elle ne sait pas ce qu'elle chante.

keys: I gave her the children's souls to keep. Hana loved that frog.
en: I gave her the children's souls to keep. Hana loved that frog.
fr: Je lui ai confié les âmes des enfants. Hana aimait cette grenouille.

keys: If the water gives my daughter back, I will give hers back. I swear it on the lantern.
en: If the water gives my daughter back, I will give hers back. I swear it on the lantern.
fr: Si l'eau me rend ma fille, je lui rendrai les siens. Je le jure sur la lanterne.
Chantée au bord de la source

keys: Little paper boat, carry my candle far.
en: Little paper boat, carry my candle far.
fr: Petit bateau de papier, porte ma bougie loin.

keys: If the old frog sings, you have arrived.
en: If the old frog sings, you have arrived.
fr: Si la vieille grenouille chante, tu es arrivé.

keys: If she falls silent, hurry home.
en: If she falls silent, hurry home.
fr: Si elle se tait, rentre vite à la maison.
Gravée sur le rebord de la source

keys: The frog does not bite those who drank her water. She takes them for her own.
en: The frog does not bite those who drank her water. She takes them for her own.
fr: La grenouille ne mord pas ceux qui ont bu son eau. Elle les prend pour des siens.

keys: Drink at the spring before you go down, and she will let you by.
en: Drink at the spring before you go down, and she will let you by.
fr: Bois à la source avant de descendre, et elle te laissera passer.

keys: I did not drink. I am going back up.
en: I did not drink. I am going back up.
fr: Moi, je n'ai pas bu. Je remonte.

keys: The king of Solhar smiled when I offered him the souls. He had already done what I am doing.
en: The king of Solhar smiled when I offered him the souls. He had already done what I am doing.
fr: Le roi de Solhar a souri quand je lui ai offert les âmes. Il avait déjà fait ce que je fais.

keys: I asked him whether the promise was kept. He showed me his gold.
en: I asked him whether the promise was kept. He showed me his gold.
fr: Je lui ai demandé si la promesse avait été tenue. Il m'a montré son or.

keys: It is not the same. Hana is not gold; it is not the same.
en: It is not the same. Hana is not gold; it is not the same.
fr: Ce n'est pas pareil. Hana n'est pas de l'or ; ce n'est pas pareil.
Registre de la Dîme, dernière page

keys: Solhar, the year of the last harvest
en: Solhar, the year of the last harvest
fr: Solhar, l'année de la dernière moisson

keys: One soul: the eastern harvest. Ten souls: the victory at the river.
en: One soul: the eastern harvest. Ten souls: the victory at the river.
fr: Une âme : la moisson de l'est. Dix âmes : la victoire du fleuve.

keys: The whole Tithe: plenty forever, by the king's word.
en: The whole Tithe: plenty forever, by the king's word.
fr: Toute la Dîme : l'abondance pour toujours, au dire du roi.

keys: Received in exchange: gold. The granary is empty.
en: Received in exchange: gold. The granary is empty.
fr: Reçu en échange : de l'or. Le grenier est vide.

keys: An inn of Solhar, before the fall
en: An inn of Solhar, before the fall
fr: Une auberge de Solhar, avant la chute

keys: The king buys everything I sell and pays three times the price. He thinks gold makes him loved.
en: The king buys everything I sell and pays three times the price. He thinks gold makes him loved.
fr: Le roi achète tout ce que je vends et paie trois fois le prix. Il croit que l'or le rend aimé.

keys: A word to whoever would face him: buy nothing on the way. One who buys nothing, he wants to know why.
en: A word to whoever would face him: buy nothing on the way. One who buys nothing, he wants to know why.
fr: Un conseil à qui voudrait l'affronter : n'achète rien en chemin. Celui qui n'achète rien, il veut savoir pourquoi.

keys: Me, I sell. It is my trade.
en: Me, I sell. It is my trade.
fr: Moi, je vends. C'est mon métier.

keys: The Gentle One needed no chains. She already belongs to what waits for me below.
en: The Gentle One needed no chains. She already belongs to what waits for me below.
fr: La Douce n'avait pas besoin de chaînes. Elle appartient déjà à ce qui m'attend en bas.

keys: I felt the breath beneath her. Warm, patient, pleased with me.
en: I felt the breath beneath her. Warm, patient, pleased with me.
fr: J'ai senti le souffle sous elle. Tiède, patient, content de moi.

keys: Pleased with me. I wrote it twice to believe it.
en: Pleased with me. I wrote it twice to believe it.
fr: Content de moi. Je l'ai écrit deux fois pour y croire.

keys: The Hushed Archive, shelf of rites
en: The Hushed Archive, shelf of rites
fr: Les Archives Muettes, rayon des rites

keys: The Gentle One rises only for the willing, those who come at the hardest of the rite.
en: The Gentle One rises only for the willing, those who come at the hardest of the rite.
fr: La Douce ne se dresse que pour les offrandes volontaires, celles qui viennent au plus dur du rite.

keys: The lukewarm she swallows without a glance.
en: The lukewarm she swallows without a glance.
fr: Les tièdes, elle les avale sans un regard.

keys: Let only those who come down as martyrs approach her head.
en: Let only those who come down as martyrs approach her head.
fr: Que seuls ceux qui descendent en martyrs approchent sa tête.
Gravé sur une écaille de jade

keys: Gentle One, put me to sleep before the fire.
en: Gentle One, put me to sleep before the fire.

keys: I gave my fields and my goats. I have nothing left but me.
en: I gave my fields and my goats. I have nothing left but me.
fr: J'ai donné mes champs et mes chèvres. Il ne me reste que moi.

keys: If you sting me, sting softly.
en: If you sting me, sting softly.
fr: Si tu me piques, pique doucement.

keys: I poured the first soul into the bronze bowl. It was light, when I had expected it to weigh.
en: I poured the first soul into the bronze bowl. It was light, when I had expected it to weigh.
fr: J'ai versé la première âme dans le bol de bronze. Elle était légère, et je m'attendais à ce qu'elle pèse.

keys: The beast drank the way a child drinks.
en: The beast drank the way a child drinks.
fr: La bête a bu comme boit un enfant.

keys: Hana, if you can hear me at the bottom of the water: this is only the beginning.
en: Hana, if you can hear me at the bottom of the water: this is only the beginning.
fr: Hana, si tu m'entends au fond de l'eau : ce n'est que le début.

keys: The Nushi has grown again. It swallows the wax faster than we can pour it.
en: The Nushi has grown again. It swallows the wax faster than we can pour it.
fr: Le Nushi a encore grossi. Il avale la cire plus vite qu'on ne la coule.

keys: Left in peace for a minute, it doubles. Drive it off at once, or not at all.
en: Left in peace for a minute, it doubles. Drive it off at once, or not at all.
fr: Laissé en paix une minute, il double. Il faut le chasser aussitôt, ou pas du tout.

keys: The keeper says to let it be. The keeper knows what he does.
en: The keeper says to let it be. The keeper knows what he does.
fr: Le gardien dit de le laisser faire. Le gardien sait ce qu'il fait.

keys: Nushi, I gave you my finest coin.
en: Nushi, I gave you my finest coin.
fr: Nushi, je t'ai donné ma plus belle piécette.

keys: Make spring come back soon, and make Mother well.
en: Make spring come back soon, and make Mother well.
fr: Fais que le printemps revienne vite, et que maman guérisse.

keys: And do not eat the moon. It belongs to everyone.
en: And do not eat the moon. It belongs to everyone.
fr: Et ne mange pas la lune. Elle est à tout le monde.
Kagari, l'été où Hana s'est noyée

keys: Hana went into the water at dusk, among the paper boats. I was sweeping the shrine; I heard nothing.
en: Hana went into the water at dusk, among the paper boats. I was sweeping the shrine; I heard nothing.
fr: Hana est entrée dans l'eau au crépuscule, parmi les bateaux de papier. Je balayais le sanctuaire ; je n'ai rien entendu.

keys: I have taken in the child who sleeps at the door. He holds the broom badly and never cries.
en: I have taken in the child who sleeps at the door. He holds the broom badly and never cries.
fr: J'ai recueilli l'enfant qui dort devant la porte. Il tient mal le balai et ne pleure jamais.

keys: I will teach him everything. Then at least I will have taught someone.
en: I will teach him everything. Then at least I will have taught someone.
fr: Je lui apprendrai tout. Ainsi, j'aurai au moins appris quelque chose à quelqu'un.
Épinglées à l'intérieur de la porte du dojo

keys: The dash: go in, strike, never stay where the answer will fall.
en: The dash: go in, strike, never stay where the answer will fall.
fr: L'élan : entrer, frapper, ne jamais rester là où tombera la réponse.

keys: The guard: do not step aside. Let it come, and be there when it does.
en: The guard: do not step aside. Let it come, and be there when it does.
fr: La garde : ne pas s'écarter. Laisser venir, et être là quand ça vient.

keys: The lantern: it never goes out. That rule I will not teach him to break.
en: The lantern: it never goes out. That rule I will not teach him to break.
fr: La lanterne : elle ne s'éteint jamais. Cette règle-là, je ne lui apprendrai pas à la briser.

keys: Found on the stairs of the Well
en: Found on the stairs of the Well
fr: Trouvée dans les escaliers du Puits

keys: Old mother, you will hear the bell fall silent. Do not ring it; let them sleep.
en: Old mother, you will hear the bell fall silent. Do not ring it; let them sleep.
fr: Vieille mère, tu entendras la cloche se taire. Ne la sonne pas ; laisse-les dormir.

keys: If my pupil goes down after me, do not bless his lantern. He must not come this far.
en: If my pupil goes down after me, do not bless his lantern. He must not come this far.
fr: Si mon élève descend après moi, ne bénis pas sa lanterne. Il ne doit pas venir jusqu'ici.

keys: Hana will knock at your door first. Open to her.
en: Hana will knock at your door first. Open to her.
fr: Hana frappera d'abord à ta porte. Ouvre-lui.
Note de Brann sur deux lames

keys: Scratched on a cold blade's guard
en: Scratched on a cold blade's guard
fr: Gravée sur la garde d'une lame froide

keys: Forged for a man going to die without a name. I did not want to know his.
en: Forged for a man going to die without a name. I did not want to know his.
fr: Forgées pour un homme qui allait mourir sans nom. Je n'ai pas voulu savoir le sien.

keys: They will not tremble. Neither will he.
en: They will not tremble. Neither will he.
fr: Elles ne trembleront pas. Lui non plus.

keys: Beat him without bleeding much, and he will speak to you. He was an upright man.
en: Beat him without bleeding much, and he will speak to you. He was an upright man.
fr: Bats-le sans trop saigner, et il te parlera. C'était un homme droit.

keys: On a tomb without an inscription
en: On a tomb without an inscription

keys: Here lies —, knight of —, who gave his name to the seal.
en: Here lies —, knight of —, who gave his name to the seal.
fr: Ici repose —, chevalier de —, qui a donné son nom au sceau.

keys: Passer-by, do not try to read it. The name is below, and it holds the door.
en: Passer-by, do not try to read it. The name is below, and it holds the door.
fr: Passant, ne cherche pas à le lire. Le nom est en bas, et il tient la porte.

keys: The first keeper rose against me. I struck the way I teach my pupil.
en: The first keeper rose against me. I struck the way I teach my pupil.
fr: Le premier gardien s'est levé contre moi. J'ai frappé comme je l'enseigne à mon élève.

keys: The seal opened without a sound. The knight's name blew away like ash.
en: The seal opened without a sound. The knight's name blew away like ash.
fr: Le sceau s'est ouvert sans un bruit. Le nom du chevalier s'est envolé comme de la cendre.

keys: My pupil will recognise the cut. I pray he never comes this far.
en: My pupil will recognise the cut. I pray he never comes this far.
fr: Mon élève reconnaîtra la coupure. Je prie pour qu'il ne descende jamais jusqu'ici.
Gravé sur le fourreau de Vardan
Un seul tranchant, une seule loyauté.

keys: A guard crosses steel only with a curved blade like his own, a katana's. No other deserves an answer.
en: A guard crosses steel only with a curved blade like his own, a katana's. No other deserves an answer.
fr: Un garde ne croise le fer qu'avec une lame courbe comme la sienne, un katana. Aucune autre ne mérite de réponse.

keys: Whoever defeats him so becomes his master.
en: Whoever defeats him so becomes his master.
fr: Qui le vainc ainsi devient son maître.

keys: Tôma's Journal, a Page Folded in Four
en: Tôma's Journal, a Page Folded in Four
fr: Journal de Tôma, page pliée en quatre

keys: The Pyre Temple, the seventh step
en: The Pyre Temple, the seventh step

keys: The guard of Solhar listened to me as one listens to a king. I was ashamed of how easy it was.
en: The guard of Solhar listened to me as one listens to a king. I was ashamed of how easy it was.
fr: Le garde de Solhar m'a écouté comme on écoute un roi. J'ai eu honte de la facilité.

keys: I told him no one would drive these souls up. I am the one who will.
en: I told him no one would drive these souls up. I am the one who will.
fr: Je lui ai dit que personne ne ferait monter ces âmes. C'est moi qui les ferai monter.

keys: I lied to him with the words of my oath. They still obey me.
en: I lied to him with the words of my oath. They still obey me.
fr: Je lui ai menti avec les mots de mon serment. Ils m'obéissent encore.

keys: Solhar, the day of the Tithe
en: Solhar, the day of the Tithe
fr: Solhar, le jour de la Dîme

keys: Merel the baker and her two sons; Osk the tanner; old Ilse, who brought me water.
en: Merel the baker and her two sons; Osk the tanner; old Ilse, who brought me water.
fr: Merel la boulangère et ses deux fils ; Osk le tanneur ; la vieille Ilse, qui m'apportait de l'eau.

keys: All went up at dawn. None came down.
en: All went up at dawn. None came down.
fr: Tous montés à l'aube. Aucun redescendu.
Chanté sur les marches du temple

keys: Great Noon, you drink our shadows, and our fields are golden.
en: Great Noon, you drink our shadows, and our fields are golden.
fr: Grand Midi, tu bois nos ombres, et nos champs sont dorés.

keys: Great Noon, you drink our sons, and our blades are victorious.
en: Great Noon, you drink our sons, and our blades are victorious.
fr: Grand Midi, tu bois nos fils, et nos lames sont victorieuses.

keys: Great Noon, drink again. It is so bright.
en: Great Noon, drink again. It is so bright.
fr: Grand Midi, bois encore. Il fait si clair.

keys: Tôma's Journal, a Page Burnt Through
en: Tôma's Journal, a Page Burnt Through
fr: Journal de Tôma, page brûlée au cœur

keys: The Tomb of the Dead Sun
en: The Tomb of the Dead Sun

keys: It answered me, and it was not a voice: it was hers. Hana, in the light.
en: It answered me, and it was not a voice: it was hers. Hana, in the light.
fr: Il m'a répondu, et ce n'était pas une voix : c'était la sienne. Hana, dans la lumière.

keys: "Give, and she will come." I will give.
en: "Give, and she will come." I will give.
fr: « Donne, et elle viendra. » Je donnerai.

keys: I did not look behind the light. I will not look.
en: I did not look behind the light. I will not look.
fr: Je n'ai pas regardé derrière la lumière. Je ne regarderai pas.

keys: Carved on a slab of the tomb
en: Carved on a slab of the tomb
fr: Gravé sur une dalle du tombeau

keys: Our prayers fed it; only our blessed steel wounds it.
en: Our prayers fed it; only our blessed steel wounds it.
fr: Nos prières l'ont nourri ; seul notre acier béni le blesse.

keys: Strike it with the Templar's sword, and the mask cracks.
en: Strike it with the Templar's sword, and the mask cracks.
fr: Frappe-le avec l'épée du Templier, et le masque se fend.

keys: I did not have the time. You, perhaps.
en: I did not have the time. You, perhaps.
fr: Je n'en ai pas eu le temps. Toi, peut-être.

keys: Little boat, go down to the bottom and say hello to the sun.
en: Little boat, go down to the bottom and say hello to the sun.
fr: Petit bateau, descends jusqu'au fond et dis bonjour au soleil.

keys: Bring a ray back for papa. He is always cold.
en: Bring a ray back for papa. He is always cold.
fr: Rapporte un rayon pour papa. Il a toujours froid.

keys: Tôma's Journal, a Page Stuck with Tar
en: Tôma's Journal, a Page Stuck with Tar
fr: Journal de Tôma, page collée de goudron

keys: It rose out of the tar, golden, and I knelt as the priests of Solhar knelt.
en: It rose out of the tar, golden, and I knelt as the priests of Solhar knelt.
fr: Elle est montée du goudron, dorée, et je me suis agenouillé comme les prêtres de Solhar.

keys: It speaks with her voice. It says papa as she did, only a little too slowly.
en: It speaks with her voice. It says papa as she did, only a little too slowly.
fr: Elle parle avec sa voix. Elle dit papa comme elle, juste un peu trop lentement.

keys: I will wait here until it keeps its word. It has all the time in the world; so have I.
en: I will wait here until it keeps its word. It has all the time in the world; so have I.
fr: J'attendrai ici qu'elle tienne parole. Elle a tout le temps du monde ; moi aussi.

keys: A copy, taken from under the bell of Kagari
en: A copy, taken from under the bell of Kagari
fr: Une copie, relevée sous la cloche de Kagari

keys: It does not die. A lack is not killed; it is made to wait.
en: It does not die. A lack is not killed; it is made to wait.
fr: Elle ne meurt pas. On ne tue pas un manque ; on le fait attendre.

keys: Ring the bell from below, and the door remembers it is a door.
en: Ring the bell from below, and the door remembers it is a door.
fr: Sonne la cloche d'en bas, et la porte se souvient qu'elle est une porte.

keys: Give it nothing, not even a drop of blood. What it has tasted, it keeps.
en: Give it nothing, not even a drop of blood. What it has tasted, it keeps.
fr: Ne lui donne rien, pas même une goutte de sang. Ce qu'elle a goûté, elle le garde.

keys: Never weep in front of the dead. Tears bind them here.
en: Never weep in front of the dead. Tears bind them here.
fr: Ne pleure jamais devant un mort. Les larmes l'attachent ici.

keys: Stay dry, stay straight. Let nothing touch you, not even a blow.
en: Stay dry, stay straight. Let nothing touch you, not even a blow.
fr: Reste sèche, reste droite. Ne te laisse rien toucher, pas même un coup.

keys: Then the dead will speak to you, because you do not hold them back.
en: Then the dead will speak to you, because you do not hold them back.
fr: Alors les morts te parleront, parce que tu ne les retiens pas.

keys: They weep for Hana. No one asked them to; they do it anyway.
en: They weep for Hana. No one asked them to; they do it anyway.
fr: Elles pleurent Hana. Personne ne le leur a demandé, elles le font quand même.

keys: I have no tears left. I left them my last ones, with the souls.
en: I have no tears left. I left them my last ones, with the souls.
fr: Je n'ai plus de larmes. Je leur ai laissé les dernières, avec les âmes.

keys: When Hana comes back, I will pay them all the rice in the world.
en: When Hana comes back, I will pay them all the rice in the world.
fr: Quand Hana reviendra, je leur paierai tout le riz du monde.

keys: Sleep, sleep, the rice is cooked, the mat is laid.
en: Sleep, sleep, the rice is cooked, the mat is laid.
fr: Dors, dors, le riz est cuit, la natte est faite.

keys: Sleep, the bell has rung for you, the earth is waiting.
en: Sleep, the bell has rung for you, the earth is waiting.
fr: Dors, la cloche a sonné pour toi, la terre t'attend.

keys: Sleep: we weep, so you need not.
en: Sleep: we weep, so you need not.
fr: Dors : nous pleurons, toi, tu n'as plus à le faire.

keys: Between the Well and the light, the dead wait their turn. Not yours. Not yet.
en: Between the Well and the light, the dead wait their turn. Not yours. Not yet.
fr: Entre le Puits et la lumière, les morts attendent leur tour. Pas le tien. Pas encore.

keys: Pale shapes wait in the dark, held by chains of tar. They were Kagari's, once.
en: Pale shapes wait in the dark, held by chains of tar. They were Kagari's, once.
fr: Des formes pâles attendent dans le noir, tenues par des chaînes de goudron. Elles étaient de Kagari, autrefois.

keys: The last soul rises. Somewhere above, a lantern burns a little brighter.
en: The last soul rises. Somewhere above, a lantern burns a little brighter.
fr: La dernière âme s'élève. Quelque part en haut, une lanterne brûle un peu plus fort.

keys: The villagers Tôma gave to the Well on the moonless night. The tar holds them still; stand by each one long enough, and it lets go.
en: The villagers Tôma gave to the Well on the moonless night. The tar holds them still; stand by each one long enough, and it lets go.
fr: Les villageois que Tôma a donnés au Puits la nuit sans lune. Le goudron les tient encore ; reste assez longtemps près de chacun, et il lâche prise.

keys: A seal is drawn before a sealed door, its five points dark. Lanterns stand cold somewhere on this floor.
en: A seal is drawn before a sealed door, its five points dark. Lanterns stand cold somewhere on this floor.
fr: Un sceau est tracé devant une porte scellée, ses cinq pointes éteintes. Des lanternes froides attendent quelque part à cet étage.

keys: The fifth flame takes. The seal comes undone, and the door with it.
en: The fifth flame takes. The seal comes undone, and the door with it.
fr: La cinquième flamme prend. Le sceau se défait, et la porte avec lui.

keys: Tôma undid the seal's knots one by one. Here a lesser seal still holds a door: light its five lanterns, and tie the knots back the other way.
en: Tôma undid the seal's knots one by one. Here a lesser seal still holds a door: light its five lanterns, and tie the knots back the other way.
fr: Tôma a défait les nœuds du sceau un à un. Ici, un sceau plus petit tient encore une porte : allume ses cinq lanternes, et renoue les nœuds dans l'autre sens.

keys: Drag your thumb on the left side of the screen to walk.
en: Drag your thumb on the left side of the screen to walk.
fr: Fais glisser ton pouce sur la gauche de l'écran pour marcher.

keys: The way down is sealed. Slay monsters to break the seal: the count is under the map.
en: The way down is sealed. Slay monsters to break the seal: the count is under the map.
fr: La voie vers le bas est scellée. Abats des monstres pour briser le sceau : le compte est sous la carte.

keys: Tap the big button to strike. It aims at the closest enemy by itself.
en: Tap the big button to strike. It aims at the closest enemy by itself.
fr: Touche le gros bouton pour frapper. Il vise tout seul l'ennemi le plus proche.

keys: Press {attack} to strike. It aims at the closest enemy by itself.
en: Press {attack} to strike. It aims at the closest enemy by itself.
fr: Appuie sur {attack} pour frapper. Le coup vise tout seul l'ennemi le plus proche.

keys: Tap Roll to dash the way you walk. Nothing can hurt you mid-roll.
en: Tap Roll to dash the way you walk. Nothing can hurt you mid-roll.
fr: Touche Roulade pour filer dans la direction où tu marches. Rien ne peut te blesser pendant une roulade.

keys: Press {skill_1} to roll the way you walk. Nothing can hurt you mid-roll.
en: Press {skill_1} to roll the way you walk. Nothing can hurt you mid-roll.
fr: Appuie sur {skill_1} pour rouler là où tu marches. Rien ne peut te blesser pendant une roulade.

keys: Your weapon has two skills of its own, and every weapon has different ones. Try them!
en: Your weapon has two skills of its own, and every weapon has different ones. Try them!
fr: Ton arme a deux compétences bien à elle, et chaque arme a les siennes. Essaie-les !

keys: Your weapon has two skills of its own, on {skill_2} and {skill_3}. Every weapon has different ones. Try them!
en: Your weapon has two skills of its own, on {skill_2} and {skill_3}. Every weapon has different ones. Try them!
fr: Ton arme a deux compétences à elle, sur {skill_2} et {skill_3}. Chaque arme a les siennes. Essaie-les !

keys: Hold the big button to charge your weapon. Let go when the ring is full to unleash its heavy blow.
en: Hold the big button to charge your weapon. Let go when the ring is full to unleash its heavy blow.
fr: Maintiens le gros bouton pour charger ton arme. Relâche quand l'anneau est plein pour libérer son coup puissant.

keys: Hold {attack} to charge your weapon. Let go when the ring is full to unleash its heavy blow.
en: Hold {attack} to charge your weapon. Let go when the ring is full to unleash its heavy blow.
fr: Maintiens {attack} pour charger ton arme. Relâche quand l'anneau est plein pour libérer son coup puissant.

keys: Tap a potion on your belt to drink it. Potions are rare: keep them for when it counts.
en: Tap a potion on your belt to drink it. Potions are rare: keep them for when it counts.
fr: Touche une potion de ta ceinture pour la boire. Les potions sont rares : garde-les pour les moments critiques.

keys: Press {quick_item} to drink the potion on your belt. Potions are rare: keep them for when it counts.
en: Press {quick_item} to drink the potion on your belt. Potions are rare: keep them for when it counts.
fr: Appuie sur {quick_item} pour boire la potion de ta ceinture. Les potions sont rares : garde-les pour les moments critiques.

keys: Slain monsters free their souls. Between runs, spend them on the Tree of Souls, at the shrine.
en: Slain monsters free their souls. Between runs, spend them on the Tree of Souls, at the shrine.
fr: Les monstres abattus libèrent leurs âmes. Entre deux parties, dépense-les dans l'Arbre des Âmes, au Sanctuaire.

keys: Each level brings a perk: tap the glowing button to choose it, whenever you like. Three of a family awaken a bonus.
en: Each level brings a perk: tap the glowing button to choose it, whenever you like. Three of a family awaken a bonus.
fr: Chaque niveau apporte un atout : touche le bouton qui luit pour le choisir, quand tu veux. Trois d'une famille éveillent un bonus.

keys: Each level brings a perk: press {offers} to choose it, whenever you like. Three of a family awaken a bonus.
en: Each level brings a perk: press {offers} to choose it, whenever you like. Three of a family awaken a bonus.
fr: Chaque niveau apporte un atout : appuie sur {offers} pour le choisir, quand tu veux. Trois d'une famille éveillent un bonus.

keys: Three of a family: its bonus is yours for the rest of the run.
en: Three of a family: its bonus is yours for the rest of the run.
fr: Trois atouts d'une famille : son bonus est à toi pour le reste de la partie.

keys: You picked up gear. Open the Bag to compare it and equip it.
en: You picked up gear. Open the Bag to compare it and equip it.
fr: Tu as ramassé de l'équipement. Ouvre le Sac pour le comparer et l'équiper.

keys: You picked up gear. Open the Bag ({inventory}) to compare it and equip it.
en: You picked up gear. Open the Bag ({inventory}) to compare it and equip it.
fr: Tu as ramassé de l'équipement. Ouvre le Sac ({inventory}) pour le comparer et l'équiper.

keys: The tome taught you a spell: it has its own button. Reading another tome replaces it.
en: The tome taught you a spell: it has its own button. Reading another tome replaces it.
fr: Le grimoire t'a appris un sort : il a son propre bouton. Lire un autre grimoire le remplace.

keys: The tome taught you a spell: {skill_4} casts it. Reading another tome replaces it.
en: The tome taught you a spell: {skill_4} casts it. Reading another tome replaces it.
fr: Le grimoire t'a appris un sort : {skill_4} le lance. Lire un autre grimoire le remplace.

keys: Elites have powers, named after them. Tougher, but they drop better loot, and sometimes runes.
en: Elites have powers, named after them. Tougher, but they drop better loot, and sometimes runes.
fr: Les élites ont des pouvoirs, qui leur donnent leur nom. Plus coriaces, mais ils lâchent un meilleur butin, et parfois des runes.

keys: Runes go into your weapon's sockets at a smith's forge. Better weapons have more sockets.
en: Runes go into your weapon's sockets at a smith's forge. Better weapons have more sockets.
fr: Les runes se sertissent dans les emplacements de ton arme, à la forge d'un forgeron. Les meilleures armes ont plus d'emplacements.

keys: Walk up to the anvil and tap Forge to set runes into your weapon. The smith takes them out again for gold.
en: Walk up to the anvil and tap Forge to set runes into your weapon. The smith takes them out again for gold.
fr: Approche-toi de l'enclume et touche Forger pour sertir des runes dans ton arme. Le forgeron les retire contre de l'or.

keys: Walk up to the anvil and press {interact} to set runes into your weapon. The smith takes them out for gold.
en: Walk up to the anvil and press {interact} to set runes into your weapon. The smith takes them out for gold.
fr: Approche-toi de l'enclume et appuie sur {interact} pour sertir des runes dans ton arme. Le forgeron les retire contre de l'or.

keys: Walk up to the merchant and tap Trade to spend your gold, or to sell him what you don't need.
en: Walk up to the merchant and tap Trade to spend your gold, or to sell him what you don't need.
fr: Approche-toi du marchand et touche Marchander pour dépenser ton or, ou lui vendre ce dont tu n'as pas besoin.

keys: Walk up to the merchant and press {interact} to spend your gold, or to sell him what you don't need.
en: Walk up to the merchant and press {interact} to spend your gold, or to sell him what you don't need.
fr: Approche-toi du marchand et appuie sur {interact} pour dépenser ton or, ou lui vendre ce dont tu n'as pas besoin.

keys: Walk up to a chest to open it. Careful: some are trapped.
en: Walk up to a chest to open it. Careful: some are trapped.
fr: Approche-toi d'un coffre pour l'ouvrir. Prudence : certains sont piégés.

keys: This wall is cracked and a draft blows through it. Strike it or blast it: something lies behind.
en: This wall is cracked and a draft blows through it. Strike it or blast it: something lies behind.
fr: Ce mur est fissuré et un courant d'air passe au travers. Frappe-le ou fais-le sauter : il cache quelque chose.

keys: The exits stay shut until every wave is dead. Survive, and a chest appears.
en: The exits stay shut until every wave is dead. Survive, and a chest appears.
fr: Les sorties restent closes jusqu'à ce que chaque vague soit morte. Survis, et un coffre apparaît.

keys: Watch the ground: red marks show where it will strike. It changes its attacks as it weakens.
en: Watch the ground: red marks show where it will strike. It changes its attacks as it weakens.
fr: Surveille le sol : les marques rouges montrent où il va frapper. Il change d'attaques en s'affaiblissant.

keys: Find the stairs on the map. Tap the map to see the whole floor.
en: Find the stairs on the map. Tap the map to see the whole floor.
fr: Trouve les escaliers sur la carte. Touche la carte pour voir tout l'étage.

keys: Find the stairs on the map. Press {map} to see the whole floor.
en: Find the stairs on the map. Press {map} to see the whole floor.
fr: Trouve les escaliers sur la carte. Appuie sur {map} pour voir tout l'étage.

keys: This floor has two stairs. The sign over each tells where it leads: a cursed floor is harder but has better loot.
en: This floor has two stairs. The sign over each tells where it leads: a cursed floor is harder but has better loot.
fr: Cet étage a deux escaliers. Le panneau au-dessus de chacun indique où il mène : un étage maudit est plus dur mais offre un meilleur butin.

keys: You brought souls back. The shrine's Tree of Souls turns them into lasting upgrades.
en: You brought souls back. The shrine's Tree of Souls turns them into lasting upgrades.
fr: Tu as ramené des âmes. L'Arbre des Âmes du Sanctuaire les change en améliorations durables.

keys: Tap a node, then Buy. Nodes open from the top down; "or": pick one of two. Reset gives all your souls back.
en: Tap a node, then Buy. Nodes open from the top down; "or": pick one of two. Reset gives all your souls back.
fr: Touche un nœud, puis Acheter. Les nœuds s'ouvrent de haut en bas ; « ou » : choisis l'un des deux. Réinitialiser te rend toutes tes âmes.

keys: Choose a node, then Buy. Nodes open from the top down; "or": pick one of two. Reset gives all your souls back.
en: Choose a node, then Buy. Nodes open from the top down; "or": pick one of two. Reset gives all your souls back.
fr: Choisis un nœud, puis Acheter. Les nœuds s'ouvrent de haut en bas ; « ou » : choisis l'un des deux. Réinitialiser te rend toutes tes âmes.

keys: An oath changes your start: a gain and a cost. Pick one or Unsworn, then Begin the descent.
en: An oath changes your start: a gain and a cost. Pick one or Unsworn, then Begin the descent.
fr: Un serment change ton départ : un gain et un prix. Choisis-en un ou Sans serment, puis Entamer la descente.

keys: A curse changes this floor's rules. It lasts until you take the stairs.
en: A curse changes this floor's rules. It lasts until you take the stairs.
fr: Une malédiction change les règles de cet étage. Elle dure jusqu'à ce que tu prennes les escaliers.

keys: Something unusual is going on here: the log on the left tells you what.
en: Something unusual is going on here: the log on the left tells you what.
fr: Il se passe quelque chose d'inhabituel ici : le journal à gauche te dit quoi.

keys: Stay near a campfire to warm up. Frozen, you slow down and get hurt.
en: Stay near a campfire to warm up. Frozen, you slow down and get hurt.
fr: Reste près d'un feu de camp pour te réchauffer. Gelé, tu ralentis et tu souffres.

keys: Stay by an oasis to cool down before the heat hurts you.
en: Stay by an oasis to cool down before the heat hurts you.
fr: Reste près d'une oasis pour te rafraîchir avant que la chaleur ne te blesse.

keys: A second life, if you earn it: slay the spectres before the countdown ends to return where you fell.
en: A second life, if you earn it: slay the spectres before the countdown ends to return where you fell.
fr: Une seconde vie, si tu la mérites : abats les spectres avant la fin du compte à rebours pour revenir où tu es tombé.

keys: Fallen into the Deeps: follow the arrow of light to the Dawn Breach. The Damned keep coming.
en: Fallen into the Deeps: follow the arrow of light to the Dawn Breach. The Damned keep coming.
fr: Tombé dans les Tréfonds : suis la flèche de lumière jusqu'à la Brèche de l'Aube. Les Damnés affluent.

keys: A pact door. Walk up to the stele and tap Read the pact: keep it for a relic, break it and lose max Health.
en: A pact door. Walk up to the stele and tap Read the pact: keep it for a relic, break it and lose max Health.
fr: Porte de pacte. Approche de la stèle, touche Lire le pacte : tiens-le pour une relique, romps-le et perds de la Vie max.

keys: A pact door. Walk up to the stele and press {interact}: keep the pact for a relic, break it and lose max Health.
en: A pact door. Walk up to the stele and press {interact}: keep the pact for a relic, break it and lose max Health.
fr: Porte de pacte. Approche de la stèle, appuie sur {interact} : tiens le pacte pour une relique, romps-le et perds de la Vie max.

keys: Altars, springs and spirits offer a deal. Walk up to one and tap the button over your skills to see it.
en: Altars, springs and spirits offer a deal. Walk up to one and tap the button over your skills to see it.
fr: Autels, sources et esprits proposent un marché. Approche-toi et touche le bouton au-dessus de tes compétences.

keys: Altars, springs and spirits offer a deal. Walk up to one and press {interact} to see it.
en: Altars, springs and spirits offer a deal. Walk up to one and press {interact} to see it.
fr: Autels, sources et esprits proposent un marché. Approche-toi et appuie sur {interact} pour le voir.

keys: Drag on the left side of the screen
en: Drag on the left side of the screen
fr: Glisse le doigt sur la gauche de l'écran
Le gros bouton, en bas à droite

keys: The round button left of the attack
en: The round button left of the attack
fr: Le bouton rond à gauche de l'attaque

keys: The round button above the roll
en: The round button above the roll
fr: Le bouton rond au-dessus de la roulade

keys: The round button above the attack
en: The round button above the attack
fr: Le bouton rond au-dessus de l'attaque

keys: The fourth round button, once you know a spell
en: The fourth round button, once you know a spell
fr: Le quatrième bouton rond, une fois un sort appris

keys: The small buttons left of the skills
en: The small buttons left of the skills
fr: Les petits boutons à gauche des compétences

keys: The button over the skills, when something is in reach
en: The button over the skills, when something is in reach
fr: Le bouton au-dessus des compétences, quand quelque chose est à portée

keys: The golden star, left of the map
en: The golden star, left of the map
fr: L'étoile dorée, à gauche de la carte

keys: The II button, or the phone's back button
en: The II button, or the phone's back button
fr: Le bouton II, ou le bouton retour du téléphone

keys: Close, or the phone's back button
en: Close, or the phone's back button
fr: Fermer, ou le bouton retour du téléphone

keys: The Dismantle button on the item's card
en: The Dismantle button on the item's card
fr: Le bouton Démanteler, sur la fiche de l'objet

keys: The Drop button on the item's card
en: The Drop button on the item's card
fr: Le bouton Jeter, sur la fiche de l'objet

keys: Tap the minimap to see the whole floor and find the stairs.
en: Tap the minimap to see the whole floor and find the stairs.
fr: Touche la mini-carte pour voir tout l'étage et trouver les escaliers.

keys: Press {map} to see the whole floor and find the stairs.
en: Press {map} to see the whole floor and find the stairs.
fr: Appuie sur {map} pour voir tout l'étage et trouver les escaliers.

keys: Hold the attack button to charge a heavy blow; let go when the ring is full.
en: Hold the attack button to charge a heavy blow; let go when the ring is full.
fr: Maintiens le bouton d'attaque pour charger un coup puissant ; relâche quand l'anneau est plein.

keys: Hold {attack} to charge a heavy blow; let go when the ring is full.
en: Hold {attack} to charge a heavy blow; let go when the ring is full.
fr: Maintiens {attack} pour charger un coup puissant ; relâche quand l'anneau est plein.

keys: A level up's perk waits behind the golden star: tap it when the fight allows.
en: A level up's perk waits behind the golden star: tap it when the fight allows.
fr: L'atout d'un niveau attend derrière l'étoile dorée : touche-la quand le combat le permet.

keys: A level up's perk waits: press {offers} when the fight allows.
en: A level up's perk waits: press {offers} when the fight allows.
fr: L'atout d'un niveau attend : appuie sur {offers} quand le combat le permet.

keys: Roll through a blow: for a heartbeat, nothing can touch you.
en: Roll through a blow: for a heartbeat, nothing can touch you.
fr: Roule à travers un coup : le temps d'un battement de cœur, rien ne peut te toucher.

keys: A weapon is as strong as the floor it was found on. Keep plundering.
en: A weapon is as strong as the floor it was found on. Keep plundering.
fr: Une arme vaut l'étage où elle fut trouvée. Continue à piller.

keys: Hold three perks of one family to awaken its bonus.
en: Hold three perks of one family to awaken its bonus.
fr: Réunis trois atouts d'une même famille pour éveiller son bonus.

keys: The sign over each stairs tells where it leads. Cursed floors pay better loot.
en: The sign over each stairs tells where it leads. Cursed floors pay better loot.
fr: Le panneau au-dessus des escaliers indique où ils mènent. Les étages maudits offrent un meilleur butin.

keys: Elites wear their powers in their names. Read before you charge.
en: Elites wear their powers in their names. Read before you charge.
fr: Les élites portent leurs pouvoirs dans leur nom. Lis avant de charger.

keys: Souls outlive you. Offer them to the Tree of Souls, at the shrine.
en: Souls outlive you. Offer them to the Tree of Souls, at the shrine.
fr: Les âmes te survivent. Offre-les à l'Arbre des Âmes, au Sanctuaire.

keys: Gold dies with you: spend it at the merchant while you still breathe.
en: Gold dies with you: spend it at the merchant while you still breathe.
fr: L'or meurt avec toi : dépense-le chez le marchand tant que tu respires.

keys: A forge sets runes in your weapon for free.
en: A forge sets runes in your weapon for free.
fr: Une forge sertit gratuitement des runes dans ton arme.

keys: Wardens wind up their great blows: step away when they do.
en: Wardens wind up their great blows: step away when they do.
fr: Les gardiens prennent leur élan avant un grand coup : écarte-toi quand ils le font.

keys: Lock an item at the merchant: the next one sells it at the same price.
en: Lock an item at the merchant: the next one sells it at the same price.
fr: Verrouille un objet chez le marchand : le suivant te le vend au même prix.

keys: A banish removes a perk you never want to see again, for the whole run.
en: A banish removes a perk you never want to see again, for the whole run.
fr: Un bannissement retire un atout que tu ne veux plus jamais voir, pour toute la partie.

keys: No prayer heals faster than a warden strikes: dodge, don't trade blows.
en: No prayer heals faster than a warden strikes: dodge, don't trade blows.
fr: Aucune prière ne soigne plus vite qu'un gardien ne frappe : esquive, n'échange pas les coups.

keys: Campfires warm you on frozen floors; oases cool you on burning ones.
en: Campfires warm you on frozen floors; oases cool you on burning ones.
fr: Les feux de camp te réchauffent sur les étages gelés ; les oasis te rafraîchissent sur les étages brûlants.

keys: On Pilgrim, every new floor heals you a quarter of your Health.
en: On Pilgrim, every new floor heals you a quarter of your Health.
fr: En Pèlerin, chaque nouvel étage te rend un quart de ta Vie.

keys: Your weapons' skills deal more damage, in every run.
en: Your weapons' skills deal more damage, in every run.
fr: Les compétences de tes armes infligent plus de Dégâts, dans chaque partie.

keys: Pick your starting weapon before each run.
en: Pick your starting weapon before each run.
fr: Choisis ton arme de départ avant chaque partie.

keys: 20% more max Health in every run, but every heal is 30% weaker.
en: 20% more max Health in every run, but every heal is 30% weaker.
fr: 20 % de Vie max en plus dans chaque partie, mais chaque soin est 30 % plus faible.

keys: The minimap shows each floor's stairs, merchant and forge from the start.
en: The minimap shows each floor's stairs, merchant and forge from the start.
fr: La minicarte montre dès le départ les escaliers, le marchand et la forge de chaque étage.

keys: One more banish every run: a perk you never want to see again is gone for the run.
en: One more banish every run: a perk you never want to see again is gone for the run.
fr: Un bannissement de plus par partie : un atout que tu ne veux plus jamais voir disparaît pour la partie.

keys: The Tomes of Thunder and Wind can be found in the dungeon.
en: The Tomes of Thunder and Wind can be found in the dungeon.
fr: Les Grimoires du Tonnerre et du Vent peuvent apparaître dans le donjon.

keys: The merchant sells 2 more pieces of equipment.
en: The merchant sells 2 more pieces of equipment.
fr: Le marchand vend 2 pièces d'équipement de plus.

keys: Faster attacks: +4% attack speed per level, in every run.
en: Faster attacks: +4% attack speed per level, in every run.
fr: Des attaques plus rapides : +4 % de Vitesse d'attaque par niveau, dans chaque partie.
Les prix du marchand sont 15 % plus bas.

keys: One more reroll of the perk cards every run.
en: One more reroll of the perk cards every run.
fr: Une relance de plus des cartes d'atouts par partie.

keys: Plate Armor and the Shadow Cloak can be found in the dungeon.
en: Plate Armor and the Shadow Cloak can be found in the dungeon.
fr: L'Armure de Plates et la Cape d'Ombre peuvent apparaître dans le donjon.

keys: Every hit you land deals more damage, in every run.
en: Every hit you land deals more damage, in every run.
fr: Chaque coup porté inflige plus de Dégâts, dans chaque partie.

keys: Opens this oath: sworn before a run, it changes how you start it.
en: Opens this oath: sworn before a run, it changes how you start it.
fr: Ouvre ce serment : prêté avant une partie, il change ton départ.

keys: The Templar Sword (holy skills) can be found in the dungeon.
en: The Templar Sword (holy skills) can be found in the dungeon.
fr: L'Épée de Templier (compétences sacrées) peut apparaître dans le donjon.

keys: More critical hits: +2% critical hit chance per level, in every run.
en: More critical hits: +2% critical hit chance per level, in every run.
fr: Plus de coups critiques : +2 % de chance de coup critique par niveau, dans chaque partie.

keys: Start every run with one more health potion per level.
en: Start every run with one more health potion per level.
fr: Commence chaque partie avec une potion de Vie de plus par niveau.

keys: The Ember Tome (fire skills) can be found in the dungeon.
en: The Ember Tome (fire skills) can be found in the dungeon.
fr: Le Grimoire des Braises (compétences de feu) peut apparaître dans le donjon.

keys: Skills recharge 4% faster per level, in every run.
en: Skills recharge 4% faster per level, in every run.
fr: Compétences rechargées 4 % plus vite par niveau, dans chaque partie.

keys: Heal 5% of your max Health per level each time a floor's stairs open or its boss falls.
en: Heal 5% of your max Health per level each time a floor's stairs open or its boss falls.
fr: Récupère 5 % de ta Vie max par niveau chaque fois que les escaliers d'un étage s'ouvrent ou que son boss tombe.

keys: Start every run with a Phoenix Feather: a killing blow sends you to the Threshold; win its trial to return where you fell, at half Health (a quarter in a boss fight).
en: Start every run with a Phoenix Feather: a killing blow sends you to the Threshold; win its trial to return where you fell, at half Health (a quarter in a boss fight).
fr: Commence chaque partie avec une Plume de Phénix : un coup fatal t'envoie au Seuil ; remporte son épreuve pour revenir où tu es tombé, à la moitié de ta Vie (un quart en combat de boss).

keys: Your hero moves faster, in every run.
en: Your hero moves faster, in every run.
fr: Ton héros se déplace plus vite, dans chaque partie.

keys: Start every run with a spell tome, at random among those the dungeon holds.
en: Start every run with a spell tome, at random among those the dungeon holds.
fr: Commence chaque partie avec un grimoire de sort, au hasard parmi ceux que recèle le donjon.

keys: Armor: the hits you take hurt less, in every run.
en: Armor: the hits you take hurt less, in every run.
fr: Armure : les coups que tu encaisses font moins mal, dans chaque partie.

keys: Elites, Fell and Legendary monsters always drop a Magic (or better) piece of equipment.
en: Elites, Fell and Legendary monsters always drop a Magic (or better) piece of equipment.
fr: Les monstres d'élite, Funestes et Légendaires lâchent toujours une pièce d'équipement Magique (ou mieux).

keys: More max health at the start of every run.
en: More max health at the start of every run.
fr: Plus de Vie max au début de chaque partie.
